AI.tldr: 本文研究在不确定市场条件下，共同所有权如何将序贯先占竞争转变为带有竞赛式动态的协调机制。通过对三家企业面对随机需求演化的行业进行建模，发现均衡表现出"手风琴效应"：共同所有权软化最后进入、加剧双寡头阶段的竞争，并最终延缓首次市场进入。但在三企业行业中，如果期权价值足够高，双寡头阶段会出现协调均衡，其竞赛式动态加速首次进入并提升福利。
AI.research_question: 共同所有权如何在不确定市场中根本性地改变企业的进入决策与市场竞争动态？具体而言，在三企业行业情境下，共同所有权对序贯进入行为的影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有文献大多聚焦于两家企业行业的共同所有权效应，而现实市场中通常存在三个或更多竞争者。作者试图填补这一空白，探索共同所有权在多企业背景下如何改变市场进入的时间安排与竞争结构，特别是其可能产生的非线性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序贯进入博弈理论、共同所有权内部化理论、实物期权理论、竞赛理论（contest theory）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建三家企业面对随机需求演化的行业模型，企业进入和产出决策内化对竞争对手的影响，求解均衡并分析共同所有权程度变化对进入时机和竞争强度的影响。
AI.findings: （1）均衡呈现"手风琴效应"：共同所有权软化最后进入、加剧双寡头阶段竞争、延缓首次市场进入，降低整体市场活力；（2）与两企业行业不同，三企业行业中在期权价值足够高时，双寡头阶段会出现协调均衡；（3）该协调均衡的竞赛式动态能够加速首次进入并提升社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将共同所有权研究从两企业扩展到三企业行业，揭示了多企业情境下共同所有权可能导致协调均衡而非简单竞争弱化的新机制，丰富了共同所有权与市场进入理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估共同所有权对市场动态和福利的影响提供理论依据，特别是在多企业竞争行业中，共同所有权的作用可能并非单向的负面影响，而是存在复杂的情境依赖效应。

title: From Reactive Alerts to Predictive Whale Avoidance: Integrating Live AIS, Environmental Indicators, and Whale Reports into a Real-Time Collision-risk System

detail.title: From Reactive Alerts to Predictive Whale Avoidance: Integrating Live AIS, Environmental Indicators, and Whale Reports into a Real-Time Collision-risk System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: My father recommended that I do and look into this as a project as it is something I am interested in.

detail.abstract: Whale-vessel collisions remain a major conservation concern where shipping routes overlap with whale feeding, migration, and resting habitat. Existing protection systems often depend on observations made after whales have already entered areas of vessel traffic, while ecological forecasts and vessel-monitoring tools are frequently managed separately. This study presents AI Marine Sentinel, a deployed decision-support prototype that combines live Automatic Identification System (AIS) vessel data, NOAA sea-surface temperature retrieved through Google Earth Engine, NOAA buoy observations when available, bathymetric habitat context, historical whale records, and recent user reports. A transparent heuristic model calculates environmental suitability, relative whale likelihood, and relative collision risk. Geodesic distance calculations generate advisory zones, recommend speeds of 10 knots in high-risk areas, and evaluate compliance among eligible live vessels. Missing inputs are excluded and remaining weights are renormalized when sufficient data remain. Calculations, source states, effective weights, zone geometry, and compliance counts are logged to BigQuery for reproducibility. Production testing confirmed live AIS synchronization across backend records, frontend state, and map markers, successful Earth Engine retrieval of NOAA OISST values, and dynamic riskzone generation. The system is operational as a real-time prototype, but its manually selected weights have not yet been calibrated against an independent set of confirmed whale observations. Its outputs should therefore be interpreted as transparent prioritization indices rather than validated probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI Marine Sentinel，一个部署的决策支持原型系统，用于减少鲸鱼-船只碰撞风险。系统整合了实时AIS船舶数据、NOAA海表温度、水深栖息地背景、历史鲸鱼记录和用户报告，通过透明启发式模型计算环境适宜性、鲸鱼相对可能性和相对碰撞风险，并生成建议航速和合规评估。系统已在生产环境中测试，但权重尚未通过独立数据校准。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合多源实时数据（AIS、遥感、环境数据等）的决策支持系统，以实时评估和缓解鲸鱼-船只碰撞风险？
AI.motivation: 现有鲸鱼保护系统往往在鲸鱼已进入航道后才进行观测，缺乏事前预警能力；同时生态预报和船舶监控工具通常分开管理，缺乏整合。需要一种综合性的实时决策支持系统来弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 启发式模型（heuristic model）；环境适宜性评估；风险优先排序框架
AI.method: 系统整合AIS实时船舶数据、Google Earth Engine获取的NOAA OISST海表温度、NOAA浮标观测、水深栖息地数据、历史鲸鱼记录和用户报告。采用透明启发式模型计算环境适宜性、鲸鱼相对可能性和相对碰撞风险；使用测地线距离计算生成建议区域；在缺失输入时进行权重重新归一化；将计算过程和状态记录到BigQuery以确保可复现性。
AI.findings: 生产测试确认了系统功能正常：实时AIS同步、Earth Engine NOAA数据检索、动态风险区生成均成功运行。系统作为实时原型已投入使用，但其手动选择权重尚未通过独立鲸鱼观测数据校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将生态预测与船舶监控整合在一起的实时决策支持框架，展示了多源异构数据（AIS、遥感、浮标、历史记录）融合用于风险管理的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个已部署的、可运行的实时原型系统，能够生成可解释的风险优先排序指标、建议航速和合规评估，并确保计算过程的可复现性（BigQuery日志）。

title: “ImpactAlign: A Policy Visualization Framework for Reproducible SDG Benchmarking and Institutional Governance Clarity”

detail.title: “ImpactAlign: A Policy Visualization Framework for Reproducible SDG Benchmarking and Institutional Governance Clarity”

detail.abstract:
This concept note introduces ImpactAlign, a policy visualization framework designed to strengthen reproducibility and transparency in Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) benchmarking. The framework responds to a persistent challenge in global research governance: the fragmentation between policy directives and methodological execution. By embedding governance schematics into a reproducible flowchart, ImpactAlign bridges this gap, offering institutions a clear pathway from strategic intent to measurable outcomes. 

Concept Note 2 emphasizes the visualization dimension, presenting a governance-oriented flowchart (Figure 1) that integrates national directives, institutional policies, and methodological pathways. The sequential mapping illustrates how directives are operationalized through data collection, normalization, and benchmarking, culminating in outputs that are transparent, auditable, and globally comparable. This visualization responds directly to SSRN reviewers' emphasis on clarity, governance diagrams, and reproducibility.

 The framework's expected outcomes include enhanced reproducibility through schema-driven workflows, transparent benchmarking supported by reviewer-friendly templates and dashboards, and increased institutional recognition in international forums. By aligning outputs with UN SDG Academy guidelines and open science standards, ImpactAlign strengthens institutional accountability while advancing visibility within the global SDG ecosystem. 

Ultimately, ImpactAlign contributes to the standardization of SDG benchmarking by offering a reproducible, policy-driven visualization tool. Its adoption enables institutions to move beyond fragmented reporting toward coherent, transparent, and globally recognized contributions to sustainable development.

AI.tldr: ImpactAlign是一个政策可视化框架，旨在通过可复现的流程图弥合政策指令与方法论执行之间的鸿沟，增强可持续发展目标（SDG）基准测评的透明度和可复现性，使机构能够从战略意图清晰过渡到可衡量的成果。
AI.research_question: 如何通过政策可视化框架来弥合全球研究治理中政策指令与方法论执行之间的碎片化脱节，从而增强SDG基准测评的可复现性和透明度？
AI.motivation: 全球研究治理中存在一个持续挑战：政策指令与方法论执行之间相互割裂（fragmentation），导致SDG基准测评缺乏可复现性和透明度。SSRN审稿人强调需要清晰的治理图示和可复现性，这构成了开发该框架的直接动因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于治理图示（governance schematics）与可复现流程图（reproducible flowchart）的理论框架，结合UN SDG Academy指南及开放科学标准（open science standards）作为理论支撑。
AI.method: 提出一种治理导向的流程图（governance-oriented flowchart）方法，通过顺序映射（sequential mapping）将国家指令、制度政策和方法论路径整合，展示指令如何通过数据收集、标准化和基准测评被操作化。
AI.findings: 该框架的预期成果包括：通过模式驱动工作流增强可复现性；通过审稿人友好型模板和仪表盘支持透明基准测评；提升机构在国际论坛中的认可度；增强机构问责制并提升其在全球SDG生态系统中的可见性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SDG基准测评的标准化提供了理论贡献：提出了一个将政策指令与执行方法系统性整合的可视化框架，弥合了政策-执行之间的理论鸿沟，推动了从碎片化报告向连贯透明报告转化的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构提供了一种可复用的、政策驱动的可视化工具，帮助其实现透明、可审计、全球可比的SDG基准测评输出，并提升在国际论坛中的制度认可度与问责能力。

title: Empirical Predictability Limits of Financial Markets via Correlated-Decorrelated Structure Function Decomposition: A Departure from Atmospheric Turbulence Theory Draft preprint -CPE research series
affiliations: Independent Quantitative Researcher

detail.title: Empirical Predictability Limits of Financial Markets via Correlated-Decorrelated Structure Function Decomposition: A Departure from Atmospheric Turbulence Theory Draft preprint -CPE research series
detail.abstract: Theoretical predictability limits of the atmosphere have been derived, in prior work by the author and others, from a multifractal cascade formalism in which the correlated and decorrelated components of a turbulent field’s polyspectrum are tracked as a function of lead time, with the predictability limit defined as the time at which correlated energy falls to a fixed fraction of total energy (Ramanathan et al., 2019; Ramanathan & Satyanarayana, 2019, 2021). This paper investig‐ ates whether the same formalism transfers to financial markets. We show that it does not transfer directly: financial return/price-increment fields are empirically conservative (Hurst-type nonconservation exponent H ≈ 0), which collapses the moment-scaling relationship (ξ(q) = qH − K(qη) + qK(η)) that the atmospheric derivation depends on, and removes the spatial dimension (and with it, the entire generalized-scale-invariance anisotropy apparatus — sphero-scale, aspect ratio, vertical stratification exponent) that the atmospheric formula’s lead-time dependence is built on. We therefore abandon the parametric route and construct the correlated and decorrel‐ ated structure functions directly and empirically, defining the predictability limit operationally as the lag at which they are equal, and — going further — treating the full gap between them as a function of lag as the object of interest rather than a single crossing time. Applied to a raw (untransformed) multi-asset universe spanning equities, commodities, crypto, rates, FX, and volatility, this reveals that the correlated fraction of the moment budget is bounded within an instrument-specific range across the entire 300-trading-day lag window tested — never reaching full correlation or full decorrelation, unlike the atmospheric picture’s terminal state. But the shape of that boundedness is not uniform, and is not uniformly unlike the atmosphere either: classifying instruments by how many times their correlated and decorrelated components swap dominance reveals three distinct regimes. A minority of instruments (Treasury bonds and a few sector ETFs) remain correlation-dominant for the entire year tested, never crossing into decorrel‐ ation at all. One instrument (VIX) shows, at typical (q=2) moment order, a single clean transition that closely resembles the atmospheric formalism’s own monotonic picture, just plateauing at a bound rather than reaching zero — though this resemblance disappears at higher moment order (q=4), where VIX’s extreme fluctuations show the same repeated-crossing behavior as everything else. The majority of equities and Bitcoin show that repeated-crossing behavior throughout: pre‐ dictability that comes and goes in discrete, recurring “pockets” at specific lags rather than decaying once and staying gone. A pocket at approximately 21–24 trading days recurs across most equities tested; a second pocket near 252 trading days (one calendar year) is prominent for SPY specifically, and coincides with the strongest validated-signal concentration independently found for SPY by the authors’ unrelated Conditional Probability of Exceedance (CPE) framework — a nonparametric methodology sharing no assumptions with the structure-function approach used here. We argue this cross-method convergence, together with the observed asset-class and moment-order-dependent heterogeneity in crossing behavior, supports treating the pocket struc‐ ture as a genuine, economically meaningful feature of market structure for the instruments that show it, rather than an artifact of either method or a universal law applying uniformly across all instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了大气可预测性极限的多重分形级联形式体系是否可直接迁移至金融市场，发现不能直接迁移（金融收益场是保守的，H≈0，且缺乏空间维度）。因此作者放弃参数化路径，直接经验性地构造相关与去相关结构函数，将预测性极限定义为两者相等的滞后时间，并进一步将两者之间的完整差距作为lag的函数来研究。应用于跨资产原始数据后发现，相关能量份额在整个300交易日窗口内被限定在特定范围内，且根据相关/去相关成分主导权交换次数可识别出三种不同机制：少数工具（国债、部分板块ETF）保持相关主导；VIX在q=2时呈现单一干净转换（类似大气图景）；大多数股票和比特币呈现反复交叉的"口袋"式可预测性。约21-24个交易日的口袋在多数股票中重现，SPY在约252个交易日处出现第二个口袋，与该文无关的CPE框架独立发现的信号集中位置吻合，支持将口袋结构视为真实的经济意义特征。
AI.research_question: 大气可预测性极限的多重分形级联形式体系能否迁移到金融市场？如果不能直接迁移，应如何构建金融市场中的可预测性极限度量，以及金融市场中各资产的可预测性结构呈现何种特征？
AI.motivation: 作者此前已建立基于多重分形级联形式体系的大气可预测性极限理论（追踪湍流场的相关与去相关谱分量作为提前时间的函数），本文旨在探讨该形式体系能否同样适用于金融市场，并探索金融市场可预测性的本质结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重分形级联形式体系（multifractal cascade formalism）、广义尺度不变性各向异性框架（generalized scale invariance anisotropy）、矩标度关系（moment-scaling relationship ξ(q) = qH − K(qη) + qK(η)）、结构函数方法、条件超越概率（CPE）框架
AI.method: 放弃参数化路线，直接经验性地构造金融收益/价格增量场的相关与去相关结构函数，定义预测性极限为两者相等的滞后（lag），并将两者之间随lag变化的完整差距作为研究对象。应用于跨多资产类别（股票、商品、加密、利率、外汇、波动率）的原始未变换数据，在300个交易日的滞后窗口内进行分类分析。
AI.findings: 金融收益场是保守的（H≈0），使大气推导所依赖的矩标度关系失效，且缺乏空间维度使各向异性装置无法迁移。经验方法显示相关能量份额在300日窗口内被限定在工具特定的范围内，从不达到完全相关或完全去相关。按主导权交换次数可分为三种机制：（1）少数工具（国债、部分板块ETF）全年保持相关主导；（2）VIX在q=2时呈现单一干净转换，类似大气单调图景（但停在界限处而非归零），在q=4时消失；（3）大多数股票和比特币呈现反复交叉的"口袋"式行为。约21-24个交易日的口袋在多数股票中重现，SPY在约252日处有第二个口袋，与该文无关的CPE框架独立发现的信号集中位置吻合。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明大气多重分形级联可预测性形式体系不能直接迁移至金融市场，揭示了金融场的保守特性（H≈0）和缺乏空间维度对理论迁移的根本性障碍；将预测性极限从单点交叉时间推广为滞后时间的完整函数（相关性差距曲线），为可预测性研究提供了更丰富的理论视角；识别出三种不同的可预测性交叉机制，表明金融市场可预测性并非普遍单调衰减，而是具有资产类别和矩阶依赖的异质性结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 发现了在约21-24个交易日和约252个交易日（一年）处重复出现的可预测性"口袋"，且SPY在252日处的口袋与独立CPE框架发现的信号集中位置一致，为实际交易策略的时间选择提供了参考；提出了跨方法收敛的证据支持口袋结构的经济真实性；为不同资产类别提供了可预测性结构的分类画像（债券/ETF始终相关主导，VIX在低阶矩上有类似大气的单一转换，股票/比特币呈现反复口袋）。

title:
Allocative Gains, Welfare Losses? 
Polarizing Effects of Disclosing Greenness
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School, University of Rochester - Simon Business School and The Chinese University of Hong Kong Business School

detail.title:
Allocative Gains, Welfare Losses? 
Polarizing Effects of Disclosing Greenness
detail.abstract: We study how green disclosure shapes portfolios and green investment. Disclosure polarizes shareholders and greenness outcomes: green investors concentrate in green firms and push them to become greener, while brown firms are held by less-green investors and reduce greenness. Because brown firms typically have cheaper opportunities to increase greenness, this sorting reduces aggregate greenness and imposes an externality cost despite improving allocative efficiency. Disclosure alone is not always welfare-improving and is complementary to externality-correcting policies such as carbon pricing. Welfare-maximizing managers overdisclose because they internalize disclosure's allocative gain but not its externality cost; price-maximizing managers can deliver higher welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究绿色信息披露如何影响投资者组合配置与绿色投资。研究发现，信息披露导致股东与绿色程度出现极化：绿色投资者集中于绿色企业并推动其变得更绿，而棕色企业由不那么绿色的投资者持有并降低绿色程度。由于棕色企业通常有更便宜的绿色化机会，这种分类效应降低了总体绿色程度并产生外部性成本，尽管提升了配置效率。信息披露本身并非总是福利改进的，需要与碳定价等矫正外部性的政策互补。福利最大化的管理者会过度披露（因其只内化配置收益而不内化外部性成本），而价格最大化的管理者可能带来更高福利。
AI.research_question: 绿色信息披露如何影响投资者组合配置与绿色投资，以及信息披露对社会福利的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注信息披露对资产定价和公司披露行为的影响，但对信息披露如何通过投资者分类（sorting）效应影响绿色投资总量及其福利后果缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者偏好异质性下的投资组合选择理论、分类匹配理论、以及外部性理论构建模型。
AI.method: 理论建模（分析性模型），刻画投资者在绿色与棕色企业间的组合配置决策，以及企业绿色化决策与管理者披露策略的均衡。
AI.findings: （1）信息披露导致股东与绿色程度极化：绿色投资者集中于绿色企业，棕色企业由偏棕投资者持有；（2）该分类使棕色企业（通常绿色化成本更低）减少绿色投资，降低总体绿色程度并产生外部性成本；（3）信息披露单独实施并非总是福利改进，需与碳定价等政策互补；（4）福利最大化管理者倾向过度披露，价格最大化管理者可能带来更高福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示信息披露通过投资者分类渠道对绿色投资总量与福利产生负面影响，挑战了信息披露必然改善福利的传统观点；并将信息披露政策与外部性矫正政策（如碳定价）的互补关系纳入统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者在设计绿色信息披露要求时提供政策参考：单独依赖披露可能不够，需配合碳定价等外部性矫正工具；同时为企业管理者选择最优披露策略提供理论依据。

title: Compression of the Variance Risk Premium: Demand Pressure or a Repricing of Variance Carry?
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Charlotte and University of North Carolina at Charlotte

detail.title: Compression of the Variance Risk Premium: Demand Pressure or a Repricing of Variance Carry?
detail.abstract: Systematic call-overwriting through option-based ETFs has grown into a large one-sided supply of short volatility, inviting a demand-pressure interpretation in which dealer inventory constraints compress compensation where the flow lands. We test this reading with an exact discrete-time decomposition of covered-call returns into passive equity, active equity, and delta-hedged short-call components, with the short call split further into gamma, vega, and residual channels and with explicit treatment of ETF cash distributions. The gamma channel is variance carry in realized form, and dividing it by ex-ante implied variance prices the carry in each market, at each strike, at each date. Across fifty strategies on SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD, and TLT over 2010 through 2026, the price declines significantly on four of the five underlyings, spread across strikes and as strong on IWM, outside the overwrite footprint, as on the index leaders. Offsetting drift in the residual channel masks the decline in aggregate covered-call returns. A single level factor carries each surface, the five prices share a common component of half to three-fifths of their variation that survives detrending, and Treasury carry decouples and reprices upward in the 2022 through 2024 rates regime. The evidence rejects a strike-local demand-pressure channel and supports a broad repricing of variance carry, without excluding declining intermediation frictions within the equity complex.

AI.tldr: 本文通过精确的离散时间分解方法，将备兑看涨期权（covered-call）收益分解为被动股权、主动股权和Delta对冲的空头看涨期权三个部分，进一步将空头看涨部分拆分至gamma、vega和残差渠道。研究发现，在2010至2026年间，SPY、QQQ、IWM、GLD和TLT五种标的上的五十种策略中，gamma渠道（即已实现方差利差）的价格在五种标的中的四种上显著下降，且该下降广泛分布于各执行价格。证据拒绝了局部需求压力（strike-local demand-pressure）的解释，支持方差利差（variance carry）的广泛重新定价，同时不排除权益类资产中中介摩擦（intermediation frictions）下降的影响。
AI.research_question: 通过期权型ETF的系统性看涨期权改写（call-overwriting）形成的空头波动率单边供给，其需求压力传导机制如何影响方差利差（variance carry）的定价？具体而言，期权改写流量的落点（strike、标的等）是否决定价格压缩的程度，抑或存在更广泛的重新定价机制？
AI.motivation: 期权型ETF的看涨期权改写已成为大规模的、单边的空头波动率供给来源，这为检验需求压力解释（dealer inventory constraints）提供了独特的自然实验情境。此前的文献多关注整体收益，而缺乏对覆盖式看涨期权收益内部各组成部分的精确分解，因此难以识别价格压缩的具体来源与传导渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求压力理论（demand-pressure theory）：交易商库存约束压缩流动性供给侧的补偿；方差利差定价理论（variance carry pricing）：gamma渠道对应已实现方差利差，与事前隐含方差之比定价利差。
AI.method: 离散时间精确分解方法：将备兑看涨收益分解为被动股权、主动股权和Delta对冲空头看涨组成部分；空头看涨部分进一步拆分为gamma、vega和残差渠道；明确处理ETF现金分配。以gamma渠道除以事前隐含方差来定价每个市场、每个执行价格、每个日期的利差。
AI.findings: （1）2010至2026年间，五种标的的五十种策略中，四种标的的利差价格显著下降，且广泛分布于各执行价格；（2）IWM（覆盖范围之外的标的）上的下降与指数龙头（SPY、QQQ）同样强劲；（3）残差渠道的漂移效应掩盖了总体备兑收益的下降；（4）单一水平因子承载每个表面，五种价格共享一半至五分之三的共同成分，且在去趋势后依然存在；（5）美国国债利差在2022至2024年利率体制中解耦并重新上行定价。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）拒绝了局部（strike-specific）需求压力假说，为理解期权改写流量的价格影响机制提供了新的经验证据；（2）支持方差利差的广泛重新定价假说，表明单一共同因子主导各表面定价；（3）为中介摩擦下降假说提供了间接证据支持。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为期权改写策略的参与者（ETF发行商、期权做市商）提供了各标的、各执行价格上方差利差定价的动态图谱；（2）揭示了总体备兑收益中残差渠道对利差下降的掩盖效应，有助于投资者更精确地识别备兑策略的真实风险收益来源；（3）对2022-2024年利率体制下国债利差与权益利差解耦的现象提供了实证洞察。

title: The Architecture of Liquidity: Certainty and Immediacy in European Electronic Bond Markets
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University - Edinburgh Business School, Erasmus Research Institute of Management (ERIM), Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics, University of Oxford - Said Business School and Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: The Architecture of Liquidity: Certainty and Immediacy in European Electronic Bond Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare to have no conflicting interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by UKRI ISCF Industrial Challenge, through the UK Industrial Decarbonisation Research and Innovation Centre (IDRIC) award number: EP/V027050/1, MIP 3.3 and MIP 3.6 under the Industrial Decarbonisation Challenge (IDC).

detail.abstract: In electronic request-for-quote (RFQ) markets, liquidity is observed through both execution probability and time-to-trade, each shaped by market design. We show theoretically that price conditions these two margins jointly, but also that market architecture is fundamental to liquidity. Empirically, using MarketAxess data for European corporate bonds, we estimate a mixed cure model with residual inclusion to address endogenous price formation. Our findings indicate that price is an endogenous liquidity attribute and that RFQ design choices materially affect both execution likelihood and speed, with clear implications for structuring trades to achieve faster and more certain outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电子询价（RFQ）市场中流动性的两个维度——执行概率与成交时间，理论上证明价格条件会共同影响这两个维度，且市场架构对流动性至关重要。基于MarketAxess欧洲公司债券数据的实证分析，采用带剩余包含项的混合治愈模型处理内生价格形成问题，发现价格是内生流动性属性，RFQ设计选择显著影响执行概率和速度。
AI.research_question: 电子RFQ市场中，价格条件和市场架构设计如何共同影响流动性的两个维度（执行概率与成交时间）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将流动性视为单一维度，未充分考虑价格形成的内生性以及市场设计对执行概率和成交速度的双重影响。本研究旨在从理论和实证两个层面揭示这些关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性双边框架：执行概率与成交时间联合由价格和市场架构决定；内生价格形成理论。
AI.method: 理论建模分析价格、市场设计与流动性的关系；实证采用混合治愈模型（mixed cure model）并引入剩余包含（residual inclusion）方法，基于MarketAxess欧洲公司债券数据进行估计，处理价格形成的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 价格是内生流动性属性；RFQ设计选择（市场架构）对执行概率和成交速度均有显著影响；价格条件共同影响执行概率和成交时间两个流动性维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将流动性解构为执行概率与时间两个维度，揭示了价格的内生性对流动性的影响；在理论上阐明了市场架构对流动性的基础性作用，为RFQ市场设计研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易者在RFQ市场中设计交易结构以实现更快、更确定成交提供实操指引；为交易所和平台设计者优化RFQ市场架构提供实证依据。

title: How Immigration Shapes Politics: Populism, Labor Movements, and Political Preferences in Brazil
affiliations: , Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics and Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV)

detail.title: How Immigration Shapes Politics: Populism, Labor Movements, and Political Preferences in Brazil
detail.abstract: This paper examines how European immigration during the Age of Mass Migration (1886-1920) shaped long-run political preferences in Brazil. While existing research links the emergence of labor-based politics in Latin America to industrialization and urban working-class growth, we argue that earlier demographic changes induced by mass migration also played an important role. Using an instrumental-variable strategy that exploits the interaction between aggregate immigration inflows and the expansion of São Paulo's railway network, we show that municipalities with a larger share of European immigrants were more likely to support labor-oriented candidates during Brazil's democratic interregnum (1945-1964). We also show suggestive evidence that the political effects of immigration persisted after Brazil's return to democracy in 1985. The findings suggest that the consequences of mass migration extended beyond economic development and contributed to the long-run formation of local political preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文利用工具变量策略（移民流入与圣保罗铁路网扩张的交互项），发现1886-1920年欧洲移民占比更高的巴西城市，在1945-1964年民主间歇期更可能支持劳工导向候选人，且该政治影响在1985年巴西恢复民主后仍持续存在。这表明大规模移民不仅影响经济发展，还塑造了地方长期政治偏好。
AI.research_question: 大规模欧洲移民如何塑造巴西长期（1945-1964年及1985年后）的地方政治偏好？
AI.motivation: 已有研究将拉美劳工政治的出现归因于工业化和城市工人阶级增长，但忽视了更早期由大规模移民引起的人口结构变化对政治形成的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口迁移的政治经济学；移民对长期政治偏好形成的影响机制；劳工政治起源理论。
AI.method: 工具变量法（IV）：利用总体移民流入与圣保罗铁路网扩张的交互项作为工具变量；实证分析1945-1964年民主间歇期及1985年后巴西地方选举的政治偏好。
AI.findings: 欧洲移民占比更高的城市更可能支持劳工导向候选人；该政治效应在1945-1964年民主间歇期显著，并在1985年巴西恢复民主后仍有持续性证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 将移民因素纳入拉美劳工政治起源的分析框架，表明大规模移民的历史影响超越经济发展范畴，对政治制度的长期形成具有独立贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解巴西及拉美地区移民历史与当代政治格局的关联提供了实证依据，有助于政策制定者认识人口迁移的长期社会政治后果。

title: Wage Advantage and Selection of Indian Immigrants in the US
affiliations: Rutgers University, New Brunswick - Department of Economics

detail.title: Wage Advantage and Selection of Indian Immigrants in the US
detail.abstract: I study the wage gap between Indian immigrants in the United States and residents of India. Using data from the 2011 and 2021 American Community Surveys and India's Employment-Unemployment Survey (2011-12) and Periodic Labour Force Survey (2020-21), I adjust the wage density of residents of India to reflect the observable characteristics of Indian immigrants in the US applying the DiNardo, Fortin, and Lemieux (1995) reweighting method. I find that differences in skills explain 24 to 36 percent of the wage gap for males and 37 to 48 percent for females. This indicates a difference in skills selection between male and female migrants or selection into labor force participation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用美国社区调查和印度劳动力调查数据，通过DFL再权重方法调整印度居民工资密度以匹配美国印度移民的可观测特征，发现技能差异可以解释24-36%（男性）和37-48%（女性）的美印工资差距，表明男女移民在技能选择或劳动力参与方面存在差异。
AI.research_question: 美国印度移民与印度本土居民之间的工资差距中，有多少可以由可观测的技能特征差异来解释？男女之间是否存在不同的技能选择效应？
AI.motivation: 理解国际移民工资差距的来源，特别是技能选择在解释跨国工资差异中的作用，以及性别差异如何影响移民的技能选择和工资结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民技能选择理论；工资分解方法（DiNardo, Fortin, and Lemieux, 1995再权重法）；劳动力参与选择理论
AI.method: 使用2011和2021年美国社区调查数据，以及印度2011-12年就业-失业调查和2020-21年定期劳动力调查数据，应用DFL（1995）再权重方法调整印度居民工资密度以匹配美国印度移民的可观测特征。
AI.findings: 技能差异解释了男性工资差距的24-36%，女性工资差距的37-48%；剩余的工资差距无法由可观测技能解释，且男女之间存在显著差异，表明男性与女性移民在技能选择或劳动力参与选择上存在不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 为移民技能选择理论提供了来自印度-美国双向劳动力市场的实证证据；拓展了DFL分解方法在跨国工资比较中的应用；揭示了性别差异在移民技能选择中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供参考，表明技能筛选机制在不同性别群体中的作用存在差异；有助于理解国际劳动力市场中技能流动与工资回报的关系。

title: Negotiating Clean Energy: Women’s Bargaining Power and the impact of energy transition subsidy
affiliations: ETH Zürich and ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich

detail.title: Negotiating Clean Energy: Women’s Bargaining Power and the impact of energy transition subsidy
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates India’s Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), the world’s largest LPG subsidy program. Using a difference-in-difference approach with propensity score matching, we examine how intra-household decision-making and local fuel availability modulate policy effectiveness. Results show that PMUY increased LPG adoption, with impacts notably amplified in households where women have greater bargaining power but subdued in households with local fuel availability. These findings highlight that successful energy transitions depend on addressing intra-household decision-making and economic barriers. Our study provides critical insights for designing effective clean cooking interventions in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了印度规模最大的液化石油气（LPG）补贴项目——Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana（PMUY）的政策效果。采用倾向得分匹配结合双重差分法，研究发现PMUY显著提高了LPG采用率，且该效应在女性议价能力更强的家庭中更为显著，而在当地燃料可得性较高的地区效应被削弱。
AI.research_question: 家庭内部决策过程（女性议价能力）和当地燃料可得性如何调节PMUY这一全球最大LPG补贴项目的政策效果？
AI.motivation: 清洁能源转型是发展中国家的重要政策目标，但补贴项目的有效性受到多种因素的制约。理解家庭内部决策和当地能源环境如何影响政策效果，对于设计更有效的清洁烹饪干预措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭内部议价理论（intra-household bargaining）、能源阶梯/燃料可得性理论
AI.method: 倾向得分匹配（Propensity Score Matching）+ 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）
AI.findings: （1）PMUY显著提高了LPG采用率；（2）在女性拥有更高议价能力的家庭中，政策效果被显著放大；（3）在本地燃料（如薪柴等）可得性较高的地区，政策效果被削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭内部决策动态（性别议价能力）引入清洁能源政策评估框架，揭示了补贴政策效果的条件性，丰富了能源转型与家庭决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家设计清洁烹饪干预措施提供实证依据，强调政策制定需同时关注家庭内部性别平等和地区燃料可得性等结构性障碍。

title: Telework Adoption and Mobility-Related Carbon Emissions: Causal Evidence from France
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Savoie Mont Blanc, University of Savoy and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Telework Adoption and Mobility-Related Carbon Emissions: Causal Evidence from France
detail.abstract: Demand-side measures are increasingly recognized as an essential component of climate mitigation, yet credible causal evidence on their effectiveness remains limited. Teleworking is widely viewed as a promising ``Avoid'' strategy because it reduces the need for commuting, but its net environmental impact remains uncertain due to behavioural rebound effects and the non-random adoption of remote work. Using a unique two-period panel survey of 3,530 French workers observed before and after the widespread diffusion of teleworking, we estimate the causal effect of telework adoption on annual mobility-related greenhouse gas emissions. Identification relies on a doubly robust difference-in-differences estimator that combines outcome regression and propensity-score weighting to account for selective treatment adoption. We find that teleworking reduces annual mobility-related emissions by approximately 270-300 kgCO2e per treated worker. These reductions are driven almost entirely by lower commuting emissions, while additional non-work travel offsets only a small share of the initial gains. The estimated effects remain stable across alternative estimators and robustness checks. Our results provide causal evidence that teleworking constitutes an effective demand-side mitigation strategy for workers able to adopt it. At the same time, because teleworkable jobs remain concentrated among highly skilled occupations, the aggregate mitigation potential and distributional consequences of teleworking depend critically on its unequal feasibility across sectors of the labour market.

AI.tldr: 本文利用法国3530名工人在远程办公大规模普及前后两期面板调查数据，采用双重稳健双重差分估计器，发现远程办公使每位受雇工人的年出行相关温室气体排放减少约270-300 kgCO2e，减排主要由通勤排放降低驱动，非工作出行的反弹效应仅抵消一小部分。但远程办公岗位集中于高技能职业，其总体减排潜力和分配后果受制于劳动力市场的不平等可行性。
AI.research_question: 远程办公的采纳对工人年出行相关温室气体排放的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 需求侧措施对气候减缓的重要性日益被认可，但对其有效性的可信因果证据仍然有限。远程办公被视为有前景的"规避"策略，但由于行为反弹效应和远程工作的非随机采纳，其净环境影响仍不确定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求侧气候减缓理论；"规避"（Avoid）策略框架；行为反弹效应理论
AI.method: 利用法国3530名工人在远程办公大规模普及前后的两期面板调查数据，采用双重稳健双重差分估计器（结合结果回归与倾向得分加权）来识别远程办公采纳的因果效应，并控制选择性处理采纳问题。
AI.findings: 远程办公使每位被处理工人年出行相关排放减少约270-300 kgCO2e；减排几乎完全由通勤排放降低驱动，非工作出行仅抵消一小部分初始收益；估计结果在替代估计器和稳健性检验下保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了远程办公作为需求侧减缓策略有效性的因果证据，填补了该领域因果证据不足的空白；揭示了反弹效应对减排效果的影响有限，丰富了需求侧气候减缓理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了远程办公减排效果的可信因果估计，支持将远程办公纳入气候减缓政策工具；同时指出远程办公岗位集中于高技能职业，其分配后果和总体减排潜力取决于劳动力市场的结构性不平等，有助于政策设计时考虑公平性问题。

title: Cash Transfers and Local Prices

detail.title: Cash Transfers and Local Prices

keywords: cash transfers; local prices; inflation; general equilibrium; multilevel meta-analysis; robust variance estimation; publication bias. JEL codes: C12

detail.abstract: Cash transfers increase household purchasing power, but their effect on local prices depends on productive capacity, market integration, tradability, program saturation, and the speed at which supply can respond. This study presents a harmonized causal meta-analysis of 49 goods-price estimates nested within nine independent programs or experiments. The confirmatory estimand aggregates dependent outcomes within each program, incorporates an assumed within-study correlation, and applies restricted maximum likelihood with a modified Knapp-Hartung correction. The estimated average change in goods prices is 0.101 %, with a 95 % confidence interval from-0.030 % to 0.233 %. The result is nearly invariant to within-study correlations between 0 and 0.90. A three-level model that retains all 49 outcomes, estimates between-program and within-program heterogeneity, and uses CR2 small-sample inference yields a point estimate of-0.585 % and a 95 % interval from-2.274 % to 1.134 %. The wider interval shows that the precision of the aggregated estimate depends on an exceptionally informative price index and on compressing product-level heterogeneity. Egger, Begg, PET, PEESE, trim-and-fill, excess-significance tests, and selection models do not identify a systematic publication-bias pattern, although statistical power is limited with only nine independent clusters. A Bayesian model that jointly addresses dependence, heterogeneity, and outcome selection yields a median effect of 0.080 % and a 95 % credible interval from-0.645 % to 0.713 %. The evidence does not support generalized goodsprice inflation following cash transfers, but it remains compatible with larger responses in non-tradable services, perishable products, highly saturated interventions, and markets facing binding supply constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文对49个商品价格估计值（来自9个独立项目或实验）进行协调化因果元分析，采用多种统计方法（REML修正Knapp-Hartung、三水平模型、贝叶斯模型等）检验现金转移对当地商品价格的影响。平均价格变化估计为0.101%（95%CI: -0.030%～0.233%），证据不支持现金转移导致普遍的商品价格通胀，但可能与不可贸易服务、易腐产品、高饱和干预及供给约束市场的更大价格反应相容。
AI.research_question: 现金转移支付对当地商品价格的影响程度如何？是否存在普遍的商品价格通胀效应？
AI.motivation: 现金转移增加家庭购买力，但其对当地价格的影响取决于多种因素（生产能力、市场一体化、可贸易性、项目饱和度和供给响应速度），现有证据不一致，需要系统化的元分析来评估总体效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供需理论（购买力增加对价格的传导）、市场一体化理论、可贸易性理论、项目饱和度与供给弹性理论、元分析方法论（REML、多水平模型、贝叶斯模型、发表偏倚检测）
AI.method: 协调化因果元分析：49个商品价格估计值来自9个独立项目/实验；确认性估计量聚合各项目内的依赖结果，假设组内相关性，采用限制最大似然法（REML）配合修正的Knapp-Hartung校正；三水平模型保留全部49个结果，估计项目间与项目内异质性，使用CR2小样本推断；进行多种发表偏倚检验（Egger、Begg、PET、PEESE、trim-and-fill、超显著性检验、选择模型）；贝叶斯模型联合处理依赖、异质性和结果选择。
AI.findings: 平均商品价格变化为0.101%（95% CI: -0.030%～0.233%）；结果对0～0.90的组内相关性几乎不变；三水平模型点估计为-0.585%（95% CI: -2.274%～1.134%）；贝叶斯模型中位效应为0.080%（95% CrI: -0.645%～0.713%）；未发现系统性发表偏倚模式；证据不支持普遍的商品价格通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 方法上贡献了协调化因果元分析框架，展示了如何处理依赖结果、异质性和发表偏倚的多种方法比较；理论上澄清了现金转移与价格通胀的关系，表明总体效应接近于零但需考虑异质性情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据基础：现金转移在总体上不会引发普遍商品价格通胀；但在特定条件（非贸易服务、易腐品、高饱和度干预、供给约束市场）下仍需关注价格风险，建议根据市场特征设计现金转移项目。

title: Evidentiary Design and Cross-Border Monitoring in Frontier-AI Safety

detail.title: Evidentiary Design and Cross-Border Monitoring in Frontier-AI Safety
detail.abstract: This paper studies how evidentiary design mediates enforcement of minimum safety requirements in a two-country frontier-AI contest. Monitoring changes both the probability of an actionable evaluation and the precision of the resulting evidence. We show that cross-border information sharing can affect domestic AI safety non-monotonically, but the familiar single-test hump is not a robust policy prediction. Its shape depends on the legal rule used to aggregate adverse findings. Under an any-of-three-tests rule, independent and moderately correlated evaluations place domestic safety on a strictly declining path as foreign monitoring capacity expands. Under highly correlated testing, the smooth compliance continuation collapses: the developer problem becomes non-concave and fails global best-response validation, consistent with discrete or "bang-bang" adjustment rather than stable interior compliance. The central result is therefore institutional dependence. Pooling international evaluation capacity changes safety incentives only through the evidentiary rule, the dependence structure among tests, and the legal treatment of adverse findings. Full-dimensional equilibrium searches, unilateral-deviation checks, and appendix diagnostics support the reported monitoring equilibria. The quantitative exercises remain normalized and partially identified rather than predictive.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在两国前沿AI竞赛中，证据设计如何调节最低安全要求的执行。监测同时影响可行评估的概率和证据的精度。研究发现跨境信息共享对国内AI安全的影响是非单调的，但熟悉的单测试驼峰并非稳健的政策预测。其形状取决于汇总不利发现的法律规则。在"三检任一"规则下，独立和适度相关的评估使国内安全随外国监测能力扩张而严格下降。在高度相关的测试下，平滑合规延续崩溃：开发者问题变为非凹的，无法通过全局最佳反应验证，与离散或"开关"式调整而非稳定的内部合规一致。核心结论是制度依赖性。
AI.research_question: 在两国家前沿AI竞赛背景下，跨国监测能力的扩张如何通过证据设计与法律证据规则影响国内AI安全的最低安全要求执行？
AI.motivation: 随着前沿AI竞赛的激烈化，各国面临在竞争压力下执行最低安全要求的挑战。跨国信息共享可能影响国内AI安全激励，但其方向与幅度取决于复杂的制度细节，现有研究缺乏对证据设计、测试相关性及法律汇总规则如何交互影响安全执行的系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（两国竞赛框架）、机制设计（监测与证据精度）、非凹优化理论（开发者合规决策）、法律证据规则（多测试不利发现的汇总规则）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建两国前沿AI竞赛的博弈模型，分析监测概率与证据精度对开发者合规决策的影响。采用全维度均衡搜索、单边偏差检验和附录诊断来支持均衡结果。定量练习采用归一化与部分识别方法。
AI.findings: （1）跨境信息共享对国内AI安全的影响是非单调的，但单测试驼峰不是稳健的政策预测；（2）在"任何三项测试之一"规则下，独立与适度相关的评估使国内安全随外国监测能力扩张严格下降；（3）高度相关测试下，平滑合规延续崩溃，开发者问题变为非凹，出现"开关"式（bang-bang）调整而非稳定的内部合规；（4）核心结论是制度依赖性：跨国监测能力的整合仅通过证据规则、测试依赖结构和不利发现的法律处理来改变安全激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了证据设计在国际AI安全治理中的核心作用，指出政策预测的稳健性高度依赖制度细节（证据规则与测试相关性结构）。挑战了单测试驼峰作为通用政策启示的结论，提出了"制度依赖性"这一更精细的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国AI安全治理中的监测能力整合与信息共享政策提供了制度层面的设计启示，强调在选择证据汇总规则和测试依赖结构时需审慎考量其对国内安全激励的影响。

title: Billionaires: The Case for Taxing Puppies, a Note on Taxing the .01%

detail.title: Billionaires: The Case for Taxing Puppies, a Note on Taxing the .01%

keywords: Generational Benchmark Inheritance Regime JEL Classification: D31

detail.abstract: This brief note presents a street-level translation of certain ideas in the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) return decomposition and the biological dilution test applied to dynastic wealth transmission. By analyzing the multi-generational compounding of an average billionaire fortune held by an entirely passive beneficiary-modeled here as an ethically bred poodle-we demonstrate that the compound interest engine of the capital commons effortlessly outruns human reproduction and natural biological fragmentation. We argue that passive market returns (Beta in the sense of the return on the total stock market) represent a participation dividend generated by the nation's collective infrastructure, thus requiring a generational benchmark settlement to preserve a meritocratic republic, while active outperformance over a broad-based index of all the common stocks available ("Practical Alpha") should remain entirely exempt.

AI.tldr: 本文以一只"伦理培育的贵宾犬"作为完全被动受益人模型，运用CAPM收益分解和生物稀释检验，分析亿万富翁财富多代复利传承与人类繁衍之间的赛跑。研究发现资本复利引擎远超人口繁衍和自然生物稀释速度，据此提出：被动市场收益（Beta）应视为国家集体基础设施带来的参与红利，需通过代际基准结算来维护精英共和制；而主动超额收益（Practical Alpha）应完全免税。
AI.research_question: 在代际财富传承中，复利收益（Beta）与人类繁衍稀释速度孰快孰慢？被动资本收益应否承担代际社会责任？
AI.motivation: 代际财富不平等日益加剧，需要重新审视被动投资收益（Beta）的社会属性及其在财富传承中的作用，为资本收益征税提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM）收益分解；生物稀释检验（biological dilution test）；复利引擎理论
AI.method: 采用街头式（street-level）的比喻性分析，以"纯被动受益的贵宾犬"作为极端简化模型，模拟亿万富翁财富的多代复利增长与人类自然繁衍稀释的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）资本复利引擎的增速显著超过人类生殖繁衍率和生物财富稀释速度；2）被动市场收益（Beta）本质上是国家集体基础设施产生的"参与红利"；3）主动超额收益（Practical Alpha）则属于个人能力或运气的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CAPM收益分解逻辑创新性地引入代际财富公平讨论，提出"参与红利"概念，区分Beta与Alpha的社会属性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供代际基准结算（generational benchmark settlement）的政策框架，主张对被动Beta收益进行代际再分配，而对主动Alpha收益免税。

title: Optimal Dividend Policy under Global Warming
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Université de Rennes I and CREM

detail.title: Optimal Dividend Policy under Global Warming
detail.abstract: Global warming affects the payout policy of heat-sensitive firms by shortening their economic lifetime, thereby reducing the option value of retained cash and inducing earlier dividend distributions. A firm-specific heat-tolerance threshold determines when business activity ceases, translating the projected temperature trajectory into a finite operating horizon, and yielding a finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous version of the classical De Finetti dividend problem. We characterize the optimal dividend policy analytically and complement the analysis with numerical solutions of the associated HJB quasi-variational inequality. The optimal dividend barrier declines over time and converges to zero as climate-induced business termination approaches, reflecting the progressive loss of the option value of retained cash. The barrier increases with business risk and decreases with the discount rate, while its response to expected cash-flow growth is non-monotonic. We also analyze a one-time irreversible adaptation investment, showing that adaptation may be value-enhancing and that an optimal adaptation effort exists under mild cost conditions. Finally, extending the model to stochastic temperature dynamics shows that the declining dividend barrier is not an artifact of deterministic warming trajectories. Unlike in the deterministic model, firms may optimally retain positive cash reserves for distribution at climate-induced business termination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全球变暖如何通过缩短热敏感企业的经济寿命来影响其股利政策。全球变暖导致企业运营期缩短，降低了留存现金的期权价值，促使企业提前发放股利。作者将企业特有的耐热阈值转化为有限运营期限，构建了De Finetti股利问题的有限时域、非时间齐次版本，并解析刻画了最优股利政策，同时用数值方法求解相关HJB拟变分不等式。
AI.research_question: 全球变暖如何影响热敏感企业的股利支付政策？具体而言，气候变化导致的有限经营期限如何改变企业留存现金的期权价值，进而影响最优股利分配决策？
AI.motivation: 全球变暖对企业的财务决策（尤其是股利政策）的影响尚未得到充分研究。已有文献多关注气候风险对资产定价或资本结构的影响，但鲜有研究从企业生命周期的角度探讨全球变暖如何通过缩短经济寿命来改变企业的现金留存和股利分配决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典的De Finetti股利问题框架，结合实物期权理论（留存现金的期权价值）、最优控制理论（HJB方程与拟变分不等式）以及适应投资决策模型，构建了有限时域、时间非齐次的最优股利分配模型。
AI.method: 理论建模与解析推导为主，辅以数值求解：1) 将企业耐热阈值转化为有限经营期限；2) 建立并解析求解有限时域最优股利问题；3) 数值求解相应的HJB拟变分不等式；4) 扩展至一次性不可逆适应投资分析；5) 将确定性温度轨迹扩展为随机温度动态。
AI.findings: 1) 最优股利屏障随时间递减，并在气候导致的企业终止经营时收敛至零，反映留存现金期权价值的逐步丧失；2) 股利屏障随经营风险增加而上升，随贴现率增加而下降；3) 股利屏障对预期现金流增长率的响应呈非单调关系；4) 适当的适应投资具有增值效应，且在温和成本条件下存在最优适应努力水平；5) 在随机温度动态下，递减的股利屏障并非确定性变暖轨迹的产物，且企业可能在气候终止时保留正向现金储备用于最终分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展了De Finetti股利问题至有限时域、时间非齐次的情境，为新古典股利理论在气候风险背景下的应用提供了新视角；2) 将全球变暖与股利政策通过企业经济寿命这一机制连接起来，揭示了气候变化对企业财务决策的传导路径；3) 证明随机温度动态下结果的稳健性，排除结论对确定性假设的依赖。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为热敏感企业提供气候风险下的最优股利分配决策参考；2) 为企业评估适应投资（如降温技术改造）的价值和对冲策略提供分析框架；3) 有助于投资者和监管者理解气候风险对企业现金管理和股利支付行为的实际影响。

title: The Intent Gap: Artificial Intelligence, Prediction Markets, and the Collapse of Federal Manipulation Doctrine

detail.title: The Intent Gap: Artificial Intelligence, Prediction Markets, and the Collapse of Federal Manipulation Doctrine
detail.abstract: Prediction markets are now public infrastructure. Their prices are quoted in political analysis, cited by institutional investors, and used by policymakers as real-time probability signals for elections, economic events, and geopolitical crises. Documented wash trading exceeds twentyfive percent of volume on major platforms. AI trading systems-reinforcement learning agents, LLM-powered probability models, autonomous arbitrage bots-are proliferating in these markets. And the federal enforcement framework designed to protect market integrity cannot reach them, because every manipulation provision under the Commodity Exchange Act and federal securities laws requires proof of human intent that AI systems do not possess. This Article addresses that structural enforcement vacuum. It develops the first systematic taxonomy of AI manipulation risks specific to prediction markets-coordinated trading without communication, information asymmetry exploitation, and emergent manipulative behavior-and demonstrates that each defeats every existing doctrine at the intent element. It proposes upstream scienter: a liability framework that relocates the legally relevant intent inquiry from the moment of manipulation to the design and deployment decisions that made manipulation foreseeable. The framework includes a three-part liability test, a tiered safeguard structure calibrated to AI system risk, a compliance safe harbor, and a complete model rule suitable for CFTC adoption. It operates coherently across the SEC/CFTC jurisdictional divide. The analysis also identifies a problem that extends far beyond financial regulation: every intent-based legal doctrine-criminal mens rea, antitrust conspiracy, tort negligence-faces the same structural failure when AI agents replace human actors. Prediction market manipulation is the leading edge.

AI.tldr: 本文针对预测市场中AI系统操纵行为引发的监管真空问题，提出"上游意图"（upstream scienter）责任框架，将法律意图认定从操纵行为发生时点前移至AI系统的设计与部署决策阶段，并给出了适用于CFTC采纳的三部分责任测试和分层合规制度。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统（强化学习代理、LLM概率模型、自主套利机器人）大规模参与预测市场且现行联邦法律（CEA和证券法）的意图要件无法适用于无人类意图的AI操纵行为的背景下，应如何重构责任框架以填补执法真空？
AI.motivation: 预测市场已成为公共基础设施，其价格被广泛引用，但现有数据显示主要平台上超过25%的交易量涉嫌洗售交易（wash trading）。然而，联邦执法框架中所有操纵条款都要求证明人类意图，AI系统不具备这一要件，导致结构性执法真空。此外，这一问题已超越金融监管范畴，所有依赖意图要件的法律学说（刑法mens rea、反垄断共谋、侵权过失）都面临同样的结构性失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 依据《商品交易法》（CEA）和联邦证券法中的操纵责任条款及其"人类意图"要件分析，提出"上游意图"（upstream scienter）理论，将法律意图的认定从操纵行为发生时刻前移至使操纵可预见的设计与部署决策时刻。
AI.method: 本文采用法律教义学分析方法，首次系统构建预测市场中AI操纵风险的类型学分类——无沟通的协调交易（coordinated trading without communication）、信息不对称利用（information asymmetry exploitation）和涌现性操纵行为（emergent manipulative behavior），并逐一检验每类风险如何使现有所有操纵教义在意图要件上失效。在此基础上提出包含三部分责任测试、分层安全保障结构、合规安全港和完整示范规则的法律框架。
AI.findings: 研究发现：预测市场中AI操纵风险可系统划分为三大类型，每一类型均在意图要件上击败现有所有监管教义；"上游意图"框架可有效跨越SEC与CFTC的管辖权划分；该监管真空问题不仅限于预测市场，所有依赖意图要件的法律学说在AI代理取代人类行为者时都面临同样的结构性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次提出预测市场AI操纵风险的系统性类型学分类，并首创"上游意图"（upstream scienter）理论，将法律意图责任的重心从操纵行为时点前移至系统设计部署时点，为AI时代金融监管中的意图要件重构提供了理论框架，并指出这一问题对更广泛的意图基础法律学说（刑法、反垄断、侵权法）的普遍性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文提供了一个可直接供CFTC采纳的完整示范规则，包括三部分责任测试、依AI系统风险等级配置的分层安全保障体系、合规安全港机制，这些制度设计在SEC与CFTC管辖权分立下仍能协调运作，为监管机构和预测市场平台提供了可操作的执法与合规指引。

title: A Composite Multi-Dimensional Risk-Scoring Framework for Aerospace Supply Chains: Evidence from the Boeing 787 Program

detail.title: A Composite Multi-Dimensional Risk-Scoring Framework for Aerospace Supply Chains: Evidence from the Boeing 787 Program
detail.abstract: Commercial aerospace supply chains exhibit a distinctive risk structure: a small number of sole-source suppliers, often geographically concentrated, produce structurally critical components whose replacement requires multi-year regulatory re-certification. Existing supply chain risk-management tools assess these exposures in organizational silos: geophysical hazard, supplier financial health, export-control exposure, and logistics disruption are each analyzed by different functions using incommensurable metrics. This paper develops a composite, multi-dimensional risk-scoring framework that integrates nine risk dimensions into a single program-level index, and applies it to the Boeing 787 Dreamliner. Using a hand-constructed dataset of 28 suppliers, 31 geocoded production sites, 19 program dependencies, and 8 documented disruption events assembled from primary sources (SEC filings, FAA airworthiness directives, USGS and Japan Cabinet Office seismic hazard assessments, and OFAC sanctions data), the framework produces a Q1 2026 composite score of 65/100 (high risk) for the 787 program. The analysis surfaces two findings not visible to single-dimension methods: (1) five sole-source Tier 1 suppliers operate primary facilities within a single probabilistic seismic rupture zone (Nankai Trough, 70-80% probability of a M8+ event within 30 years), creating a correlated failure mode with an estimated 2-3 year recovery horizon; and (2) the aircraft's bleedless electrical architecture embeds a rare-earth-element processing dependency on a single country (China, 85-98% of relevant Nd/Dy processing) across more than 100 permanent-magnet motor systems, a dependency invisible at the commodity-tariff level of analysis. The framework demonstrates that cross-referencing geophysical, regulatory, financial, and material-chain data at the program level reveals concentrated, correlated exposures that sole-source registries and supplier self-reporting structurally understate. Implications for aerospace industrial-base policy and program-level risk monitoring are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个综合多维风险评分框架，将九个风险维度整合为单一项目级指数，并应用于波音787 Dreamliner。基于28家供应商、31个地理编码生产站点、19个项目依赖关系和8个记录在案的中断事件的原创数据集，该框架产生2026年第一季度综合评分65/100（高风险）。研究揭示了单一维度方法无法发现的两种相关风险：五个独家供应商位于南海海槽单一地震破裂带内，以及无引气电气架构对中国的稀土加工存在隐性依赖。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个综合性的多维风险评分框架，以在项目层面揭示商业航天供应链中被单一维度分析所掩盖的集中和相关性风险暴露？
AI.motivation: 现有供应链风险管理工具在组织孤岛中评估风险（地球物理灾害、供应商财务健康、出口管制、物流中断各自使用不可通约的指标），无法揭示跨维度的集中和相关风险暴露，尤其对商业航天这类具有独特风险结构（独家供应商、地理集中、多年监管再认证）的行业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合多维风险评分框架；耦合失效模式分析；供应链集中度与相关性风险理论
AI.method: 手工构建数据集（28家供应商、31个地理编码生产站点、19个项目依赖、8个记录的中断事件），来源包括SEC文件、FAA适航指令、USGS和日本内阁府地震灾害评估、OFAC制裁数据；将九个风险维度整合为单一项目级指数。
AI.findings: (1) 五个独家一级供应商的主要设施位于南海海槽单一概率地震破裂带内（30年内M8+事件概率70-80%），形成相关失效模式，恢复期估计2-3年；(2) 无引气电气架构在100多个永磁电机系统中嵌入对中国单一国家的稀土（Nd/Dy）加工依赖（85-98%），这种依赖在商品关税层面不可见。787项目2026年Q1综合评分为65/100（高风险）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在项目层面交叉参照地球物理、监管、财务和材料链数据能够揭示独家供应商登记册和供应商自我报告结构性低估的集中和相关风险暴露，扩展了供应链风险分析的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航天工业基础政策和项目级风险监控提供了可操作的分析框架，能够识别单一维度方法无法发现的耦合失效风险，帮助决策者进行更有效的风险管理和产业政策制定。

title: Beyond Arab-Jewish Reductionism: Broken Kinship, Political Visibility, and Exclusive Sovereignty in Palestine and Israel

detail.title: Beyond Arab-Jewish Reductionism: Broken Kinship, Political Visibility, and Exclusive Sovereignty in Palestine and Israel

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, professional, institutional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper. The study was conducted independently.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study did not involve human participants, patients, interviews, experiments, personal data, or case studies requiring consent. The research is based exclusively on publicly available historical, legal, and scholarly sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author within the Third Generation in International Relations Project.

detail.abstract: This article examines how legal and historical categories determine whose claims become visible in Palestine and Israel. It focuses on a recurrent argumentative move in which a limited fact, such as historical attachment, refuge, land purchase, military victory, or the conduct of political leaders, is treated as if it resolved the separate questions of sovereignty, property, return, or civilian rights. Drawing on Mandate records, legal instruments, Palestinian and Israeli or Jewish historiography, minority-community studies, and structured testing of counter-arguments, the article develops the Broken Kinship and Exclusive Sovereignty framework. Broken Kinship describes the transformation of overlapping local relations and sacred geographies into inherited civilisational opposition. Exclusive Sovereignty describes the institutional process through which one community’s memory, vulnerability, sacred attachment, or demographic project acquires superior constitutional and territorial priority. The article examines asymmetrical recognition under the Balfour Declaration and the Mandate, the displacement and non-return regime formed around 1948, post-1948 property and nationality laws, and later constitutional arrangements. It also develops the concepts of transferred cost, collective forfeiture, and presumed counterfactual complicity. The central normative claim is that Jewish security and Palestinian freedom must be made institutionally compatible rather than one being achieved through the erasure of the other.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨法律与历史范畴如何决定巴勒斯坦和以色列中哪些主张得以被看见，提出了"断裂的亲缘"（Broken Kinship）与"排他性主权"（Exclusive Sovereignty）分析框架，揭示有限事实（如历史依附、避难、土地购买、军事胜利等）如何被当作解决主权、财产、回归或公民权利等独立问题的依据，最终主张犹太安全与巴勒斯坦自由必须在制度上兼容而非彼此抹除。
AI.research_question: 法律和历史范畴如何决定巴勒斯坦和以色列中哪些主张得以被看见？具体而言，有限的论据（如历史依附、避难、土地购买、军事胜利或政治领袖行为）是如何被当作解决了主权、财产、回归或公民权利等独立问题的？
AI.motivation: 在巴勒斯坦和以色列的冲突中，双方的主张往往依赖相互冲突的法律和历史叙事，但缺乏一个系统性框架来理解这些主张如何被建构、如何获得或丧失可见性，以及"不对称承认"如何在制度层面运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 断裂的亲缘（Broken Kinship）与排他性主权（Exclusive Sovereignty）框架；不对称承认；转移成本（transferred cost）、集体没收（collective forfeiture）、推定反事实共谋（presumed counterfactual complicity）等概念。
AI.method: 基于委任统治档案、法律文书、巴勒斯坦与以色列/犹太史学著作、少数族裔社区研究，并对反论点进行结构化检验。
AI.findings: ①断裂的亲缘描述了重叠的地方关系与神圣地理如何转变为继承性的文明对立；②排他性主权描述了某一共同体的记忆、脆弱性、神圣依附或人口工程如何获得优越的宪法和领土优先权；③巴勒斯坦托管地时期的《贝尔福宣言》和委任统治、1948年前后形成的流离失所与禁止返回体制、1948年后的财产和国籍法以及后续宪法安排中均存在不对称承认；④提出了转移成本、集体没收和推定反事实共谋等新概念。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"断裂的亲缘"与"排他性主权"分析框架，并发展出"转移成本""集体没收""推定反事实共谋"等新概念，为理解法律与历史范畴在建构冲突主张中的角色提供了系统性理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确提出核心规范性主张：犹太安全与巴勒斯坦自由必须在制度上实现兼容，而非通过一方对另一方的抹除来实现，为冲突解决提供规范性指引。

title: Measuring Supply Chain Performance Using Sem Approach: An Empirical Analysis of Knitted Garment Units in Tiruppur
affiliations: Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, PPG College of Arts and Science and Kristu Jayanti College

detail.title: Measuring Supply Chain Performance Using Sem Approach: An Empirical Analysis of Knitted Garment Units in Tiruppur

keywords: Supply Chain Performance and Structural Equation Modeling.

detail.abstract: In order to adopt the global value chain in apparel, the first line starts with new ideas for producing different kind of products has to be generated. In the second line appropriate fabrics has to be developed for meeting the requirement. In the third stage appropriate material has to be sourced for meeting the requirement of the order. The next stage was the product design sent to the buyer and permission of acceptance is made. The business unit's directors take the responsibility of marketing the product after the quality is assured by the pre shipment inspection team (Kalyani Joshi, 2015) (5). At the production stage product development design is perfectly adopted and required raw material is used in the process adhering production management purposefully. The material production has to concentrate on cut, make and trim and sew process. The value chain process starts from procuring the fiber as the raw material and concerting the fiber to yarn by spinning and twisting. The yarn is converted into fabrics by the process of weaving and knitting. The fabrics are converted into finished fabric by the process of bleaching, dyeing and printing. After making design the finished fabrics is converted as garment and through retailing it reaches the customer (www.ec.europa.eu) (6). At the final stage the sales team design the catalogue, make sure of appropriate posters with a unique pattern making perfect supply. For analyzing supply chain performance of the company the study adopted a Simple Random Sampling method to ascertain the sample size. Data were collected from 429 respondents and analyzed using simple percentage analysis, factor analysis and SEM model from the collected data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了服装行业中全球价值链的采纳与供应链绩效分析，详细描述了从产品创意提出、面料开发、材料采购、产品设计、营销到生产与零售的完整价值链流程，并采用简单随机抽样方法收集429名受访者数据，通过简单百分比分析、因子分析和SEM模型分析服装企业供应链绩效。
AI.research_question: 服装行业如何采纳全球价值链，以及如何分析该企业的供应链绩效？
AI.motivation: 服装行业需要适应全球价值链模式，通过理解完整的价值创造流程（从纤维采购到零售）来优化供应链绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论（GVC）；供应链管理理论
AI.method: 简单随机抽样方法确定样本量；从429名受访者收集数据；采用简单百分比分析、因子分析和结构方程模型（SEM）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 研究对服装企业的供应链绩效进行了分析，但摘要中未详细呈现具体的统计结果和模型结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全球价值链理论应用于服装行业的实际运营分析，丰富了全球价值链在发展中国家服装产业中的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服装企业提供了从产品开发到零售的完整价值链操作流程参考，并提供了供应链绩效的量化分析方法。

title: Consensus Change Standards: A Legal and Technical Framework for Bitcoin Protocol Governance

detail.title: Consensus Change Standards: A Legal and Technical Framework for Bitcoin Protocol Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a solo Bitcoin miner and full node operator, and is incorporating Bitcoin-anchored timestamping into legal case-management software he develops. These operational interests in how Bitcoin block space is used are disclosed in the paper (Sections 1.4 and 5.4). The framework is deliberately confined to procedural standards so that its conclusions do not turn on the author's view of the underlying inscription debate. The author received no financial support for this work and has no other relationships that could be perceived to have influenced it.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a legal and technical analysis involving no human participants, patient data, or personal data; no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external, institutional, or commercial funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Bitcoin has no formal process for evaluating proposed changes to its consensus rules. The Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) system provides a way to propose changes, but sets no minimum standards a proposal must meet before the community considers activation. There are no required review periods, no mandatory code audit standards, no agreed-upon activation thresholds, no chain split risk assessment methodology, and no framework for evaluating the legal and economic consequences of a failed activation.

This absence of standards has produced predictable results. The block size wars of 2015-2017 consumed years of developer time, fractured the community, and produced a contentious hard fork. The SegWit activation is widely credited to the threat of a novel User Activated Soft Fork (UASF) - BIP-148 - breaking the deadlock that had persisted after BIP-9 signaling failed to reach its 95% threshold over the preceding eight months. More recently, BIP-110 - a proposed temporary soft fork to restrict arbitrary data in Bitcoin transactions - was released with an activation client that multiple developers reported contained significant bugs. Its deployment paired that client with a 55% activation threshold far below any successful modern deployment and a six-week timeline from initial proposal to activation client - shorter than the review period of every modern successful soft fork, for SegWit and Taproot by more than an order of magnitude. The activation client was first distributed alongside stable Knots releases on node management platforms with no risk disclosure or visual differentiation, then bundled into the default release stream itself - so that the routine upgrade ladder terminates in a confirmation dialog that presents consensus alteration as the path forward.

This paper proposes a framework for evaluating Bitcoin consensus change proposals, and it begins from a claim these debates rarely confront: the catastrophic failure mode of a consensus change - a persistent chain split - has a computable risk profile, and that risk depends almost entirely on one variable, the share of hashrate that will enforce the new rules at activation. Section 3 models it and shows it is not a smooth function of that share but a cliff: at 55% enforcement the chance of a six-block reorganization during activation is roughly thirty percent; by 90% or above it is effectively zero, five to seven orders of magnitude lower. Much of the governance argument turns out to be a fight over a number - one the standard mathematics of chain-race security already supplies, but that the activation debate has almost never computed. The framework builds on that quantification, on the history of Bitcoin's prior consensus changes, on the maturity-gate principles the open-standards tradition has applied to protocol governance for thirty years, and on a legal analysis of the liabilities an inadequately reviewed activation creates. It is practical, concrete, and immediately applicable. It proposes no changes to Bitcoin's code; it proposes standards for the process by which such changes are evaluated, debated, and either adopted or rejected.

The author is a practicing litigator, solo Bitcoin miner, full node operator, and computer scientist - roles that carry their own operational stake in how block space is used. This framework is written from the intersection of those disciplines, and is deliberately limited to procedural standards so that its conclusions do not turn on the author's view of the underlying inscription debate. The problems it addresses - governance, liability, technical risk, and economic consequence - cannot be fully analyzed from any single perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文指出比特币共识变更提案（BIP）体系缺乏正式的最低评估标准——没有强制审查期、代码审计标准、激活门槛、链分裂风险评估方法或法律经济后果框架，导致历史上多次治理危机（如区块大小之战、SegWit激活僵局、BIP-110仓促部署）。论文提出一个评估比特币共识变更提案的框架，核心论点是共识变更的灾难性失败模式（持续链分裂）具有可计算的风险曲线，且该风险几乎只取决于一个变量——激活时执行新规则的算力份额。作者通过数学建模证明该风险在55%执行率时六区块重组概率约30%，在90%以上时接近于零（低5-7个数量级），呈现"悬崖"而非平滑曲线特征。框架综合了量化分析、历史经验、开放标准传统的成熟度门槛原则，以及法律责任分析，提出程序性标准而非代码更改。
AI.research_question: 如何为比特币共识变更提案建立一套正式的评估标准，以降低链分裂等灾难性失败风险？具体而言，共识变更的激活风险如何量化，以及应建立怎样的程序性门槛来评估、讨论和采纳或拒绝提案？
AI.motivation: 比特币共识变更体系（BIP）缺乏最低标准：无强制审查期、无代码审计标准、无统一激活门槛、无链分裂风险评估方法、无法律和经济后果评估框架。这种缺失已导致：2015-2017年区块大小之战（耗时数年、导致社区分裂和硬分叉）、SegWit激活依赖BIP-148的UASF威胁才打破僵局，以及BIP-110的仓促部署（55%的低激活阈值、六周的极短审查期、含重大bug的激活客户端）。这些事件表明需要建立一个系统性框架来评估共识变更提案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 链竞争安全性的标准数学（chain-race security mathematics）——用于计算共识变更激活时的链重组风险；2) 开放标准传统中的成熟度门槛原则（maturity-gate principles）——开放标准社区三十年来应用于协议治理的成熟度评审机制；3) 法律分析——评估未经充分审查的激活可能产生的法律责任；4) 比特币历史共识变更的经验教训——涵盖SegWit和Taproot等成功案例的审查流程。
AI.method: 1) 数学建模：对共识变更激活时的链分裂风险进行量化建模，将风险表示为执行新规则算力份额的函数；2) 历史案例分析：回顾比特币此前共识变更（区块大小之战、SegWit、Taproot）的治理过程；3) 跨学科综合分析：整合计算机科学（技术风险）、法律（责任分析）、经济学（治理后果）和开放标准治理实践。论文聚焦于程序性标准，不涉及作者对底层协议内容（如铭文辩论）的个人立场。
AI.findings: 1) 共识变更激活时的链分裂风险几乎完全取决于一个变量——激活时执行新规则的算力份额；2) 该风险不是算力份额的平滑函数，而是"悬崖"形态：55%执行率时六区块重组概率约30%，90%及以上时概率接近于零（低5-7个数量级）；3) 治理争论本质上是对一个数字的争夺——而这个数字其实可以由标准的链竞争安全数学直接计算得出，但激活辩论中几乎从未计算过；4) 现有BIP体系中失败的案例（如BIP-110）在阈值设定（55%）、审查周期（六周 vs SegWit和Taproot的数十倍）上都严重偏离成功案例的标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将链分裂风险从模糊的治理争论转化为可计算、可量化的风险曲线，为共识变更评估提供数学基础；2) 将开放标准传统的成熟度门槛原则系统性引入比特币共识治理领域，填补了该领域的程序性标准空白；3) 提出单一关键变量（激活算力份额）驱动的风险量化模型，简化了治理讨论的焦点；4) 将法律责任分析纳入共识变更评估框架，扩展了比特币治理研究的跨学科视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一个立即适用的、具体的共识变更提案评估框架，不要求修改比特币代码，只定义评估、讨论和采纳/拒绝的过程标准；2) 给出了可操作的激活阈值参考——基于计算结果显示90%以上执行率可有效消除链分裂风险；3) 为BIP-110类仓促提案提供了风险识别和防范的程序性工具，防止低阈值、短周期的风险部署；4) 为社区、开发者、矿工和节点运营商提供了共识变更决策的量化依据和责任制衡机制。

title: When Hegemons Revise: Dependence and International Order
affiliations: , Waseda University and Waseda University, Graduate School of Asia Pacific Studies, Students

detail.title: When Hegemons Revise: Dependence and International Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was partially supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers JP22H00849, JP21K13263 and Waseda University’s Special Research Project 2021C010 and 2023C247.

detail.abstract: Why do incumbent hegemons sometimes revise the very international orders they created? Classical theories of hegemonic stability and power transition typically attribute revisionism to dissatisfied rising powers or to shifts in ideology and preferences. Yet even while remaining system leaders, incumbent hegemons have sometimes revised the institutional and normative foundations of their own orders. This paper develops a formal theory of hegemonic revisionism grounded in variation in global dependence. We model international order as an institutional arrangement whose orientation can be strategically adjusted by competing superpowers. Non-superpower states affiliate based on both institutional compatibility and material dependence. When dependence on a superpower is high, the superpower can sustain participation while reproducing its historically embedded mode of authority. As dependence declines, however, maintaining coalition support requires reorienting the institutional terms of order provision. Revisionism thus emerges endogenously as a structural response to weakening leverage. The model identifies five equilibrium phases, partitioned by dependence thresholds, from unipolar dominance through bipolar rivalry to hegemonic reversal. It shows that challengers are most accommodating when their leverage is weakest, while incumbents revise the authoritative content of their orders only after dependence falls below a critical level-even if they remain materially dominant. By deriving the conditions for order revision within a formal framework, the paper advances hegemonic-order theory and reframes revisionism as structural phases in superpower competition life cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于全球依赖性变化的霸权修正主义正式理论。模型将国际秩序视为可被超级大国战略调整的制度安排，当其他国家对其依赖高时，霸权国可维持参与并延续既有权威模式；当依赖下降时，霸权国需重新调整秩序供给的制度条款以维持联盟支持，修正主义由此内生地作为弱化杠杆的结构性反应出现。模型识别出五个均衡阶段，并证明挑战者在杠杆最弱时最顺从，而霸权国仅当依赖降至临界值以下才会修正其秩序——即便其仍保持物质主导地位。
AI.research_question: 为什么在任霸权国有时会修正其自身创建的国际秩序？霸权修正主义在何种结构性条件下内生性地出现？
AI.motivation: 古典霸权稳定论和权力转移理论通常将修正主义归因于不满的崛起国或意识形态与偏好的转变，但未能解释在任霸权国在仍保持体系领导者地位时修正自身秩序的制度与规范基础的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霸权稳定理论、权力转移理论、国际秩序制度理论，以及基于全球依赖性变化的正式博弈论模型
AI.method: 建立关于国际秩序的制度取向可被竞争性超级大国战略调整的正式博弈论模型，分析非超级大国基于制度兼容性与物质依赖的从属选择，识别由依赖阈值划分的均衡阶段。
AI.findings: 模型识别出五个均衡阶段（从单极主导经两极竞争到霸权逆转），证明：（1）挑战者在自身杠杆最弱时最具包容性/合作性；（2）霸权国仅在依赖降至临界水平之下才会修正其秩序的权威性内容，即使其仍保持物质主导；（3）修正主义是超级大国竞争生命周期中的结构性阶段而非简单的偏好变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了霸权秩序理论，将修正主义重新框定为超级大国竞争生命周期中的结构性阶段，将霸权修正主义内生化为对弱化杠杆的结构性回应，弥合了经典霸权稳定论与权力转移理论的解释缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解大国竞争中的秩序调整时机提供分析框架，有助于预测霸权国在何种条件下会修正既有国际秩序，对国际秩序变迁与大国战略互动研究具有政策启示。

title: Do Markets Think about Stocks Proportionally?
affiliations: Freelancer

detail.title: Do Markets Think about Stocks Proportionally?
detail.abstract: I examine whether investors perceive higher-priced stocks as riskier despite identical percentage price changes. Using survey evidence, the study investigates whether nominal stock prices influence decisions to sell during market downturns.  The findings suggest that investors exhibit non-proportional reasoning, attributing significance to nominal price movements rather than proportional changes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查证据研究投资者是否认为高价股风险更高，即使百分比价格变化相同。研究发现投资者存在非比例推理，倾向于关注名义价格变动而非比例变动，这影响了他们在市场下跌时出售股票的决定。
AI.research_question: 投资者是否会将名义股价视为风险的代理指标？即使百分比价格变化相同，投资者是否认为高价股票风险更高？名义股价是否会影响投资者在市场下跌时的抛售决策？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论认为投资者应基于比例而非名义价格变动做出决策，但现实中的投资者可能受到名义价格锚定效应的影响。理解这一认知偏差对市场行为和投资者教育具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非比例推理（non-proportional reasoning）理论；行为金融学中的名义价格幻觉/价格锚定效应。
AI.method: 调查/问卷实验法（survey evidence），设计场景考察投资者面对名义价格变动时的出售决策。
AI.findings: 投资者表现出非比例推理行为，即在百分比变化相同的情况下，名义价格变动幅度更大的股票（高价股）被认为风险更高，从而影响出售决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非比例推理概念引入股票定价和风险感知领域，拓展了行为金融学中关于名义价格幻觉的理论边界，揭示投资者存在系统性认知偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者教育和投资咨询具有实践意义，提示投资者应关注比例收益而非名义价格；也有助于市场监管者理解市场下跌中的非理性抛售行为。

title: A SPOT in the dark: using AI to assess financial stability risks
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), University of Marburg and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: A SPOT in the dark: using AI to assess financial stability risks
detail.abstract: Financial stability risks consist of two distinct components: vulnerabilities and possible trigger events. While there has been considerable progress regarding the measurement of vulnerabilities, the assessment of possible trigger events remains largely qualitative. To fill this gap, we employ Large Language Models to extract information about the Severity and Probability Of potential Trigger events (SPOT) from a large dataset of financial news articles over the period2005 – 2026. The SPOT indicator increases ahead of major historical trigger events, correctly identifies trigger sources, and helps to improve forward looking model estimates of downside risks to the economy. The results indicate that the use of AI-based signal extraction from text can be a promising avenue to improve the monitoring of financial stability risks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从2005-2026年间的大量金融新闻文章中提取潜在触发事件的严重性和概率信息，构建SPOT指标，以补充金融稳定风险评估中偏重定性分析的触发事件评估环节。SPOT指标在重大历史触发事件前上升，能准确识别触发源，并改善对经济下行风险的预测。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大型语言模型从金融新闻文本中系统地量化金融稳定风险中的潜在触发事件（包括严重性和概率），从而弥补现有评估方法中触发事件评估偏重定性分析的不足？
AI.motivation: 金融稳定风险由脆弱性和可能触发事件两个不同组成部分构成。虽然脆弱性测量已取得较大进展，但潜在触发事件的评估仍然主要是定性的，缺乏系统性的量化方法，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融稳定风险评估框架，区分脆弱性（vulnerabilities）与触发事件（trigger events）两个维度；利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的文本信息提取能力进行自然语言处理。
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型（LLMs）从2005-2026年间的大量金融新闻文章数据集中提取潜在触发事件的严重性（Severity）和概率（Probability）信息，构建SPOT（Severity and Probability Of potential Trigger events）指标。
AI.findings: 1. SPOT指标在重大历史触发事件之前会上升；2. SPOT指标能够正确识别触发事件的来源；3. SPOT指标有助于改善对经济下行风险的前瞻性模型估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融稳定风险评估中的触发事件维度从定性分析推进到可量化的实证测量，为金融稳定风险的两维框架提供了可操作化的量化工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管部门提供了一种基于AI文本信号提取的金融稳定风险监测新工具，有望提升对潜在触发事件的前瞻性预警能力和对经济下行风险的预测精度。

title: Systemic Landslide Risk and Governance Fragmentation in the Western Ghats: A Comparative Policy Analysis of Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu
affiliations: and

detail.title: Systemic Landslide Risk and Governance Fragmentation in the Western Ghats: A Comparative Policy Analysis of Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declares no competing financial or personal interests that could influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a policy and secondary literature review. It did not involve any human participants, clinical trials, or animal experimentation, and therefore did not require formal institutional ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or financial support from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage biodiversity hotspot spanning roughly 1,600 km across six Indian states, has experienced a marked escalation in landslide frequency and severity over the past decade, culminating in high casualty events such as the 2024 Mundakkai-Chooralmala landslide in Wayanad, Kerala. Yet disaster governance in the region remains fragmented across state jurisdictions, each operating distinct hazard mapping protocols, regulatory regimes, and response mechanisms. This paper applies a systemic risk framework, integrating natural hazard drivers, socio-ecological vulnerability, and human exposure, to conduct a qualitative comparative policy analysis of landslide governance in Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu, the three Western Ghats states with the most developed institutional frameworks and the highest documented landslide incidence. Drawing on national hazard atlases, state disaster management authority reports, peer-reviewed geomorphological studies, and the National Disaster Management Authority's guidelines, the analysis identifies distinct state level vulnerability profiles: Kerala's high density settlement saturation on deeply weathered lateritic slopes, Karnataka's linear infrastructure stress along transit corridors compounded by an unresolved ecological zoning dispute, and Tamil Nadu's seasonal mass tourism exposure in the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal belts. An institutional assessment reveals structural enforcement deficits, cartographic resolution failures, and temporal gaps in bio-engineering interventions common across all three states despite their differing operational models. The paper concludes with targeted, scalable policy prescriptions, including statutory liability and independent geotechnical audit frameworks, blended finance vehicles for eco-relocation, LiDAR assisted micro zonation, and hybrid biostructural stabilization protocols, and argues for a unified pan regional governance model that treats the Western Ghats as a single ecological unit rather than a set of fragmented administrative territories.

AI.tldr: 本文运用系统性风险框架，对喀拉拉邦、卡纳塔克邦和泰米尔纳德邦三个西高止山脉邦的滑坡治理政策进行定性比较分析，识别出各邦不同的脆弱性特征和共同制度缺陷，并提出统一的跨区域治理模式和政策建议。
AI.research_question: 西高止山脉三个邦（喀拉拉邦、卡纳塔克邦、泰米尔纳德邦）的滑坡灾害治理政策存在哪些差异与共性制度缺陷？如何构建统一的跨区域治理框架？
AI.motivation: 西高止山脉作为联合国教科文组织世界遗产生物多样性热点区域，过去十年滑坡频率和严重程度显著升级，但灾害治理分散在各自邦管辖范围内，缺乏统一协调机制，亟需系统性评估与整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险框架（integrating natural hazard drivers, socio-ecological vulnerability, and human exposure）
AI.method: 定性比较政策分析（Qualitative Comparative Policy Analysis），基于国家灾害图集、邦灾害管理局报告、同行评审地貌学研究和国家灾害管理局指南等多元数据来源。
AI.findings: 各邦具有不同的脆弱性特征：喀拉拉邦为高密度定居点饱和于深层风化红土坡；卡纳塔克邦为线性基础设施压力叠加未解决的生态分区争议；泰米尔纳德邦为尼尔吉里和科代卡纳尔地带季节性大众旅游暴露。三国均存在结构性执法缺陷、制图分辨率失败以及生物工程干预的时间缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将系统性风险框架应用于跨邦比较分析，揭示了不同行政模式下的共同制度性治理缺陷，为滑坡灾害治理研究提供了整合自然驱动因素、社会生态脆弱性和人类暴露度的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出针对性的可扩展政策建议，包括法定责任与独立岩土审计框架、生态搬迁的混合融资工具、LiDAR辅助微区划、混合生物结构稳定方案，并倡导将西高止山脉视为单一生态单元的统一跨区域治理模式。

title: Behavioural Risk in Governance: The Missing Link Between Governance Structures and Governance Outcomes

detail.title: Behavioural Risk in Governance: The Missing Link Between Governance Structures and Governance Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract:
This paper argues that behavioural risk — the risk that governance judgement is systematically influenced by psychological, social, and organisational conditions in ways inconsistent with an organisation's purpose, responsibilities, or objectives — is the most significant unnamed risk category in contemporary governance. Conventional governance frameworks focus on structures, policies and compliance, but structurally sound governance systems continue to produce poor outcomes because the behavioural conditions shaping judgement inside them are neither identified nor governed. The paper identifies nine behavioural drivers — pressure, incentives, power, fear, fatigue, loyalty, ego, cognitive bias, and identity–purpose inversion — and two governing mechanisms, behavioural capture and moral licensing, through which behavioural risk becomes embedded and normalised within governance systems. It introduces Behavioural Information Distortion to explain how organisational reality becomes filtered before it reaches the board, and the Decision Integrity Model to demonstrate precisely where behavioural risk interferes with governance — from organisational purpose, through judgement, decision and action, to organisational outcomes.

These concepts are examined against five major governance failures — the NASA Challenger disaster, the Volkswagen emissions scandal, the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, the Robodebt scheme, and the PwC Australia tax leaks — before setting out practical governance actions by role (boards, chairs, CEOs, executive teams, people leaders, internal audit and risk committees) and a call for systemic recognition of behavioural risk by regulators, governance codes, professional bodies, risk standards and academia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为风险"是当代治理中最重要但未被命名的风险类别，即治理判断因心理、社会和组织条件而被系统性影响，导致与组织目标不一致。文章识别了九大行为驱动因素和两大治理机制，引入行为信息失真和决策完整性模型，并通过五个重大治理失败案例验证，最后提出按角色划分的实践行动建议。
AI.research_question: 结构健全的治理体系为何仍持续产生不良结果？行为风险如何嵌入并在治理系统中常态化，以及应如何加以识别和治理？
AI.motivation: 现行治理框架聚焦结构、政策与合规，却忽视了塑造治理判断的行为条件。即便治理结构健全，治理系统仍持续产出不良结果，根源在于影响判断的行为条件既未被识别也未被治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为风险概念、九大行为驱动因素（压力、激励、权力、恐惧、疲劳、忠诚、自我、认知偏差、身份-目标倒置）、两大治理机制（行为捕获与道德许可）、行为信息失真（Behavioural Information Distortion）、决策完整性模型（Decision Integrity Model）。
AI.method: 概念构建与案例研究相结合。提出理论概念框架后，对照五个重大治理失败案例（NASA挑战者号灾难、大众排放丑闻、波音737 MAX坠机、Robodebt计划、PwC澳洲税务泄露）进行检验分析。
AI.findings: 行为风险是治理中最重要但未被命名的风险类别；结构健全的治理系统仍会因行为条件未受治理而产生不良结果；行为风险通过行为捕获和道德许可机制在治理系统中嵌入并常态化；行为信息失真导致组织现实在到达董事会之前被过滤。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将行为风险定义为独立的治理风险类别；提出了九大行为驱动因素和两大治理机制的概念框架；引入行为信息失真概念解释组织信息传递中的过滤机制；构建决策完整性模型展示行为风险从组织目标到治理结果的完整干扰路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 针对不同治理角色（董事会、主席、CEO、高管团队、人员领导者、内审与风险委员会）提供具体行动建议；呼吁监管机构、治理准则、专业机构、风险标准和学术界对行为风险进行系统性承认和治理。

title: The Market After God: Adam Smith and the Forgotten Problem of Evil

detail.title: The Market After God: Adam Smith and the Forgotten Problem of Evil
detail.abstract: The Adam Smith Problem has been misdescribed. The familiar question asks whether the sympathy of The Theory of Moral Sentiments can be reconciled with the self-interest of The Wealth of Nations; the consensus has answered that it can. This paper argues that the reconciliation answered the wrong question. The Moral Sentiments poses and answers a theodicy: fortune’s sway over merit, the deception that drives industry and the emptiness of greatness are justified as instruments of a benevolent systemic design. The Wealth of Nations presupposes the harmony conclusion without reopening the question that licensed it. The discontinuity between the books is therefore not a contradiction of motives but the seam of an asymmetric survival: a providential structure of harmony persisted in economic thought after the problem of evil ceased to be asked within the genre. The paper defends this redescription against Blumenberg’s objection to secularization theses and traces the structure’s afterlife from Mandeville to welfare economics.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了"亚当·斯密问题"：传统上对《道德情操论》的同情与《国富论》的自利之间能否调和的争论，其实答错了问题。本文认为，《道德情操论》本质上是一部神义论（theodicy），为命运对功绩的主宰、驱动工业的欺骗以及伟大的虚妄提供了一种善意的系统性设计辩护；而《国富论》预设了这一和谐结论却不重新追问其合法性。两书之间的断裂并非动机上的矛盾，而是一种不对称存活的接缝：神意性的和谐结构在经济学思想中存续下来，而恶的问题不再被该体裁追问。文章还针对布卢门伯格对世俗化命题的反对为这一重新描述辩护，并追溯该结构从曼德维尔到福利经济学的余绪。
AI.research_question: 亚当·斯密两部著作之间的所谓"断裂"究竟应该如何被正确理解？传统"斯密问题"的调和论是否问错了问题？
AI.motivation: 传统上"斯密问题"被视为同情与自利两种动机之间的调和问题，且学界共识认为可以调和。本文认为这种调和回答的是错误的问题，需要重新描述这一问题的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神义论（theodicy）概念；对布卢门伯格（Blumenberg）世俗化命题的回应；系统性设计的辩护理论。
AI.method: 概念史/思想史重新诠释：通过重新解读《道德情操论》与《国富论》的文本结构，论证斯密问题是神义论问题而非动机调和问题，并追溯该结构的学术史余绪。
AI.findings: 《道德情操论》是神义论，为命运对功绩的支配、欺骗对产业的驱动和伟大的虚妄作了神意辩护；《国富论》预设了和谐结论而不重新追问。两书断裂是不对称存活的接缝——神意的和谐结构在经济学中存活，而恶的问题不再被该学科追问。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了"亚当·斯密问题"，将之从动机调和的心理学问题重构为神义论问题；并回应了布卢门伯格对世俗化命题的质疑，提出"不对称存活"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 改变了理解斯密思想遗产的方式，说明经济思想中"看不见的手"等和谐结构保留了其神义论起源的印记，对理解经济学传统的元理论预设具有启示意义。

AI.research_question: 2022年度路易斯安那州石油与天然气法律领域有哪些重要判例和立法变化？
