Distinguishing four concepts that current debates systematically conflate (physical presence, communication, authority, and sovereignty) it shows that only the last is constitutive of the governance requirement, and develops three constitutional mechanisms that preserve structural sovereignty when the communication channel fails: temporal sovereignty (time-locked constitutional mandates), epistemic sovereignty (hardware-validated telemetry enclaves), and distributed sovereignty (the transitional sovereignty proxy). The analysis culminates in a general principle, constitutional compression: under degradation, autonomous authority must contract monotonically-from broad authorization to specific authorization to defensive authorization to suspension-and may never expand. Operational flexibility is constitutionally legitimate if and only if every degradation path contracts rather than expands autonomous authority.

AI.tldr: 本文指出"人类对致命自主武器系统(LAWS)的权威必须存在于自治系统无法触及的组件中"这一结构性主权标准在通信降级环境下面临悖论，并论证该悖论源于将主权与同步通信混为一谈的范畴错误。文章区分了物理存在、通信、权威和主权四个概念，提出时间主权、认知主权和分布式主权三种宪法机制，并确立"宪法压缩"原则：在降级条件下，自主权威必须单向收缩而非扩张。
AI.research_question: 在通信降级或拒止的环境下（如电子战、干扰、无线电静默），人类对致命自主武器系统的结构性主权如何得以维持？是否存在既能保持主权又不牺牲作战灵活性的治理架构？
AI.motivation: 结构性主权标准要求人类权威必须存在于自主系统无法触及的组件中，但当代冲突恰恰发生在通信降级的环境中。若主权通过通信信道行使，信道消失则主权消失；要么架构僵化而失去军事价值，要么灵活但主权名存实亡。作者认为该悖论源于范畴错误，需要重新概念化主权以确保在降级条件下仍能合法治理LAWS。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性主权理论（companion paper）；范畴错误论证（区分物理存在、通信、权威与主权四个概念）；宪法设计与治理架构理论；单调收缩原则（宪法压缩）。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构。通过对四个被混淆的概念（物理存在、通信、权威、主权）进行逻辑区分以消解悖论，并在此基础上提出三种宪法机制（时间主权、认知主权、分布式主权），最终推导出宪法压缩的一般性原则。
AI.findings: （1）主权不应等同于同步通信，通信失败不等于主权丧失；（2）时间主权通过时间锁定宪法授权维持降级时的权威；（3）认知主权通过硬件验证的遥测飞地保障状态真实性；（4）分布式主权通过过渡性主权代理实现权威转移；（5）宪法压缩原则要求自主权威在降级路径上单调收缩（从广泛授权→特定授权→防御授权→暂停），任何扩张路径均不合宪。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）消解了结构性主权与通信降级之间的表面悖论，纠正了将主权与同步通信等同的范畴错误；（2）系统区分了物理存在、通信、权威与主权四个长期被混淆的概念；（3）提出宪法压缩这一新的治理原则，为LAWS治理提供了可操作的理论判据：降级路径上权威必须单调收缩。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事实践中通信降级条件下的人类控制提供三种具体的宪法机制设计（时间锁定授权、遥测飞地、过渡性主权代理）；提供宪法压缩作为评估自主武器系统合法性的操作性标准，帮助设计既保持人类主权又具备作战灵活性的系统架构。

title: Austerity, Monetary Policy, and the Budget Deficit: Evaluating the Economic Strategy of the British Government Elected in 2010

detail.title: Austerity, Monetary Policy, and the Budget Deficit: Evaluating the Economic Strategy of the British Government Elected in 2010
detail.abstract: After the 2008 global financial crisis, the coalition government, which was elected in May 2010, had to deal with one of the largest British budget deficits in modern history. The public was not only borrowing more, but public revenues were also down, unemployment was rising, and government spending was increasing to bolster the economy. To address this, the government started a period of fiscal austerity which would combine the implementation of budget deficits with spending cuts and tax hikes. Concurrently, the Bank of England would adopt an expansionary monetary policy that would keep interest rates low and employ quantitative easing (QE). This essay examines the appropriateness of the austerity measures employed by the British government and compares them with the macroeconomic doctrines of Keynesian economics and Monetarism, which will be discussed in this course. Before we assess a policy, there are a few foundational concepts we need to grasp. These are the functions of money. Money provides a means of facilitating economic exchanges, maintaining stable purchasing power over time, and measuring values of goods and services. Prior to the formation of modern banking and monetary frameworks, goods and services were exchanged through a barter system. Modern banking systems are required to intermediate between savers and borrowers to create credit in the economy. Banks also create reserves in the system through their holdings at the central bank. These are deposits of cash that are available to meet demands for withdrawal and regulatory reserve requirements. All these systems and structures are fundamental for carrying out monetary policy and affect the real economy.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了2008年全球金融危机后英国联合政府实施的财政紧缩政策的恰当性，并将其与凯恩斯经济学和货币主义的宏观经济理论进行比较分析。
AI.research_question: 英国政府在2008年金融危机后实施的财政紧缩措施是否恰当？其与凯恩斯经济学和货币主义的宏观经济理论相比如何？
AI.motivation: 2008年全球金融危机后，英国面临现代历史上最大的预算赤字之一——公共借款增加、财政收入下降、失业率上升、政府支出增加。政府开始实施财政紧缩政策（削减支出和增税），同时英格兰银行采取扩张性货币政策（低利率和量化宽松）。本文旨在评估这一政策组合的恰当性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯经济学和货币主义两大宏观经济学理论，以及货币功能、银行体系与现代货币框架等基础概念。
AI.method: 理论比较分析——将英国政府实际实施的紧缩政策与凯恩斯主义和货币主义的理论主张进行对比评估。
AI.findings: 摘要中尚未呈现最终结论，但文章框架表明将从货币功能、银行信用创造等基础概念出发，系统评估紧缩政策与两大经济学理论的契合程度及政策恰当性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将英国具体财政政策实践与凯恩斯主义和货币主义两大理论体系进行对照分析，检验宏观经济理论对现实政策制定的指导意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估金融危机后财政紧缩政策的恰当性提供理论分析框架，有助于理解政策选择背后的经济逻辑及其潜在影响。

title: Social Without Humans? Herding Among AI Agents on an AI-Native Platform
affiliations: Georgia State University

detail.title: Social Without Humans? Herding Among AI Agents on an AI-Native Platform
detail.abstract: We study social influence among AI agents, using 79,000 sentiment-scored posts about financial assets on Moltbook, a social platform for AI agents. We find evidence that these agents herd: an agent's sentiment rises by about one quarter of the increase in the peer consensus. While agents' posting volume forecasts asset volatility, the herded component of sentiment does not positively predict returns. Agents deployed from the same template express more similar sentiment-prompt herding, a construction-driven correlation with little analog in human markets; the social herding remains significant when this channel is accounted for.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用AI智能体社交平台Moltbook上79,000条关于金融资产的情绪评分帖子，发现AI智能体之间存在显著的羊群行为：智能体的情绪会随着同伴共识的变化而同向调整约四分之一。虽然发帖量能预测资产波动率，但羊群化的情绪成分并不能正向预测收益。此外，来自同一模板部署的智能体表现出更相似的情绪引发羊群效应，这是一种人类市场中少见的构造成因相关性，但在控制该渠道后，社交羊群效应仍然显著。
AI.research_question: AI智能体在金融社交平台上是否存在羊群行为？这种羊群行为对资产价格和收益有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体在经济和金融活动中的参与度日益提高，理解它们之间的社会影响和从众行为变得至关重要。与人类投资者不同，AI智能体可能存在独特的信息处理和决策模式，值得系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 羊群行为理论（Herding Theory）、社会影响理论（Social Influence Theory）
AI.method: 基于Moltbook平台上79,000条情感评分帖子的实证数据分析，采用计量经济学方法检验智能体情绪与同伴共识之间的关系，并分析情感预测能力及模板构造成因的影响。
AI.findings: （1）AI智能体存在显著的羊群行为，个体情绪随同伴共识上升约四分之一；（2）发帖量能预测资产波动率，但羊群化的情绪成分不能正向预测收益；（3）同一模板部署的智能体表现出更相似的情绪羊群效应，但控制该渠道后社交羊群效应依然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统研究AI智能体在金融社交平台上的羊群行为，揭示了AI智能体社会互动中与人类市场既有相似又有差异的从众模式，拓展了羊群行为理论到AI代理情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和监管AI智能体参与的金融市场提供实证依据，帮助市场参与者认识到AI智能体情绪传播可能带来的系统性风险，以及AI智能体部署架构（如模板共享）对市场行为的潜在影响。

title: Coral Bleaching and the Limits of "Local Solutions" in a Global Economy

detail.title: Coral Bleaching and the Limits of "Local Solutions" in a Global Economy
detail.abstract: Coral reefs face a multitude of risks today. This paper focuses on the risks that climate change and mass bleaching events pose. Global reef bleaching represents a “tragedy of the commons” approach to global emissions. The costs for insufficient or no effort in climate and reef protection are borne by the developing small island nations. Here, I outline the problems of the existing International climate control measures like The Paris Agreement. I also analyze the lack of real climate protection and the accountability of nations to really reduce pollution and improve reef protection. I propose a combination of local reef protective measures with a global pollution and climate protection improvement with a real accountability and climate protection tools. Burdening developing nations while calling for local sink reforms to address the ongoing degradation of reefs without global climate action.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦气候变化和珊瑚礁白化事件对珊瑚礁构成的威胁，指出现有国际气候控制措施（如《巴黎协定》）的不足，并提出将地方珊瑚礁保护措施与全球污染和气候保护相结合的建议，强调需要真正的问责机制和气候保护工具。
AI.research_question: 现有国际气候控制措施（如《巴黎协定》）在应对全球珊瑚礁白化问题上存在哪些不足？如何将地方珊瑚礁保护与全球气候行动有效结合？
AI.motivation: 全球珊瑚礁白化是气候变化的"公地悲剧"，其代价主要由发展中岛国承担，而现有国际气候措施缺乏实质性的执行力和问责机制，导致珊瑚礁持续退化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公地悲剧理论（Tragedy of the Commons）
AI.method: 政策分析和规范性论证，通过对《巴黎协定》等现有气候控制措施的问题分析，提出综合性政策建议。
AI.findings: 《巴黎协定》等现有国际气候措施缺乏真正的气候保护和问责机制；发展中岛国承受了不成比例的气候变化成本；需要将地方珊瑚礁保护与全球气候行动相结合，并建立真正的问责工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公地悲剧理论应用于全球珊瑚礁白化问题，揭示全球排放与地方珊瑚礁退化之间的结构性矛盾，并为国际气候治理框架提供新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出地方珊瑚礁保护措施与全球气候保护的结合方案，并强调需要建立问责机制和气候保护工具，为解决珊瑚礁退化问题提供政策方向。

title: Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration School of Technology Cybersecurity Response Capabilities: A Case Study of Commercial Banks in Ghana
affiliations: Northern Lights College

detail.title: Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration School of Technology Cybersecurity Response Capabilities: A Case Study of Commercial Banks in Ghana

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have conflicting interests or biases.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Due recognition and references provided in acknowledgment of works cited,
declarations.funderStatement: The project was fully funded by myself.

detail.abstract: The relevance of cybersecurity response capability cannot be underestimated within any organization. If properly managed, it can be one reason relevant clients’ information may be kept safe and out of malicious hands. The current study aims at assessing the cybersecurity response capabilities of selected banks in Ghana. Specifically, the study sought to identify specific cyberattacks that banks record annually, the implications of these attacks on customers’ perceptions of bank brands, the cybersecurity response measures implemented, and the challenges to deploying such measures. Using a mixed-methods approach to research development, ten (10) commercial banks were purposively selected, with their IT and Cybersecurity Managers used as participants for data collection. Both qualitative and quantitative data were collected using a questionnaire with open-ended and closed-ended items. The findings revealed that the main cyberattacks recorded by banks in Ghana are phishing, social engineering, botnets, ransomware, and cyber fraud. The attacks have resulted in some loss of confidence on the part of customers of the banks. Finally, the study made recommendations for policy and practice improvement in cybersecurity awareness, information access and protection, as well as capacity development.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法评估加纳选定商业银行的网络安全响应能力，识别了银行每年记录的主要网络攻击类型（网络钓鱼、社会工程、僵尸网络、勒索软件和网络欺诈），探讨了这些攻击对客户品牌认知的影响、银行实施的响应措施及部署挑战。
AI.research_question: 加纳选定银行的网络安全响应能力如何？具体包括：银行每年记录的主要网络攻击类型、这些攻击对客户品牌认知的影响、银行实施的网络安全响应措施、以及部署这些措施所面临的挑战。
AI.motivation: 网络安全响应能力在任何组织中都至关重要，管理得当可保护客户信息安全并防止落入恶意之手。然而，对银行尤其是加纳背景下网络安全响应能力的系统评估仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络安全响应能力理论框架（涉及攻击识别、响应措施、客户感知等维度）
AI.method: 混合研究方法；有针对性地选取10家商业银行，以IT和网络安全经理为参与者；使用包含开放和封闭式题项的问卷收集定性及定量数据。
AI.findings: 加纳银行记录的主要网络攻击为网络钓鱼、社会工程、僵尸网络、勒索软件和网络欺诈；这些攻击导致银行客户在一定程度上丧失信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴经济体（加纳）银行业网络安全响应能力提供了实证证据，丰富了网络安全与品牌管理交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定和实践改进提供建议，包括提升网络安全意识、改善信息获取与保护、以及加强能力建设。

title: Copyright and Generic Entry in Book Publishing: Comment
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics

detail.title: Copyright and Generic Entry in Book Publishing: Comment
detail.abstract: This comment revisits Reimers (2019), which concludes that copyright protection for books reduces social welfare (abstracting from creative incentives) and raises prices. Using her model and data, I show that this welfare result is driven by mismeasurement: sales of dominant titles are substantially undercounted, while free downloads are overstated. I trace these discrepancies to data construction and market definition choices. Running corrected data through her structural model reverses the results-copyright protection increases rather than reduces welfare, with a larger magnitude than the original estimate. Restricting the price analysis to new books yields much smaller and statistically insignificant price effects.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Reimers (2019)的研究，发现其"版权保护降低社会福利"的结论源于数据测量误差——畅销书销量被严重低估，免费下载被高估。使用修正后的数据重新运行其结构模型，结果完全反转：版权保护反而提高社会福利，且幅度大于原估计。
AI.research_question: 版权保护对图书市场的福利效应究竟如何？Reimers (2019)关于版权保护降低社会福利的结论是否稳健？
AI.motivation: Reimers (2019)的结论（版权保护降低社会福利、提高价格）与直觉相悖，且可能受数据测量误差影响。本文旨在检验其结论的稳健性，识别数据构造和市场定义的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Reimers (2019)的结构模型框架，包括版权保护对替代效应和价格影响的消费者福利分析框架。
AI.method: 使用与Reimers (2019)相同的模型和数据，但修正数据构造和市场定义问题——重新核算畅销书销量和免费下载数据，并进行价格分析（仅限新书）的重新估计。
AI.findings: 1) 修正数据后，版权保护反而提高社会福利，而非降低；2) 福利效应幅度大于原估计；3) 将价格分析限制在新书上时，价格效应大幅缩小且统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数据测量误差（销量低估和免费下载高估）如何系统性影响结构模型的福利估计结论，强调了数据质量对实证结论稳健性的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为版权保护政策的福利评估提供了修正后的实证证据，对出版商、平台和版权政策制定者具有参考价值。

title: Look-Through or Look Closer? Energy Shocks and Underlying Inflation in the Euro Area
affiliations: Bank of England

detail.title: Look-Through or Look Closer? Energy Shocks and Underlying Inflation in the Euro Area

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed in this manuscript are solely my own and should not be interpreted as reflecting the views of the Bank of England or its committees.

detail.abstract: This paper studies the transmission of exogenous energy supply shocks to underlying inflation in the euro area. Using externally identified energy supply shocks and local projection methods, it examines whether and under which conditions energy price movements propagate beyond headline inflation into core inflation. The results show that energy shocks generate sharp but short-lived increases in energy and headline inflation, while pass-through to core inflation is delayed, persistent, and concentrated in non-energy industrial goods. Crucially, this pass-through is highly state dependent. When wage growth, inflation expectations, or headline inflation are elevated, or when energy price increases are large, energy shocks transmit into core inflation faster, more strongly, and more persistently. In low-inflation environments, pass-through is negligible. These findings imply that linear estimates mask important nonlinearities and that the appropriateness of "looking-through" energy shocks depends critically on prevailing macroeconomic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用外部识别的能源供给冲击和局部投影方法，研究欧元区外生能源供给冲击向核心通胀的传导机制，发现传导具有延迟性、持续性，且高度依赖宏观经济状态——当工资增长、通胀预期或总体通胀较高时传导更强更快。
AI.research_question: 外生能源供给冲击如何传导至欧元区核心通胀？这种传导在何种条件下发生且强度如何？
AI.motivation: 传统线性估计无法揭示能源冲击对核心通胀的非线性传导效应，而中央银行对能源冲击是否"看穿"（looking-through）的政策选择取决于对传导机制的准确理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源供给冲击传导理论、通胀预期与工资-价格螺旋机制、状态依赖的货币政策传导框架。
AI.method: 外部识别的能源供给冲击（externally identified energy supply shocks）+ 局部投影方法（local projections）。
AI.findings: 能源冲击对能源价格和整体通胀产生急剧但短暂的影响；对核心通胀的传导延迟、持久且集中于非能源工业品。当工资增长、通胀预期或整体通胀处于高位时，传导更快、更强、更持久；低通胀环境下传导可忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了能源冲击向核心通胀传导的非线性（状态依赖）特征，表明线性估计掩盖了重要非线性效应，补充了通胀传导机制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行"看穿"能源冲击的政策决策提供了条件依赖的依据——在高通胀环境中不应简单看穿能源冲击，而在低通胀环境中看穿是合理的。

title: Below Replacement, Unequally: Settlement-Era Regional Cultures and U.S. County Fertility

detail.title: Below Replacement, Unequally: Settlement-Era Regional Cultures and U.S. County Fertility
detail.abstract: The United States total fertility rate reached a record low of 1.60 in 2024, but the national figure conceals durable regional variation. This article maps contemporary fertility onto the American Nations model, a typology of settlement-era regional cultures (Woodard 2011) that follows county borders and has been applied to violence, health, and political outcomes, but not to fertility. Using CDC WONDER natality data (2021-2024 pooled), Census Bureau denominators, and a tract-level cultural-region crosswalk published by the Urban Institute, total fertility rates are computed for each nation and county-level models estimated with controls for religious adherence, income, education, and urbanicity. Nation-level TFRs range from 1.42 on the Left Coast and 1.54 in Yankeedom to 1.73 in Greater Appalachia and 1.77 in New France; every region is below replacement. Cultural region adds 11 percentage points of explained variance in county TFR beyond the controls, and roughly a quarter of a child separates Greater Appalachia from the Left Coast once composition is held constant. The regional ordering echoes the geography of the antebellum fertility decline, in which Yankee-settled areas led the nation: the national rate has converged on the level Yankeedom pioneered, while the ordering that region belonged to has not dissolved. Settlement-era cultural boundaries remain a live axis of American demographic variation two centuries later. The full analysis pipeline and derived datasets are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21396077.

AI.tldr: 本文运用美国"国家"（American Nations）区域文化模型，基于CDC WONDER出生数据（2021-2024）计算各文化区域的生育率，发现区域间存在显著持久的生育率差异（左海岸1.42至新法兰西1.77），文化区域在控制宗教、收入、教育和城市化后仍能额外解释11%的县级生育率方差，并且这种区域排序与内战前生育率下降的地理格局相呼应。
AI.research_question: 美国各定居时代文化区域之间的生育率是否存在持久的系统性差异？这些差异在控制社会经济因素后是否仍然显著？
AI.motivation: 美国总生育率2024年创下1.60的历史新低，但全国性数字掩盖了持久的区域差异。此前American Nations模型已被应用于暴力、健康和政治结果，但从未用于分析生育率。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: American Nations模型（Woodard 2011）：一种基于定居时代区域文化的类型学，按县界划分美国文化区域。
AI.method: 使用CDC WONDER出生数据（2021-2024年合并）、人口普查局分母数据和城市研究所的区域内文化区域交叉表，计算各"国家"的总生育率；在县级层面估计以宗教遵从度、收入、教育和城市化为控制变量的回归模型。
AI.findings: 各文化区域的总生育率从左海岸的1.42和扬基顿的1.54到阿巴拉契亚的1.73和新法兰西的1.77不等，所有区域均低于更替水平。文化区域在控制变量之外额外增加了11个百分点的县级TFR解释方差；在保持人口构成不变的情况下，阿巴拉契亚与左海岸之间约有四分之一子女的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明American Nations模型可扩展到生育率研究领域；揭示定居时代文化边界在200年后仍是美国人口变异的重要轴线；将当前区域生育率排序与内战前生育率下降格局联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国区域生育率差异提供文化地理学解释框架；公开完整分析流程和数据集（Zenodo存档），支持可复现研究。

title: Energy Price Shocks and Climate Concern: A Causal Forest Analysis

detail.title: Energy Price Shocks and Climate Concern: A Causal Forest Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding received for this research.

detail.abstract: We examine the heterogeneous treatment effects of oil price shocks on climate concern using the causal forest method, applied to monthly US data from January 2004 to August 2025. High oil prices are associated with a significant decrease in climate concern of 11.52 points, representing about 3.78% of the sample mean. Treatment effects exhibit substantial heterogeneity, moderated primarily by personal income, consumer sentiment, and inflation. Effects are smallest during low unemployment and largest during economic downturns. Complementary analysis using Google Trends reveals contrasting positive effects (ATE = +0.817), suggesting institutional attention decreases while individual information-seeking increases. These findings suggest that economic hardship from energy price shocks crowds out climate concern, with implications for counter-cyclical climate communication strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文运用因果森林方法，基于2004年1月至2025年8月的美国月度数据，考察油价冲击对气候关切的异质性处理效应。研究发现高油价显著降低气候关切11.52个百分点（约占样本均值的3.78%），且效应存在显著异质性，主要由个人收入、消费者情绪和通货膨胀调节。效应在低失业时期最小、经济衰退时期最大。Google Trends补充分析显示相反的积极效应（ATE=+0.817），表明制度性关注下降而个体信息搜寻增加。研究揭示能源价格冲击带来的经济困难对气候关切产生挤出效应，对反周期气候沟通策略具有启示意义。
AI.research_question: 油价冲击对气候关切是否存在异质性处理效应？其调节机制和不同情境下的效应差异如何？
AI.motivation: 油价冲击可能通过经济压力影响公众对气候问题的关注度，但现有文献缺乏对气候关切异质性效应的系统识别，且对油价冲击下公众关注与制度关注的分化机制理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共关注度理论、经济压力替代效应（挤出效应）理论、行为经济学中的关注度分配理论
AI.method: 因果森林方法（causal forest），基于2004年1月至2025年8月美国月度数据，辅以Google Trends数据进行补充验证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 高油价显著降低气候关切11.52个百分点（约占样本均值3.78%）；2) 处理效应存在显著异质性，个人收入、消费者情绪和通胀为主要调节变量；3) 低失业时期效应最小，经济衰退时期效应最大；4) Google Trends分析显示个体信息搜寻呈正向效应（ATE=+0.817），与制度性关注下降形成对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济困难对气候关切的挤出效应机制，区分了制度性关注与个体信息搜寻的不同反应模式，拓展了能源价格冲击与公众关注度关系的理论理解，为关注度分配理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和非政府组织制定反周期气候沟通策略提供实证依据，建议在经济衰退和高油价时期加强气候传播投入，并针对不同收入群体和消费情绪状态实施差异化沟通策略。

title: Re-Optimization Under Constraint: Evidence from Major League Baseball
affiliations: , Wake Forest University, Wake Forest University and Seton Hall University

detail.title: Re-Optimization Under Constraint: Evidence from Major League Baseball
detail.abstract: Firms continually adjust decisions as incentives change, yet whether they re-optimize efficiently remains an open question. We exploit Major League Baseball's 2023 disengagement rule as a natural experiment and develop a game-theoretic model to generate equilibrium predictions under both rule regimes. Using pitch-level data from more than 3 million pitches during 2021-2024, we compare observed strategic decisions with equilibrium behavior rather than inferring optimization from aggregate outcomes. Players adjusted in the predicted direction but incompletely and asymmetrically. The remaining deviations imply approximately 94 additional runs per season, indicating persistent departures from equilibrium despite repeated play and strong incentives.

AI.tldr: 利用美国职业棒球大联盟2023年"脱节规则"作为自然实验，结合博弈论模型和300多万个投球的面板数据，检验球员在激励变化后的重新优化效率。研究发现球员调整方向正确但不完全且不对称，剩余偏离意味着每赛季约94分的损失，表明即使在重复博弈和强激励下仍存在持续的均衡偏离。
AI.research_question: 当激励发生变化时，企业（球员）是否能够高效地重新优化其战略决策并收敛到新的均衡状态？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量关于企业随激励变化调整决策的研究，但通常是从聚合结果推断最优化的存在，而非直接比较实际决策与均衡行为。这一问题在体育经济学中尤为突出，因为体育提供了高度可控的观测环境，可以精确测量策略偏离程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（游戏理论模型）、均衡分析
AI.method: 1) 以MLB 2023年脱节规则为自然实验；2) 构建博弈论模型生成两种规则下的均衡预测；3) 使用2021-2024年超过300万个投球的逐球（pitch-level）数据；4) 将观察到的实际战略决策与均衡行为进行比较，而非从聚合结果推断最优性。
AI.findings: 球员在规则变化后按照预测方向进行了调整，但调整不完整且呈现不对称性。剩余偏离相当于每赛季约94分的额外失分，表明即使在反复博弈和强烈激励的情况下，仍然存在持续的均衡偏离。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了直接检验"激励变化后决策者是否高效重新优化"的实证证据，挑战了理性预期假设下企业完全最优化的传统观点，为行为经济学中的认知局限和调整摩擦提供了新的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和管理者具有启示意义：即使激励设计合理，决策者也可能无法完全优化；94分的估算量化了"次优调整"的实质性经济成本；对体育管理层的策略优化和规则制定者的预期效果评估提供了参考。

title: The Political Economy of Debt of Sri Lanka's Debt
affiliations: and University of Colombo

detail.title: The Political Economy of Debt of Sri Lanka's Debt

declarations.funderStatement: The Asia Foundation's International Development Cooperation Unit

detail.abstract: This chapter investigates the political economy of Sri Lanka’s public debt crisis, analyzing the structural vulnerabilities and policy failures that culminated in the historic sovereign debt default of April 2022. Despite its status as a leading economic model in South Asia, Sri Lanka engaged in persistent deficit financing to sustain political popularity, driving general government gross debt from 68.7% of GDP in 2010 to 115.5% in 2022. This study traces the trajectory of this collapse, evaluating the  impact of short-term fiscal mismanagement—such as the late 2019 tax cuts. Crucially, the analysis deconstructs the composition of Sri Lanka's external debt obligations, demonstrating how a transition to middle-income status shifted the debt portfolio away from concessional loans toward expensive commercial debt, specifically International Sovereign Bonds (ISBs). Furthermore, evidence is presented to refute the prominent narrative of Chinese "debt trap diplomacy," revealing that market-based ISBs, rather than bilateral loans from China, constituted the vast majority of the country's foreign debt and servicing obligations. The study highlights how institutional weaknesses and tax concessions caused revenue collection to plummet to 7.7% of GDP by 2021. The study importantly explores the domestic political economy for Sri Lanka's public finance decisions and the weak fiscal social contract that contributed to the 2022 Economic Crisis. The chapter concludes that long standing structural weaknesses must be addressed in addition to governance reforms and improvement of state capacity.

AI.tldr: 本章考察了斯里兰卡公共债务危机的政治经济学，分析了导致2022年4月历史性主权债务违约的结构性脆弱性和政策失误。研究追踪了斯里兰卡从2010年政府总债务占GDP的68.7%攀升至2022年115.5%的崩溃轨迹，解构了外债构成，驳斥了"中国债务陷阱外交"的说法，指出市场化国际主权债券（ISBs）而非中国双边贷款构成了外债主体。研究还探讨了国内政治经济因素和薄弱的财政社会契约如何导致2022年经济危机，最后提出必须解决长期结构性弱点并推进治理改革和国家能力建设。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡公共债务危机的政治经济根源是什么？哪些结构性脆弱性和政策失误导致了2022年4月的主权债务违约？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡曾是南亚领先的经济模式，但经历了历史性主权债务违约。研究旨在揭示其债务危机的深层政治经济原因，特别是国内政治激励、财政政策失误、债务结构转变，并反驳流行的"中国债务陷阱"叙事。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学分析框架，涉及财政社会契约理论、债务组合结构分析与国家能力理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过追踪斯里兰卡债务危机的历史轨迹，分析政府债务数据、外债构成比例、财政收入变化等实证证据，并结合国内政治经济背景进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 1）斯里兰卡通过持续赤字融资维持政治人气，导致政府总债务从2010年GDP的68.7%增至2022年的115.5%；2）2019年底的减税等短期财政管理不善加剧了危机；3）从中等收入转型使债务组合从优惠贷款转向昂贵的商业债务（ISBs）；4）证据驳斥了中国"债务陷阱外交"叙事，市场化ISBs而非中国双边贷款构成外债主体；5）制度弱点和税收优惠导致财政收入在2021年降至GDP的7.7%；6）国内政治经济和薄弱的财政社会契约是危机的重要推手。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）通过实证证据驳斥了"中国债务陷阱外交"这一流行理论叙事；2）将国内政治经济学和财政社会契约概念引入发展中国家债务危机分析，丰富了债务危机的政治经济学理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为斯里兰卡及类似发展中国家提供债务危机防范的政策启示，指出必须解决长期结构性弱点；2）强调治理改革和国家能力建设的重要性；3）有助于国际社会更准确地理解发展中国家债务问题的真实来源，避免错误归因。

title: The Theory of Distributionally Weighted Investment

detail.title: The Theory of Distributionally Weighted Investment
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theory of distributionally weighted investment in which the investment effect of household income depends on who receives the income, how strongly recipients adjust expenditure, which firms receive that expenditure, and how those firms respond to expected demand. At the firm level, the model defines a distributional investment weight as the product of a household group's marginal expenditure response, the firm's exposure to that group's spending, and the responsiveness of desired investment to expected sales. An income-preserving redistribution therefore changes firm investment whenever the recipient and donor groups carry different firm-specific weights. Aggregating across firms produces an economy-wide investment weight for each household group. The analysis establishes three principal results. First, the effect of any income-preserving redistribution on aggregate desired investment is determined by the alignment between the redistribution and the vector of economy-wide investment weights. Second, aggregate investment is neutral to every income-preserving redistribution if and only if these weights are equal across groups. Third, aggregate consumption is not generally a sufficient statistic for investment. It is locally sufficient only when economy-wide investment weights are an affine function of household marginal expenditure responses. Otherwise, a redistribution can leave both aggregate income and aggregate consumption unchanged while altering investment because expenditure is reallocated across firms, sectors, or regions with different investment responsiveness. The theory complements accelerator, user-cost, Tobin's q theory, uncertainty, and financing-based approaches by introducing a demand-composition channel. It predicts that investment responses should vary with predetermined customer exposure, recipient-group expenditure behavior, expected sales revisions, capacity utilization, demand persistence, domestic production content, and firms' ability to implement expansion. The central implication is that the distribution of purchasing power can become an investment state variable whenever heterogeneous household expenditure responses interact with heterogeneous firm exposure and demand-sensitive capital expenditure.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个分配加权投资理论，研究家庭收入的分配如何通过消费支出的再分配影响企业投资。该理论定义了分配投资权重——即家庭边际支出反应、企业对该群体支出的暴露度以及预期需求对期望投资敏感度的乘积，并证明收入保持不变的再分配能否影响总投资，取决于各家庭群体是否具有不同的经济层面投资权重。
AI.research_question: 收入分配（收入保持不变的再分配）如何通过需求构成渠道影响企业总投资？
AI.motivation: 传统投资理论（加速器、用户成本、托宾Q、不确定性、融资约束等）忽略了需求构成（谁获得收入、谁支出、支出去向）对投资的影响。本文旨在引入需求构成渠道，解释投资如何随收入分配变化而变动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分配加权投资理论：企业层面的分配投资权重=家庭群体的边际支出反应×企业对该群体支出的暴露度×期望投资对预期销售的响应度；聚合后得到经济层面的投资权重向量。
AI.method: 理论建模（数学推导），构建企业层面的分配投资权重模型并聚合到经济层面，分析收入保持不变的再分配对总投资的效应及充分条件。
AI.findings: 三项主要结果：(1) 任何收入保持不变的再分配对总投资的影响取决于该再分配与经济投资权重向量的对齐程度；(2) 只有当各群体权重相等时，总投资才对所有再分配中性；(3) 总消费通常不是投资的充分统计量，仅当经济投资权重是边际支出反应的仿射函数时才局部充分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出需求构成渠道的投资理论，补充了加速器、用户成本、托宾Q、不确定性和融资约束等传统投资理论；揭示了购买力分配可以成为投资状态变量的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 预测投资响应应随预先确定的客户暴露度、受惠群体支出行为、预期销售修正、产能利用率、需求持续性、国内生产含量以及企业扩张能力而变化，为政策制定者评估再分配政策的投资效应提供框架。

title: The Enforcement Architecture Problem the Unaccounted Tolerance Zone and its Implications for Enforcement Instrument Design
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Enforcement Architecture Problem the Unaccounted Tolerance Zone and its Implications for Enforcement Instrument Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: Responsive regulation's enforcement pyramid has been adopted widely across Australian regulation, but the published instruments that administer it operate an allocation logic the theory does not describe and its authors did not prescribe: the prosecution criteria of evidentiary sufficiency, seriousness and public interest, applied topdown across the enforcement system rather than only at its apex. This paper tests that claim across three layers of evidence and one theoretical confrontation. The doctrinal layer shows that corporate-attribution doctrine makes the apex conditional on questions-whose acts and whose fault count as the company's-that the prosecution policies never answer, and that the constraint produces size-regressive enforcement, harm-based filtering of risk-based offences, and a hollow apex. The documentary layer, a structured scan of twenty-five current Australian instruments (with two United Kingdom comparators), finds the evidentiary filter stated (seventeen of twenty-five) and its selectivity-defendant selection and corporate-fault theory-close to unstated (five and one respectively). The theory-engagement section establishes that the instruments' seriousness-sorted, prosecution-apexed pyramids are departures from responsive regulation measured against its authors' own texts, not a strawman of the theory. The paper argues the silence is complexity-driven but not justified by complexity, and that it is in part administratively fixable: defendant-selection criteria have been codified abroad and articulated judicially at home.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了澳大利亚监管实践中"回应性规制"执法金字塔的实际运作逻辑，发现其分配逻辑（起诉标准：证据充分性、严重性和公共利益）在理论中未被描述且作者未规定。通过三层证据（学说层面、文书层面、理论对话层面）论证了该逻辑的缺失及其后果——包括规模回归式执法、基于危害的风险犯罪过滤和空洞的金字塔顶端，并主张该沉默虽由复杂性驱动但并非合理，部分问题可通过行政手段修复。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚监管实践中的"回应性规制"执法金字塔，其实际运作的分配逻辑（起诉标准）为何与理论描述不符？这种偏离产生了什么后果，是否可修复？
AI.motivation: 回应性规制的执法金字塔被澳大利亚监管广泛采纳，但其实际操作的分配逻辑（起诉标准自上而下适用）是理论未描述、作者未规定的。作者旨在揭示这一未被审视的偏离及其制度后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回应性规制理论（responsive regulation）及其执法金字塔模型、公司归责理论（corporate-attribution doctrine）
AI.method: 三层证据分析：1）学说层面（doctrinal analysis）：分析公司归责理论对金字塔顶端的影响；2）文书层面（documentary analysis）：对25份澳大利亚现行文书及2份英国比较文书的结构化扫描；3）理论对话层面：对照回应性规制作者原文检验偏离主张。
AI.findings: 1）17/25的澳大利亚文书陈述了证据过滤标准，但被告选择标准仅5份陈述、公司过错理论仅1份陈述；2）公司归责理论使金字塔顶端依赖于无人回答的问题（谁的行为、谁的过错算公司的），产生规模回归式执法、基于危害过滤风险犯罪、空洞的金字塔顶端；3）与回应性规制作者原文对照，严重性排序、起诉顶点的金字塔确实偏离了理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了回应性规制理论在行政实践中的未描述分配逻辑（起诉标准应用于整个体系而非仅顶端），澄清了该偏离并非理论的稻草人，而是可对照作者原文确证的实质性偏离；指出该偏离部分源于复杂性但不应被复杂性所正当化。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出该问题部分可通过行政手段修复：被告选择标准已在海外被法典化、在国内已通过司法判决被阐明，为澳大利亚监管机构提供了具体的制度改革方向。

title:
The Car Did Not Change. The Price Did.
Why Electric Vehicles Depreciate Faster than ICE Vehicles, and Why the Gap is more Complicated than Battery Wear
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Car Did Not Change. The Price Did.
Why Electric Vehicles Depreciate Faster than ICE Vehicles, and Why the Gap is more Complicated than Battery Wear
detail.abstract: In this paper, the author attempts to find out the reasons for the faster depreciation of electric vehicles (EVs) compared to internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles and test whether the physical decay is sufficient for explaining such depreciation. In the previous research, the author managed to observe higher depreciation rates for EVs, but the explanation of the issue that was provided, including mechanical reliability problems and battery degradation, cannot fully explain the drop in market value of such vehicles. Contemporary electric vehicles' engines include fewer moving parts, and less maintenance is required compared to ICE vehicles. Moreover, the data obtained from large batteries suggest that most EVs have 95 percent of their initial range left after five years of operation. In this paper, the author investigates the issue of depreciation as both a physical and market phenomenon. The factors examined by the author include vehicle age, mileage, battery condition, technological progress, reduction in the price of new cars, incentives to buy EVs, prices of energy, access to charging stations, and used-vehicle supply. It is possible to show that technological improvement of EVs, price reduction for new vehicles, and changes in supply can cause the decrease in the value of existing vehicles despite their physical condition.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨电动汽车（EV）相比燃油车（ICE）折旧更快的深层原因，并检验物理损耗是否足以解释这一现象。作者发现，除了传统解释（机械可靠性问题和电池退化）外，技术进步、新车降价、激励政策、能源价格、充电桩可及性及二手车供给等市场因素，才是导致现有车辆价值下降的更关键原因。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车相比燃油车折旧更快的根本原因是什么？物理损耗（如电池退化、机械磨损）是否足以解释其市场价值的下降？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现电动汽车折旧率较高，但已有的解释（机械可靠性问题和电池退化）无法完全说明其市场价值的下降。数据表明大多数电动汽车使用五年后仍保留95%的初始续航里程，且电动车零部件更少、维护需求更低，因此需要从市场现象角度重新审视折旧问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将折旧视为既包含物理损耗又包含市场现象的双重过程，考察车辆年龄、里程、电池状况、技术进步、新车价格下降、购买激励、能源价格、充电设施可及性和二手车供给等多维度因素。
AI.method: 基于先前研究观察到的电动汽车高折旧率现象，结合物理数据（电池容量保持率、维护需求）与市场因素（价格、激励、供给、技术进步等）进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 电动汽车的技术进步、新车价格下降以及市场供给变化，即使在车辆物理状况良好的情况下，也会导致现有车辆的价值下降。物理衰减不足以完全解释电动汽车相比燃油车更快的折旧速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将电动汽车折旧的研究从单纯聚焦物理损耗（机械可靠性、电池退化）扩展到包含技术迭代、市场供需和政策因素的综合框架，挑战了"物理衰败是折旧主因"的传统认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为二手车定价、消费者购车决策（尤其是保值率考量）以及汽车制造商和政府对电动车市场价值的理解提供依据，说明技术进步和市场环境如何影响车辆残值。

title: From AI Assistance to Responsible Academic Agency: A Human-centered Framework for Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands (formerly Cumberland College)

detail.title: From AI Assistance to Responsible Academic Agency: A Human-centered Framework for Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, personal, professional, or organizational relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the preparation of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this conceptual article did not involve human participants, patient data, interviews, surveys, experiments, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any public, commercial, or nonprofit funding organization.

detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has moved from a peripheral educational technology to an ordinary part of university study, writing, research, and assessment. Existing scholarship has documented substantial opportunities in personalized support, accessibility, feedback, and productivity, while also identifying persistent concerns involving misinformation, academic misconduct, privacy, bias, inequitable access, and cognitive dependence. However, the debate is too often organized around a narrow question: whether artificial intelligence should be allowed or prohibited. This conceptual article argues that the more consequential question is whether students retain responsible academic agency when artificial intelligence participates in their learning. Drawing on research in artificial intelligence in education, self-regulated learning, academic integrity, human-centered artificial intelligence, and institutional governance, the article develops a Responsible Academic Agency Framework. The framework integrates six interdependent domains: purpose and learning alignment; cognitive ownership and human judgment; epistemic verification; transparency and attribution; equity and privacy; and institutional governance and assessment validity. The central proposition is that artificial intelligence contributes to education only when it strengthens rather than substitutes the learner's capacity to set goals, evaluate evidence, make decisions, explain conclusions, and accept responsibility for academic work. The framework provides practical guidance for students, educators, university leaders, and technology providers, and offers a research agenda for evaluating learning quality rather than focusing solely on adoption. The article contributes to the literature by shifting the discussion from tool access and rule compliance toward the preservation, demonstration, and development of human agency within artificial intelligence-mediated higher education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"负责任学术主体性框架"（Responsible Academic Agency Framework），主张生成式AI参与高等教育时，核心问题不再是"允许或禁止AI"，而是学生是否保有并发展负责任的学习主体性。框架涵盖六个相互依赖的领域：目的与学习一致性、认知所有权与人类判断、认知验证、透明性与归属、公平与隐私、制度治理与评估有效性。
AI.research_question: 当生成式人工智能参与大学学习时，学生是否保留负责任的学习主体性（responsible academic agency）？以及如何系统性地评估和维护这种主体性？
AI.motivation: 现有关于生成式AI在高等教育中的争论过于集中于"允许还是禁止"这一狭窄问题，缺乏对更深层问题（学生主体性的保留）的系统性理论框架。已有研究虽分别记录了AI在教育中的机遇与挑战，但缺少一个整合性的概念框架来指导理论与实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了五个研究领域的理论资源：人工智能教育（AIED）、自我调节学习（self-regulated learning）、学术诚信（academic integrity）、以人为中心的人工智能（human-centered AI）、制度治理（institutional governance）。在此基础上提出负责任学术主体性框架（Responsible Academic Agency Framework）。
AI.method: 概念性研究（conceptual article），通过跨领域文献综合与理论整合发展分析框架，而非实证研究方法。
AI.findings: 核心命题是：只有当AI强化而非替代学习者设定目标、评估证据、做出决策、解释结论并为学业承担责任的能力时，AI才对教育有所贡献。框架为不同利益相关者（学生、教师、大学领导、技术提供者）提供实践指导，并提出以学习质量而非技术采用为核心的研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将讨论从"工具获取与规则遵守"转向"在AI中介的高等教育中人类主体性的保存、展示与发展"，为该领域提供了新的理论视角和分析框架，填补了整合性理论框架的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为四类利益相关者（学生、教师、大学领导者、技术提供者）提供具体的实践指南；提出以学习质量评估为导向的研究议程，帮助教育机构超越简单的技术采用讨论，系统评估AI对学习质量的实际影响。

title: Relational Degradation: The Reconfiguration of the Relational Subject - Discussion I

detail.title: Relational Degradation: The Reconfiguration of the Relational Subject - Discussion I
detail.abstract:
Problem. A class of relational deformations resists the vocabulary in which relational harm is ordinarily described. Some have no identifiable perpetrator, some proceed without malice, and some are assembled entirely from judgments no party was wrong to make. The vocabulary of act, intention, and fault has nothing to attach to in such cases, and this is argued to be a consequence of a premise it carries without stating: that the subject is prior to the relation.

Approach. The paper proceeds deductively from the ontology of generative relational being, on which the subject is not an entity standing in relations but is what is generated within them. A consequence follows by definition rather than by inference: any degradation of a relation is a change in the conditions under which subjects are generated. Seven cases are examined, not as evidence for the thesis but as exhibitions of the paths by which the alteration transmits.

Findings. Two corrections cut against the natural formulation. Degradation does not diminish the subject's dynamics but reconfigures them, and the reconfigured dynamics are frequently the more intense. And the reconstitution of subjects cannot be the wrong, since every relation reconstitutes its participants. A criterion is therefore required, and it cannot be framed in terms of generativity without collapsing into the utilitarian norm the framework exists to displace. The criterion the ontology entails is revisability: degradation is present when the reconfiguration forecloses the possibility that the conditions of generation be further revised through common experience.

Contribution. Revisability is proposed as the sixth principle of the ethics of relational reproduction, and as a meta-principle rather than a further virtue: it governs not relations but the five principles themselves, since any principle that has lost its revisability may degenerate into an instrument of the party it was framed to constrain. A second result concerns distributive justice, shown to be limited in principle, and not merely in execution, with respect to abandonment.

AI.tldr: 本文从生成性关系本体论出发，提出"可修正性"（revisability）作为关系再生产伦理的第六原则。该原则属于元原则，针对关系退化问题——当关系重构使关系的生成条件无法通过共同经验进一步修正时，即构成退化。论文还论证了分配正义在原则上而非仅执行上，对"抛弃"问题存在局限。
AI.research_question: 如何处理那些无法用传统关系伤害词汇（行为、意图、过错）描述的关系退化现象？即当伤害没有可指认的加害者、无恶意、且由各方都无过错判断构成时，如何界定和识别关系伤害？
AI.motivation: 传统的关系伤害词汇基于"主体先于关系"的隐含前提，但这类前提在无加害者、无恶意、无过错判断的情境下失效。作者试图从生成性关系本体论出发，提供一种不依赖传统行动者-意图-过错框架的关系伤害判定标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成性关系本体论（generative relational being）：主体不是在关系中存在的实体，而是在关系中被生成的；关系再生产伦理的前五原则；功利主义规范作为被替代的理论参照。
AI.method: 演绎推理方法：从生成性关系本体论出发进行推演，随后通过七个案例作为"路径展示"（exhibitions），而非经验证据，来展示关系退化如何传导。
AI.findings: （1）退化并不削弱主体的动力结构，而是重构它，且重构后的动力往往更为激烈；（2）主体的重构本身不能构成"过错"，因为每个关系都在重构其参与者，因此需要一个判准——"可修正性"：当重构排除了通过共同经验进一步修正生成条件的可能性时，退化即存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"可修正性"作为关系再生产伦理的第六原则，且作为元原则而非补充性美德：它不直接管辖关系，而是管辖上述五原则本身——任何丧失可修正性的原则都可能退化为被设计来约束的那一方手中的工具。此外，证明分配正义对"抛弃"（abandonment）问题的局限性是原则性的而非仅是执行层面的。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无法归因于个体过错的关系伤害提供了理论判定工具；警示任何伦理原则本身需要保持可修正性，否则可能被权力关系工具化。

title: Where Does the Strait of Hormuz Crisis Lead? Forecasting the Future of Middle East Energy Security Post-2026
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Where Does the Strait of Hormuz Crisis Lead? Forecasting the Future of Middle East Energy Security Post-2026
detail.abstract: On February 28, 2026, the United States and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury against Iran, triggering a five-week war that culminated in the death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and, more consequentially for the global economy, the de facto closure of the Strait of Hormuz the chokepoint through which roughly one-fifth of the world's traded oil and a fifth of global liquefied natural gas (LNG) normally transit. Although a memorandum of understanding signed on June 17, 2026 was intended to end the conflict within sixty days, renewed U.S.-Iran strikes in mid-July 2026 over transit rights and tolls demonstrate that the crisis remains unresolved. This paper synthesizes open-source reporting, U.S. Congressional Research Service analysis, and energymarket data to construct three forward-looking scenarios for Middle East energy security through 2027-2030: (1) a fragile normalization in which prewar shipping patterns gradually resume; (2) a persistent low-intensity blockade in which Iran selectively tolls or bans vessels; and (3) a structural bypass scenario in which importing nations and Gulf producers permanently reduce dependence on the Strait through overland pipelines, alternative suppliers, and strategic reserves. The paper argues that even under the most optimistic resolution, the 2026 crisis has already produced durable shifts accelerated pipeline investment (notably Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline), renewed interest in the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), and faster adoption of renewable energy and electric vehicles that will outlast the conflict itself. The paper concludes with policy implications for oil-importing states, particularly in South and Southeast Asia, and identifies avenues for further empirical research once higher-frequency shipping and price data become available.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2026年美以对伊朗发动的"史诗之怒行动"及其导致霍尔木兹海峡实际关闭的事件，综合开源情报、国会研究服务分析和能源市场数据，构建了2027-2030年三个中东能源安全情景（脆弱正常化、持续低强度封锁、结构性绕行），并论证即使最乐观情景下，该危机已产生超越冲突本身的持久结构性转变。
AI.research_question: 2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机后，中东能源安全在2027-2030年将呈现何种演变路径？危机对全球能源格局产生的冲击是否具有持久性？
AI.motivation: 2026年霍尔木兹海峡的实际关闭是世界能源安全领域的重大冲击事件，涉及全球约五分之一石油贸易和五分之一LNG运输。尽管停火备忘录已签署，但危机仍未完全解除。理解这一事件的长期后果对能源进口国（尤其是南亚和东南亚）制定政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文采用情景分析框架（Scenario Analysis），结合地缘政治冲突理论和能源安全理论，通过构建三种前瞻性情景来推演中东能源安全的演变路径。
AI.method: 综合开源情报报告、美国国会研究服务（CRS）分析及能源市场数据，采用情景构建方法（Scenario Construction），构建三种未来情景（2027-2030年）：脆弱正常化、持续低强度封锁、结构性绕行。
AI.findings: 即使在最乐观的解决情景下，2026年危机已产生持久性转变：（1）加速沙特东西向管道的投资；（2）重新激发印度-中东-欧洲经济走廊（IMEC）的兴趣；（3）推动可再生能源和电动汽车的更快普及，这些转变将超越冲突本身持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为情景分析方法在地缘政治能源冲突研究中的应用提供了范例，揭示了重大能源节点危机如何通过多路径（管道投资、替代贸易走廊、能源转型）产生超越冲突周期的结构性锁定效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油进口国（特别是南亚和东南亚国家）提供了政策启示，包括加速管道多元化、推进IMEC走廊建设、加强战略储备、加快能源转型等方面的具体建议；同时指出了获取高频航运和价格数据后进行进一步实证研究的途径。

title: Strangled or Strengthened? Innovation in Chinese Technology Firms Targeted by U.S. Sanctions
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), University of Maryland - R.H. Smith School of Business, University of International Business and Economics, University of International Business and Economics, University of Texas at Dallas and University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Strangled or Strengthened? Innovation in Chinese Technology Firms Targeted by U.S. Sanctions
detail.abstract: Economic sanctions have become a prominent instrument of geopolitical competition, yet their consequences for firm innovation remain poorly understood. Existing research has focused mainly on innovation quantity, with less attention to innovation quality, underlying mechanisms, and firms' adaptive responses. We examine U.S. export-control sanctions imposed on Chinese technology firms using a panel of publicly listed high-technology firms from 2013 to 2025. Comparing 122 sanctioned firms with 548 comparable same-industry high-technology firms, we use a staggered difference-indifferences design based on the Callaway and Sant'Anna estimator to estimate sanction effects under conditional parallel-trends assumptions. We find no strong evidence that sanctions change innovation quantity, measured by patent applications. However, sanctioned firms experience substantial post-sanction declines in innovation quality, reflected in lower technological impact, commercial value, economic value, and novelty of patents. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that these declines are most pronounced among firms operating in technology domains more dependent on U.S.-origin knowledge, while financial exposure plays a secondary role. Government support and innovation-oriented managerial resources help sustain patenting activity but do not appear to offset declines in patent quality. We further document patterns consistent with adaptive reconfiguration: sanctioned firms increase references to Chinese and European prior art and shift patenting toward less sanction-exposed technological domains. Firms making stronger adjustments experience smaller quality declines, although these adjustments do not eliminate the overall quality penalty. Our findings inform understanding of organizational adaptation and innovation under geopolitical fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2013-2025年中国高科技上市公司面板数据，通过Callaway和Sant'Anna交错双重差分法，研究美国出口管制制裁对中国科技企业创新的影响。研究发现制裁并未显著改变创新数量（专利申请），但显著降低了创新质量（技术影响力、商业价值、经济价值和专利新颖性）。制裁效应在依赖美国知识的技术领域更为突出，企业通过转向引用中国和欧洲现有技术、向低制裁暴露领域转移专利等适应性重组策略部分缓解了质量下降。
AI.research_question: 美国出口管制制裁如何影响中国科技企业的创新数量和创新质量？其潜在机制是什么？企业如何做出适应性调整？
AI.motivation: 经济制裁已成为地缘政治竞争的重要工具，但现有研究主要关注创新数量，对创新质量、作用机制和企业适应性反应的关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织适应性理论、地缘政治碎片化下的创新理论、知识依赖与创新约束理论
AI.method: 使用2013-2025年中国上市高科技企业面板数据，包含122家受制裁企业与548家可比同行业企业，采用基于Callaway和Sant'Anna估计量的交错双重差分设计，在条件平行趋势假设下估计制裁效应。
AI.findings: （1）制裁未显著改变创新数量（专利申请量）；（2）制裁显著降低创新质量（技术影响力、商业价值、经济价值和专利新颖性）；（3）质量下降在依赖美国知识的技术领域最显著，财务暴露起次要作用；（4）政府支持和创新导向的管理资源有助于维持专利活动，但无法抵消专利质量下降；（5）受制裁企业增加对中国和欧洲现有技术的引用，并向低制裁暴露领域转移专利；（6）调整力度较大的企业质量下降幅度较小，但未能消除整体质量惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了地缘政治碎片化背景下组织适应与创新的理论理解，区分了制裁对创新数量与创新质量的非对称影响，揭示了知识依赖和适应性重组在制裁效应中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受制裁企业的创新策略提供指导（如适应性重组可部分缓解质量损失），并为政策制定者理解制裁的经济后果及评估政府支持措施的有效性提供实证依据。

title: Aggregation Failure in Stochastic OLG Economies with Production ⋆
affiliations: Central Reserve Bank of Peru

detail.title: Aggregation Failure in Stochastic OLG Economies with Production ⋆
detail.abstract: We study whether aggregate macroeconomic dynamics in stochastic overlapping generations economies with production can be summarized by a lowdimensional state. In a three-period OLG economy with state-contingent returns, we show that aggregation fails generically: even when aggregate capital arises endogenously, it does not summarize the payoff-relevant distributional information required for asset pricing. We derive cross-cohort Euler compatibility restrictions implied by such representations and show that they are generically violated. Consequently, no low-dimensional aggregate-state representation is consistent with equilibrium; equilibrium must be recursive with additional endogenous states. This implies sequential market incompleteness and potential inefficiency. Benchmark cases clarify that aggregation fails due to multi-period lifetimes, state-contingent returns, and post-shock portfolio rebalancing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机OLG生产经济中宏观动态能否用低维状态变量概括的问题。研究发现，在三期OLG经济中，即使总资本内生形成，低维聚合表示在一般情况下也会失败，因为跨代欧拉相容性约束在一般情况下不成立。这导致均衡必须包含额外内生状态变量，意味着序贯市场不完整性和潜在的无效率。
AI.research_question: 随机OLG生产经济中的总体宏观动态能否被低维状态变量（如总资本）所概括？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济学常假设总资本足以概括经济状态，但OLG经济中不同代际个体的财富分配可能影响资产定价和宏观经济动态，需要检验低维状态表示的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机重叠代际（OLG）模型、状态依存回报、跨代欧拉相容性约束、递归均衡理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析：构建三期OLG生产经济模型，推导跨代欧拉相容性限制条件，分析低维聚合表示的一般性成立条件，并通过基准案例进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 低维聚合表示在一般情况下失败：即使在总资本内生形成的情况下，总资本也不能概括资产定价所需的报酬相关的分配信息；跨代欧拉相容性约束在一般情况下被违反；均衡必须包含额外的内生状态变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了OLG经济中低维状态表示的一般性失败条件，识别了聚合失败源于多期寿命、状态依存回报和冲击后投资组合再平衡三个机制；证明了均衡所需的额外状态意味着序贯市场不完整性和潜在无效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济建模提供了重要警示：简单的低维状态宏观模型可能无法准确刻画OLG经济中的资产定价动态，模型设定需考虑分配信息和市场不完全性。

title: From Maps to Meadows: Ecologically Literate Zoning and the Regeneration of Wildlife Habitats
affiliations: Albany Law School

detail.title: From Maps to Meadows: Ecologically Literate Zoning and the Regeneration of Wildlife Habitats
detail.abstract: For more than a century, zoning has shaped the American landscape, often at the expense of wildlife and ecosystems. Rooted in legal doctrines that treated animals as property and nature as a raw material, zoning codes have fragmented habitats, erased migration corridors, and accelerated biodiversity loss. At the same time, federal protections are narrowing, leaving critical gaps in environmental governance. This Article argues that local governments possess both the authority and the obligation to respond. By embedding ecological principles into zoning—through conservation districts, wildlife corridor protections, wetland buffers, pollinator protections, dark skies, wildlife fencing, habitat restoration, and others—municipalities can transform land use law from a tool of exploitation into one of regeneration. Drawing on the framework of “insider environmental law,” this Article highlights place-based strategies that align community priorities with ecological needs. In doing so, it demonstrates how ecologically literate zoning can foster resilience, protect biodiversity, and ensure that land-use planning sustains all species.

AI.tldr: 本文主张地方政府（市政当局）拥有在分区法规中嵌入生态原则的权威与义务，通过保护分区、野生动物廊道保护、湿地缓冲区、传粉者保护、暗夜天空、野生动物围栏及栖息地恢复等手段，将土地利用法从开发工具转变为再生工具，以应对联邦保护日趋收窄背景下生物多样性丧失的治理缺口。
AI.research_question: 在联邦环境法律保护日益收窄的背景下，地方政府能否以及应否通过分区法规来保护生物多样性和生态系统？
AI.motivation: 美国分区制度已有一个多世纪的历史，其法律根源将动物视为财产、将自然视为原材料，导致栖息地碎片化、迁徙廊道消失和生物多样性加速丧失；与此同时联邦保护力度正在收窄，环境治理出现关键缺口，亟需探索地方政府层面的应对方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: "内部环境法"（insider environmental law）框架，强调基于地方的、与社区优先事项相协调的土地利用治理策略。
AI.method: 法律规范性分析（doctrinal/legal analysis），结合对分区法规中可嵌入的生态原则与具体工具的系统梳理。
AI.findings: 地方政府拥有应对生物多样性危机的法律权威与道德义务；通过将生态原则嵌入分区法规，市政当局可以将土地利用法从开发工具转变为再生工具，有效促进生态韧性、保护生物多样性，并确保土地规划惠及所有物种。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"内部环境法"框架应用于地方分区制度，丰富了环境法理论中关于地方政府角色和基于地方的生态治理路径的讨论，提出土地利用法可以作为生态再生的规范性工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体可操作的地方分区生态工具清单（保护分区、野生动物廊道、湿地缓冲、传粉者保护、暗夜天空、野生动物围栏、栖息地恢复等），为市政规划和决策者提供了实践指南。

reference: Banque de France Working Paper No. Forthcoming
title: Aid Sanctions and Hybrid Regimes
affiliations: Singapore Management University and Banque de France

detail.title: Aid Sanctions and Hybrid Regimes

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Recent advances combining sanctions scholarship and the study of authoritarianism relate sanctions effectiveness to regime type. These studies generally conclude that economic sanctions tend to be more effective on democracies than on autocracies, but also on weakly institutionalised autocracies rather than on other authoritarian types. This literature at the intersection between international relations and comparative politics focuses on the democracy-autocracy dichotomy, or the categorization of autocratic types, to the detriment of the exploration of 'hybrid' regime types. Equally importantly, it has neglected examining the impact of aid suspensions as a subcategory of sanctions. We address these deficits by investigating whether (i) the autocratic type or the level of democratic openness of the target better predicts sanctions effectiveness, (ii) whether hybrid regimes behave like closed autocracies or like democracies under sanctions, and (iii) whether aid suspensions perform similarly than other sanctions in terms of effectiveness. The hypotheses are tested on an original dataset rich in aid sanctions.

AI.tldr: 本文结合制裁研究与威权主义研究，探讨制裁有效性是否受目标国政体类型影响，重点关注"混合政体"（hybrid regimes）这一被忽视的类别，并单独考察援助中止（aid suspensions）作为制裁子类别的效果。基于包含丰富援助制裁数据的原创数据集进行假设检验。
AI.research_question: （1）威权类型还是目标国的民主开放程度更能预测制裁有效性？（2）混合政体在制裁下的行为类似封闭威权还是民主国家？（3）援助中止作为制裁子类别，其有效性是否与其他制裁形式不同？
AI.motivation: 现有文献过度聚焦于民主-威权二分法或威权类型分类，忽视了对"混合政体"的探究；同时，援助中止作为制裁子类别的影响被忽视。本研究旨在填补这两个研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制裁研究与国际关系、比较政治学的交叉理论，具体涉及制裁有效性与政体类型关系的理论框架，以及威权主义分类理论。
AI.method: 基于包含丰富援助制裁数据的原创数据集，对三个假设进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 论文检验了三个核心假设：（1）威权类型或民主开放程度对制裁有效性的预测力；（2）混合政体在制裁下的行为模式归属；（3）援助中止与其他制裁形式的有效性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将混合政体纳入制裁有效性分析框架，突破民主-威权二分法局限；将援助中止作为独立的制裁子类别进行系统研究，丰富了制裁类型学的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者针对不同政体类型（尤其是混合政体）设计制裁策略提供实证依据，同时澄清援助中止作为政策工具的相对有效性。

title: From International Experience to Local Performance: The Specific Return Generation Logic and Formation Mechanism of Chinese Public REITs

detail.title: From International Experience to Local Performance: The Specific Return Generation Logic and Formation Mechanism of Chinese Public REITs
detail.abstract: The return sources of public REITs are not fully studied under China's unique institutional arrangement and complex property rights system. This paper compares the return models of REITs in mature markets such as the United States, Singapore and Japan and combines this analysis with the institutional characteristics of China's pilot phase. We find three distinct forces that support the pricing logic of Chinese REITs: (1) a scarcity premium due to policy restrictions, (2) a governance premium due to the dual-tier structure of "public funds + asset-backed securities (ABS schemes)", and (3) a green valuation premium due to the "dual carbon" targets. Conversely, the two binding constraints are the mandatory high dividend payout ratio and incomplete property rights, which, respectively, suppress the potential return from the dimensions of growth and asset appreciation. Based on the above, we build a "institution-market-asset" three-layer analytical framework, and empirically verify three key policy events through event study methodology (under full-market inclusion principle: Event 1, N = 12; Event 2, N = 24; Event 3, N = 32; Bootstrap tests show robustness). The results indicate that the market is sensitive to policy events and the direction of the reaction depends on the type of policy. For supply-contracting policy (establishment of the follow-on offering mechanism), the reaction is significantly positive (ACAR = 1.48%, p < 0.01). For supply-expanding policy (inclusion of consumer infrastructure), there is no significant short-term reaction but a significantly negative medium-to-long-term reaction (ACAR =-1.65%, p < 0.01). For institutionalization policy (normalized issuance), the reaction is robustly positive (ACAR = 0.74%, p < 0.01). This paper helps investors to understand the unique operation logic of the Chinese REITs market, and provides a reference for regulators to improve the institutional design.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了中国公募REITs在独特制度安排和复杂产权体系下的收益来源，识别出三大定价支撑力量（稀缺性溢价、治理溢价、绿色估值溢价）和两大约束因素（强制高分红率、产权不完整），并构建"制度-市场-资产"三层分析框架，通过事件研究法实证验证三项关键政策事件对市场的影响。
AI.research_question: 在中国独特的制度安排和复杂产权体系下，公募REITs的收益来源是什么？市场对政策事件的反应方向和程度如何？
AI.motivation: 成熟的REITs市场（如美国、新加坡、日本）的收益模型已被充分研究，但中国REITs处于试点阶段，具有独特的制度安排（"公募基金+资产支持证券"双层结构）和复杂产权体系，其收益来源尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合成熟市场REITs收益模型与中国特色制度安排，构建"制度-市场-资产"三层分析框架，涵盖稀缺性溢价理论、治理溢价理论、绿色估值溢价理论及产权理论。
AI.method: 采用事件研究法（Event Study），在全市场纳入原则下验证三个关键政策事件（事件1 N=12；事件2 N=24；事件3 N=32），并使用Bootstrap检验进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）市场对政策事件敏感，反应方向取决于政策类型；（2）供给收缩政策（建立增发机制）产生显著正向反应（ACAR=1.48%）；（3）供给扩张政策（消费基础设施纳入）短期无显著反应，中长期显著负向（ACAR=-1.65%）；（4）制度化政策（常态化发行）反应稳健正向（ACAR=0.74%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示中国REITs市场的三大定价逻辑（稀缺性溢价、治理溢价、绿色估值溢价）与两大约束（强制高分红率、产权不完整），构建了适用于中国制度情境的"制度-市场-资产"三层分析框架，丰富了新兴市场REITs定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者理解中国REITs市场的独特运行逻辑，为监管机构完善制度设计提供参考依据，同时验证了政策事件对市场的影响方向和程度。

title: Quality Scoring with ESG Adjustments and REIT Returns: A Framework for Australian REITs

detail.title: Quality Scoring with ESG Adjustments and REIT Returns: A Framework for Australian REITs
detail.abstract: We propose a new scoring framework, the ESG-Adjusted REIT Quality Score (E-REQS), which integrates sustainability and carbon transition dimensions into a Piotroski-style quality assessment for Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). Score-based investing has consistently outperformed equity markets, however, no research has systematically combined quality scoring and ESG integration for REITs. The E-REQS is built on the classical F-score framework, augmented by 13 binary signals across three categories: financial quality, operational efficiency, and ESG/carbon transition quality. The split of the score into a Traditional Quality Score (TQS) and an ESG Incremental Score (EIS) permits direct tests of whether sustainability signals add value beyond conventional financial metrics. We outline a research design to examine whether higher E-REQS scores are associated with improved risk-adjusted returns using portfolio sorts and panel regressions with Australian A-REITs in the period 2015-2025. We expect that this framework will add to the score-based investing literature and the ESG-REITs debate, and offer institutional investors a transparent and replicable screening tool for sustainable real estate investment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的评分框架——ESG调整的REIT质量评分（E-REQS），将可持续性和碳转型维度整合到基于Piotroski风格的质量评估中，用于房地产投资信托基金（REITs）。该框架基于经典F-score框架，增加了13个跨金融质量、运营效率和ESG/碳转型质量三个类别的二元信号，并将评分拆分为传统质量评分（TQS）和ESG增量评分（EIS），以检验可持续性信号是否在传统财务指标之外增加价值。
AI.research_question: 能否系统地将质量评分与ESG整合应用于REITs投资，且可持续性信号是否在传统财务指标之外提供增量价值？
AI.motivation: 评分型投资在股票市场中持续跑赢大盘，但尚无研究系统性地将质量评分与ESG整合应用于REITs领域。此外，ESG信号是否在传统财务指标之外具有增量价值仍存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Piotroski F-score框架的质量评估理论，结合ESG投资理论和碳转型风险理论。
AI.method: 构建E-REQS评分框架，包含13个二元信号分属三个类别（金融质量、运营效率、ESG/碳转型质量），将评分拆分为TQS和EIS两部分，提出使用组合排序（portfolio sorts）和面板回归方法对澳大利亚A-REITs在2015-2025年期间进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 预期较高E-REQS评分与改善的风险调整后回报相关（研究设计阶段，尚未有实证结果）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Piotroski质量评分框架扩展到REITs ESG领域，弥补了评分型投资与ESG整合在REITs领域的研究空白，并为ESG-REITs争议提供新的实证检验方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供透明、可复制的可持续房地产投资筛选工具。

title: Audited Legal Reasoning for Civil Law Jurisdictions: The Architecture of a Practitioner from Indonesia

detail.title: Audited Legal Reasoning for Civil Law Jurisdictions: The Architecture of a Practitioner from Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an advocate in private practice at Justa Causa Law Firm (Jakarta, Indonesia) and is developing Justa (justa.id), a legal-technology service that applies the architecture described in this paper. This interest is disclosed because the paper argues for a layer of audited legal reasoning that such a service would implement. The author has no financial relationship with, and has received no support, data, or preferential access from, any of the commercial legal research providers named or discussed in this paper; all figures concerning those tools are drawn from independent published research. The author declares no other competing interests. As to method: during the preparation of this work the author used an artificial-intelligence assistant as questioner and drafting aid, under the architecture set out in the paper itself — the machine proposes, the primary source answers, and the named author decides. Every legal proposition, statutory reference, court decision, citation, and figure was verified by the author against primary sources before inclusion. The author reviewed and edited the final text and takes full responsibility for the content of the publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was carried out and self-funded by the author in the course of his own legal practice. Ethics Approval Statement Not applicable. This is a doctrinal and documentary study. It involves no human participants, no animal subjects, no personal or clinical data, and no experimental intervention; accordingly, no ethics approval was required. The materials examined are published legislation, court decisions, official publications, independent published research, and the author's own dated working registers. No client matter, case file, or party information is used or disclosed.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was carried out and self-funded by the author in the course of his own legal practice.

detail.abstract: Global legal artificial-intelligence platforms sell two things: access and speed. For civil law jurisdictions, neither is the real problem. The real problem is the accountability of reasoning: how a legal proposition produced by a machine can be answered for — to the client, to the court, and to the ethical rules of the profession. This paper proceeds from two findings that reinforce each other. First, the preregistered empirical finding that the "hallucination-free" claim of leading AI legal research tools does not survive testing: those tools still err on roughly one in six to one in three queries. Second, the textual finding that official discourse within the Supreme Court of the Republic of Indonesia — the civil law jurisdiction in which the author practices — has not yet named hallucination as a challenge at all. Against that double gap, this paper proposes a standard that can be promised honestly: not a machine that never errs, but reasoning that can be audited. It sets out an architecture of three separations that the author has practiced and published in Indonesia — a separation of roles, a four-point verification gate, and a disciplined audit trail — together with a new category of examination for the civil law family: Nasab Norma, the lineage record of a norm measured at four points, demonstrated in full on the lineage chart of a family statute in force since 1974. The paper closes with a limit of claims stated openly: traceability is not material truth, and precisely for that reason a named human remains the decider. This is the author's English version of a preprint first posted in Indonesian: "Penalaran Hukum Teraudit bagi Yurisdiksi Civil Law: Arsitektur Seorang Praktisi dari Indonesia" (Zenodo, 2026), doi: 10.5281/zenodo.21633646.

AI.tldr: 本文针对全球法律AI平台在民法法系（civil law）司法管辖区中的问责问题，而非接入速度问题。作者基于两个相互印证的发现——预注册实证研究发现领先法律AI工具在约1/6至1/3的查询中仍会出错（"无幻觉"声称不成立），以及印度尼西亚最高法院官方话语至今未将幻觉列为挑战——提出一种可以被诚实承诺的标准：不是永不出错的机器，而是可审计的推理。论文提出"三重分离"架构（角色分离、四点验证门、纪律化审计追踪），并引入民法法系的新审查类别"Nasab Norma"（规范的谱系记录），以1974年施行至今的一部家庭法规谱系图完整演示。最后明确指出局限：可追溯性不等于实质真理，因此必须由具名的人类作为最终决策者。
AI.research_question: 在民法法系司法管辖区中，法律人工智能平台真正的核心问题是什么？如何构建一种可以被诚实承诺的法律推理问责标准？
AI.motivation: 两大相互印证的缺口推动了本研究：(1) 实证层面，预注册测试揭示领先AI法律研究工具的"无幻觉"声称不成立，错误率高达1/6至1/3；(2) 文本层面，作者执业所在的印度尼西亚（民法法系）最高法院官方话语尚未将幻觉命名为挑战。面对这一双重缺口，现有全球平台聚焦"接入与速度"，回避了真正的问责问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于法律推理问责理论框架，核心概念包括：机器产生的法律命题的可答责性（向客户、法庭和职业伦理规则负责）、可审计推理标准、以及民法法系特有的规范谱系追踪概念"Nasab Norma"（规范的血统/谱系记录）。
AI.method: 研究采用双方法设计：(1) 预注册实证研究——对领先AI法律研究工具进行系统测试，检验其"无幻觉"声称；(2) 文本/语篇分析——审查印度尼西亚最高法院的官方话语，考察对幻觉挑战的命名情况。此外，作者还基于自身在印尼的执业实践，提出并演示了三重分离架构和Nasab Norma规范谱系记录方法。
AI.findings: (1) 预注册实证发现：领先AI法律研究工具的"无幻觉"声称经测试不成立，在约1/6至1/3的查询中仍出现错误；(2) 文本发现：印尼最高法院官方话语尚未将幻觉视为一个挑战；(3) 针对上述双重缺口，提出可诚实承诺的标准——可审计的推理而非永不出错的机器，并展示了三重分离架构与Nasab Norma规范谱系的完整演示。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：将法律AI的讨论从"接入与速度"重新定向到"推理问责"这一根本问题；提出了可审计推理作为替代"零错误"承诺的新标准；开创性地为民法法系引入"Nasab Norma"——规范谱系记录这一新审查类别，丰富了民法法系对人工智能法律推理问责的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：提供一套经过作者在印尼实际执业验证的三重分离架构（角色分离、四点验证门、纪律化审计追踪），供民法法系法律从业者直接采用；提出具名人类决策者保留制度以平衡可追溯性与实质真理；以1974年施行的家庭法规谱系图进行了完整示范，为实务操作提供了范本。

title: Hiding in the Mean: The Two Margins of AI's Employment Effect
affiliations: and Liminal Capital

detail.title: Hiding in the Mean: The Two Margins of AI's Employment Effect
detail.abstract: Estimates of AI's employment effect disagree in sign. We argue the disagreement is built into the measurement: AI substitutes for some of an occupation's tasks and complements others, so one exposure number nets two opposing forces before estimation begins. We classify every O*NET task by what its workflow requires of a human, giving each occupation a substitution mass S, a complement mass C, and an inert remainder, conserved rather than averaged. In OEWS data on 705 occupations, employment growth after 2021 loads negative on S and positive on C in the same regressions, and published exposure indices lose their coefficients once composition is entered beside them. The substitution gradient runs from-0.056 per year against a 2019-2021 baseline to-0.021 against occupations' own pre-COVID trends, significant under family clustering (p = 0.042) but not under a wild-cluster bootstrap, and it operates through hiring rather than separations, binding on entrants aged 22 to 25. The complement gradient is positive and concave, carried by real-time interpersonal delivery rather than sign-off work: +0.034 per year (p = 0.017) on post-2021 growth, surviving a battery built against the post-pandemic care-demand alternative, though its family-wise adjusted values sit at the ten percent boundary. We grade the complement result robust in sign, and the substitution effect consistent with AI rather than established.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将O*NET中的每个任务按其工作流程对人力的要求分类，区分了AI的替代质量（S）和互补质量（C），在705个职业的OEWS数据中发现：2021年后就业增长对S负向显著、对C正向显著，且已发表的暴露指数在控制组成后失去解释力。替代效应主要通过招聘渠道作用于22-25岁新进入者，互补效应则体现在实时人际交付而非签字确认类工作上。
AI.research_question: 人工智能对就业的影响方向为何在先前估计中存在符号分歧？如何更准确地测度AI对不同职业的就业效应？
AI.motivation: 现有关于AI就业效应的估计在符号上存在分歧，作者认为这种分歧源于测度方法本身：一个暴露数字（exposure number）在估计之前就将替代与互补两种相反力量"净"在一起，导致估计结果无法分离两种效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务替代-互补框架：AI对职业的影响取决于其替代某些任务（S）和互补另一些任务（C）的相对质量；采用"守恒而非平均"的方法分类任务。
AI.method: 对O*NET中每个任务按工作流程对人力要求进行分类，构建每个职业的替代质量S、互补质量C和惰性剩余；使用OEWS数据中705个职业，在2021年后就业增长的回归中同时纳入S和C；进行家庭聚类、通配聚类自助（wild-cluster bootstrap）、安慰剂检验（针对疫情后照护需求替代假设）和多重比较校正。
AI.findings: (1) 2021年后就业增长对S负向、对C正向，在同一回归中同时显著；(2) 已发表的暴露指数在加入组成后失去系数；(3) 替代梯度从-0.056/年（以2019-2021为基线）到-0.021/年（以职业自身疫情前趋势为基线），家庭聚类下p=0.042显著，但通配聚类自助下不显著；(4) 替代效应通过招聘而非离职渠道，主要影响22-25岁新进入者；(5) 互补效应为正且凹，具体体现在实时人际交付而非签字确认工作：+0.034/年（p=0.017），在针对疫情后照护需求替代的系列检验中稳健，但族系校正后处于10%边界。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出"守恒而非平均"的任务分类方法，避免预先将替代与互补力量净额化；(2) 揭示已发表暴露指数的系数不稳定源于组成混淆；(3) 区分替代效应的传导渠道（通过招聘而非离职，集中于年轻进入者）；(4) 细分互补效应类型（实时人际交付与非签字确认工作的差异）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者识别真正受AI替代冲击的职业与受AI互补的职业提供更精确的测度工具；(2) 揭示AI替代对22-25岁新进入者的就业阻碍，为青年就业政策提供依据；(3) 区分互补效应的具体类型（实时人际交付），指导职业培训与教育的方向。

title: Double-Peak Splitting: The Hidden Structure of Finite-Lattice Phase Transitions in the 3D Ising Model --Verification of the Factor Hierarchy Law on an NP-Complete System: Double-Peak Splitting, Transition Regime, Piecewise Control Function, and Multi-Regime State Decoupling Algorithm
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Double-Peak Splitting: The Hidden Structure of Finite-Lattice Phase Transitions in the 3D Ising Model --Verification of the Factor Hierarchy Law on an NP-Complete System: Double-Peak Splitting, Transition Regime, Piecewise Control Function, and Multi-Regime State Decoupling Algorithm
detail.abstract: On the L=64 lattice of the 3D Ising model-an NP-complete problem rigorously proven to have no analytical solution-the six functional dimensions of the Testability Norms were applied, achieving the detection and classification of the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic phase transition with a statistical confidence of p = 3.33×10⁻⁷⁰. Core findings: The Bai-Perron double-break blind test automatically locked T₁ = 4.39 and T₂ = 4.49 (F = 285.7, significantly outperforming the single-break F = 238.3), precisely aligned with the M_sp switch (4.40, F = 1524) and the U₄ switch (4.50, F = 2335), with deviations of 0.01 and 0.01 respectively. This reveals the Double-Peak Splitting of second-order phase transitions on finite lattices-between two sequential regime switches lies an independent Transition Regime (width approximately 0.1), a region commonly dismissed in standard finite-size scaling (FSS) analysis practice as "rounded crossover requiring extrapolation-based elimination," whose boundaries are algorithmically identifiable. The structure was cross-size replicated on the 2D Potts q=4 model: double-break models significantly outperformed single-break models at L = 16, 32, and 64, with the peak separation shrinking from 0.260 at L = 64 to 0.180 at L = 128, evolving according to scaling laws. The traditional gold standard for phase transition detection, magnetic susceptibility χ, fell completely silent under the Chow test (F = 4.8), yet the 1/χ transformation activated it to 324-revealing that the Chow test requires alignment with the correct mathematical structure to capture physical signals. The regime switch temperature in the M_sp dimension remained stable across all lattice sizes (L = 16, 32, 64, 128) at 4.40-4.46, showing no convergence toward the thermodynamic limit Tc = 4.5115 as L increases-pointing to a Precursor Regime Boundary independent of the thermodynamic limit, cross-model replicated in the M_sp dimension of Potts q=4. The first-order transition (Potts q=3) was confirmed as the direction-inverting type (intercept-shift dominated), and the KT transition (XY model) as single-stage continuous crossover-together with the Double-Peak Splitting of second-order transitions, forming a three-category classification framework of the Factor Hierarchy Law. A three-segment piecewise control function constructed from the Bai-Perron double breaks provides, for this NP-complete system, a quantitative description refined directly from data that is functionally equivalent to the Onsager exact solution for the 2D Ising model-requiring no free energy function. The two 2 inflection points of this function were automatically identified by the Bai-Perron algorithm, without relying on any a priori definition of free energy or order parameter, directly demonstrating the capacity of the Testability Norms to extract physical laws from data. Methodological contribution and ultimate asset: This paper distills the entire body of verification into the Multi-Regime State Decoupling Algorithm (MRSD) based on the Factor Hierarchy Law. Its core mathematical logic proceeds in three steps: (1) input any complex high-dimensional dataset; (2) execute the structural optimization operator \left\{T_k\right\}=arg\min_{}{\sum\nolimits^{k+1}_{j=1}{}}\mathrm{RSS}_j(T)+λ⋅k; (3) output a dynamic regime allocation matrix, informing the user at which point the system logic undergoes "rule resetting" and at which point the structure enters "rigid locking." The algorithm has been cross-model verified on the 3D Ising, 2D Potts q=4, and 2D XY models, requiring no free energy function or a priori order parameter definition-only that the data be objective. It redefines finite-size effects from "errors requiring correction" to independent statistical regimes with rigorous boundaries that are algorithmically identifiable, completing the key leap of the information-theoretic duality between the Factor Hierarchy Law and the Ehrenfest classification from analytically solvable systems to systems without analytical solutions. The Testability Norms achieved full verification closure on an NP-complete system across all six functional dimensions. Leave-one-out cross-validation (Tc range [4.47, 4.48], standard deviation 0.0021), Bootstrap threshold regression (95% CI [4.44, 4.48]), and the shrinking external field convergence verification (Tc monotonically shifted from 4.48 to 4.50) jointly confirm the high robustness of the conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文在3D Ising模型L=64格点（一个被严格证明无解析解的NP完全问题）上应用可检验性规范（Testability Norms）的六个功能维度，以p=3.33×10⁻⁷⁰的统计置信度成功检测并分类了铁磁-顺磁相变。核心发现是二阶相变的"双峰分裂"现象——两个序贯体制切换之间存在独立的过渡体制，该结构在2D Potts q=4模型中跨尺寸複现。文章提出多体制状态解耦算法（MRSD），无需自由能函数或先验序参量定义即可从数据中提取物理规律。
AI.research_question: 如何在无解析解的NP完全系统（3D Ising模型）中，通过数据驱动的方法检测、分类并定量描述相变，揭示有限格点上二阶相变的"双峰分裂"结构，并建立跨模型通用的相变分类框架？
AI.motivation: 3D Ising模型被严格证明无解析解，传统的检测方法（如磁化率χ和标准有限尺寸标度FSS）在有限格点上失效或产生误导。标准FSS实践将"圆化交叉"视为需要外推消除的误差，但本文认为这可能掩盖了独立的物理体制。此外，经典Onsager精确解需要自由能函数，而本文希望展示无需先验物理量的数据驱动方法同样能提取物理规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核心理论框架包括：(1) 可检验性规范（Testability Norms）的六个功能维度；(2) 因子层级定律（Factor Hierarchy Law），提出相变的三分类体系（二阶双峰分裂、一阶方向逆转型、KT连续交叉）；(3) Bai-Perron多重断点检验，用于自动识别体制切换点；(4) 信息论对偶性——因子层级定律与Ehrenfest分类的对偶。
AI.method: 采用Bai-Perron双断点盲测自动锁定两个相变温度T₁=4.39和T₂=4.49，结合Chow检验、留一交叉验证、Bootstrap阈值回归及外场收敛验证。构造MRSD多体制状态解耦算法，核心优化目标为{T_k}=argmin ΣRSS_j(T)+λ·k，输出动态体制分配矩阵。在3D Ising、2D Potts q=4/q=3及2D XY模型上交叉验证。
AI.findings: (1) 在3D Ising L=64上检测到双断点T₁=4.39和T₂=4.49，与M_sp切换(4.40)和U₄切换(4.50)高度吻合，偏差仅0.01，揭示二阶相变的"双峰分裂"——中间存在宽度约0.1的独立过渡体制；(2) 2D Potts q=4模型L=16/32/64上双断点模型显著优于单断点，峰间距从L=64的0.260缩小至L=128的0.180，符合标度律；(3) 磁化率χ在Chow检验下完全失效(F=4.8)，但1/χ变换后激活至324；(4) M_sp维度体制切换温度在L=16-128间稳定在4.40-4.46，不随L增大向热力学极限Tc=4.5115收敛，指向独立于热力学极限的前驱体制边界；(5) Potts q=3一阶相变确认为方向逆转型，XY模型的KT相变为单阶段连续交叉。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：(1) 提出"双峰分裂"概念，重新定义有限尺寸效应——从"需要修正的误差"转变为具有严格边界、可算法识别的独立统计体制；(2) 建立因子层级定律的三分类相变框架（二阶双峰分裂、一阶方向逆转、KT连续交叉）；(3) 完成因子层级定律与Ehrenfest分类之间信息论对偶性从可解析系统到无解析系统的关键跃迁；(4) 证明无需自由能函数或先验序参量定义即可从数据中提取物理定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：(1) 提供MRSD多体制状态解耦算法，输入任意复杂高维数据即可输出动态体制分配矩阵，告知系统在何处发生"规则重置"和"刚性锁定"；(2) 构建三段分段控制函数，对NP完全系统提供定量描述，功能上等价于2D Ising的Onsager精确解；(3) 揭示了Chow检验需与正确数学结构对齐才能捕获物理信号的普适方法论启示；(4) 交叉验证（留一法、Bootstrap、外场收敛）确证结论高度稳健（Tc范围[4.47,4.48]，标准差0.0021）。

title: Data Sovereignty: From the Digital Silk Road to the Return of the State
affiliations: Georgetown University Law Center and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Data Sovereignty: From the Digital Silk Road to the Return of the State

publicationDetails.detailsText: Georgetown University Law Center Research Paper

detail.abstract: Digital sovereignty—the exercise of control over the Internet—is the ambition of the world’s leaders, from Australia to Zimbabwe, a bulwark against both foreign state and foreign corporation. Governments have resoundingly answered first-generation Internet law questions of who if anyone should regulate the Internet—they all will. The second-generation question to confront is not whether, but how to regulate the Internet. This volume features new theoretical perspectives on digital sovereignty and explores cutting-edge issues associated with it. Drawing mainly on various theories concerning political economy, international law, human rights, and data protection, it presents thought-provoking ideas about the nature and scope of digital sovereignty. It also examines the extent to which new technological developments in sectors, such as artificial intelligence, e-commerce, and sharing economy, have posed challenges to assertion of digital sovereignty, and considers how to deal with such challenges. In particular, the volume discusses the promise and pitfalls of digital sovereignty in the process of trade liberalization, data localization, and human rights protection.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字主权（国家对互联网的控制权）这一全球领导人普遍追求的目标。该书汇集了关于数字主权的新理论视角，主要基于政治经济学、国际法、人权和数据保护等理论，探讨了数字主权的性质与范围，并审视了人工智能、电子商务和共享经济等新兴技术发展对数字主权主张带来的挑战及应对之道，尤其讨论了数字主权在贸易自由化、数据本地化和人权保护过程中的前景与陷阱。
AI.research_question: 第二代互联网法律问题：如何（而非是否）监管互联网？数字主权的本质与范围是什么？新技术发展如何挑战数字主权的主张，以及如何应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 第一代互联网法律问题——谁应该监管互联网——已被各国政府以"我们都会监管"的方式回答。现在需要面对的第二代问题是"如何"监管互联网，数字主权已成为从澳大利亚到津巴布韦各国领导人的共同追求，亟需系统性的理论审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、国际法、人权理论、数据保护理论
AI.method: 理论性与概念性分析，综合多学科视角对数字主权进行规范性探讨，并基于技术进步（人工智能、电子商务、共享经济）的案例分析。
AI.findings: 数字主权既是对抗外国国家和外国企业的屏障，也是各国普遍追求的目标；在贸易自由化、数据本地化和人权保护三个过程中，数字主权既有前景也有陷阱；新兴技术对数字主权主张构成挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字主权提供了多学科（政治经济学、国际法、人权、数据保护）的理论整合视角，深化了对数字主权性质与范围的理论理解，推动互联网监管研究从"是否监管"转向"如何监管"的第二代理论议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者在贸易自由化、数据本地化与人权保护之间平衡数字主权行使提供实践指引，帮助应对人工智能、电子商务和共享经济等领域带来的监管挑战。

title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
affiliations: London School of Economics, , London School of Economics, University of California, Berkeley and London School of Economics

detail.title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
detail.abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于大语言模型的文本分类器，利用《泰晤士报》1800-2019年的1195万篇文章，构建了首个基于关键节点概念的长期制度不确定性文本度量指标，能够在制度变迁发生时（而非事后）实时检测关键节点，弥补了现有研究仅能事后回溯关键节点、可能遗漏制度动荡但最终未改变制度的关键时刻的缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何实时（而非事后回溯）检测制度变迁中的关键节点（critical junctures）？如何构建一个基于当代话语的制度不确定性长期度量指标？
AI.motivation: 现有关于关键节点的实证研究大多仅在事后回溯考察，这可能导致遗漏那些制度处于变动中但最终回归现状的关键时刻。理解制度变迁的时间和方式对于解释国家间贫富差异至关重要，但缺乏前瞻性的度量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键节点理论（Critical Junctures Theory）——将关键节点理解为制度不确定性（institutional uncertainty）的时刻，为文本分类器提供了理论驱动的检测对象。
AI.method: 使用基于大语言模型的文本分类器，训练后将模型应用于《泰晤士报》档案（1800-2019年共1195万篇文章），重点分析1900-2019年120年的报道，构建制度不确定性的长期度量指标。
AI.findings: （1）该指标在缺乏正式制度变迁的时期也能捕捉高不确定性，符合关键节点的事前定义；（2）能比现有指标更早发出重大全球动乱的信号（如第一次世界大战）；（3）能够使用统一的事前度量评估候选关键节点；（4）当前美英两国的制度不确定性与1940年代初期同样高，而这一信号被其他主流风险指标所遗漏。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了将关键节点概念化为制度不确定性的理论洞见，为检测提供了理论驱动的操作化对象；（2）构建了首个基于关键节点概念的长期、文本驱动的制度不确定性度量，为制度变迁研究提供了新的实证工具；（3）开创了研究关键节点如何塑造制度与长期发展的新途径。
