detail.title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Knowledge Management Support for Public Policymaking: Trends, Gaps, and Future Directions

publicationDetails.detailsText: System Engineering and Productivity, Volume 6, No. 2. Pp. 79-112.

detail.abstract: Data from 317 articles published between 1997 and 2025 were analyzed using the Scopus and Web of Science databases. • The field has an annual growth rate of 6.61%, with the UK, Australia, and Canada leading the research landscape. • The findings highlight critical knowledge gaps and opportunities for scientific collaboration to enhance policymaking.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于Scopus和Web of Science数据库，分析了1997年至2025年间发表的317篇学术文章，揭示了该领域年均增长率为6.61%，英国、澳大利亚和加拿大处于研究前沿，并指出了关键知识空白和加强政策制定的科学合作机会。
AI.research_question: 该领域的研究现状、发展趋势、主要研究力量分布以及存在哪些知识空白和合作机会？
AI.motivation: 通过对文献的系统分析，识别该领域的知识缺口和合作潜力，以期为政策制定提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论与科学合作网络分析框架。
AI.method: 使用Scopus和Web of Science数据库进行系统的文献计量分析，涵盖317篇发表于1997-2025年间的文章，分析增长趋势、国家分布和合作模式。
AI.findings: 该领域年均增长率为6.61%；英国、澳大利亚和加拿大是该领域研究的领先国家；研究揭示了关键的知识空白，并指出了通过科学合作增强政策制定的机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 为该领域的知识体系提供了系统的文献梳理和现状评估，识别了研究前沿与发展态势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了科学依据，明确了需要填补的知识空白及跨国科学合作的方向，有助于提升政策制定的科学性和有效性。

title: An Empirical Analysis of Bonus Feature Outcomes in Online Video Slots

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis of Bonus Feature Outcomes in Online Video Slots

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and operator of casinoaftaler.dk, a Danish-language affiliate website reviewing licensed online casinos regulated by Spillemyndigheden (the Danish Gambling Authority). Revenue is generated through affiliate partnerships with a subset of the operators referenced in the underlying dataset. The dataset itself is a complete, unfiltered record of all bonus feature outcomes observed during live sessions and is not conditioned on operator partnership status. The author declares this commercial relationship in the interest of full transparency; it did not influence the empirical measurements, sampling procedure, or statistical analysis reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human subjects, patients, or personally identifiable information. The dataset consists solely of aggregated outcomes from bonus features triggered on publicly licensed online slot games during the author's own gambling sessions. No third-party player data was collected or analyzed. Ethics committee approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data collection, curation, and analysis were conducted independently by the author. Infrastructure and operational costs were covered by SoMe Entertainment.

detail.abstract: This working paper documents an empirical corpus of bonus feature outcomes recorded from online video slot games between 2024 and 2026. Over the observation window, 9,389 individual bonus openings were captured across 392 discrete sessions ('bonus hunts'), with each opening linked to a specific game title, a fixed monetary stake, and a resulting payout expressed as a return multiple of the stake. The corpus contains 2,624 openings that returned at least 100× the stake and a maximum observed multiplier of 20,000×. This paper presents the data collection protocol, describes the aggregate distribution of return multiples, and discusses the methodological limitations that constrain inference from convenience-sampled bonus outcomes. The full anonymised dataset is archived on Zenodo under a CC BY 4.0 licence to enable independent replication and re-analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文档记录了一个2024-2026年间在线视频老虎机游戏奖励结果的实证语料库，包含9,389次奖励开奖记录（392个"奖励狩猎"会话），记录了每次开奖的游戏名称、固定下注金额及以回报倍数表示的派彩结果。语料库包含2,624次回报至少100倍的记录，最大观测倍数为20,000倍。论文介绍了数据收集协议、回报倍数的分布特征，并讨论了便利抽样奖励结果推断的方法论局限性。完整匿名数据集已存档于Zenodo（CC BY 4.0许可）以支持独立复现。
AI.research_question: 在线视频老虎机游戏奖励功能结果的回报倍数分布特征是什么？便利抽样的奖励数据对推断有何方法论局限？
AI.motivation: 在线视频老虎机游戏的奖励功能结果缺乏公开、系统的经验数据，阻碍了独立研究和复现；本文旨在提供一个公开可用的实证语料库以填补这一数据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文未明确采用特定理论框架，主要属于描述性实证研究，涉及抽样方法论（便利抽样）与数据可复现性方面的方法论考量。
AI.method: 数据收集：在2024-2026年间通过392次"奖励狩猎"会话捕获9,389次奖励开奖记录；每次记录包含游戏标题、固定下注金额和回报倍数。数据分析：描述性统计呈现回报倍数的聚合分布。数据归档：匿名化数据集存放于Zenodo（CC BY 4.0许可）。
AI.findings: 语料库包含9,389次奖励开奖记录；其中2,624次（约28%）回报至少100倍；最大观测回报倍数为20,000倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为奖励结果研究提供了首个公开可复现的实证语料库，明确了便利抽样数据的推断局限，为后续方法论的改进奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供匿名化数据集和详细数据收集协议，使研究者能够独立验证和重新分析结果，促进该领域研究的透明性和可复现性。

title: Exponentially Biased Debt Repayment Weight

detail.title: Exponentially Biased Debt Repayment Weight

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study did not involve human participants, patient data, animals, or identifiable personal data. All numerical examples are hypothetical and illustrative.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This technical note defines the Exponentially Biased Debt Repayment Weight, a closed-form method for ranking indebted users from repayment history. Each repayment is normalized by a fixed reference debt amount and weighted by an exponential recency function, producing a transparent score that emphasizes recent repayment behavior while retaining a controlled contribution from older history. The standard form uses an asymptotic exponential decay function. An extended form introduces boundary-condition coefficients that force the decay function to reach exactly zero at a specified cutoff period. The method requires no model training, labelled outcomes, demographic features, or third-party behavioral data. It is presented as an independent, non-peer-reviewed technical note and should be understood as a repayment-ranking heuristic rather than a calibrated credit-risk model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种指数偏倚债务还款权重（Exponentially Biased Debt Repayment Weight），这是一种基于还款历史对负债用户进行排名的闭式方法。该方法将每次还款按固定参考债务金额归一化，并通过指数近因函数加权，从而生成一个强调近期还款行为、同时保留较旧历史贡献的透明评分。标准形式采用渐近指数衰减函数，扩展形式引入边界条件系数使衰减函数在指定截止期精确归零。该方法无需模型训练、标注结果、人口统计特征或第三方行为数据。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种无需模型训练且透明的闭式方法，仅基于还款历史对负债用户进行有效排名？
AI.motivation: 现有的信用评分模型通常需要大量标注数据、模型训练和第三方行为数据，这在数据稀缺或需要透明可解释性的场景下难以适用。作者旨在提出一种简单、透明且无需训练的还款排名启发式方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 指数衰减函数（指数近因加权）、归一化还款比率、边界条件约束的衰减函数
AI.method: 闭式公式方法：将每次还款除以固定参考债务金额进行归一化，再用指数近因函数加权求和。标准形式使用渐近指数衰减；扩展形式引入边界条件系数使衰减函数在截止期精确归零。
AI.findings: 该方法无需模型训练、标注结果、人口统计特征或第三方行为数据即可生成还款排名评分，能强调近期还款行为并保留旧历史的受控贡献。扩展形式可强制衰减函数在指定截止期归零。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种新的还款排名启发式方法，将指数近因加权与归一化还款相结合，并引入边界条件扩展形式，为还款行为量化提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据稀缺或缺乏标注场景下的用户还款排名提供了一种透明、可解释、无需训练成本的实用工具，可作为信用风险评估的补充启发式方法。

title: Transforming Urban Futures: A Comprehensive Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Applications in Urban Planning and Smart City Development

detail.title: Transforming Urban Futures: A Comprehensive Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Applications in Urban Planning and Smart City Development
detail.abstract: The accelerating pace of global urbanisation has placed unprecedented pressure on city infrastructure, governance, and resource management systems. Traditional urban planning methodologies, largely developed in the twentieth century, are becoming insufficient to address complex, interconnected urban challenges, including traffic congestion, pollution, energy inefficiency, and inequitable public-service delivery. This paper presents a rigorous examination of the multifaceted impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on urban planning and smart-city development. We systematically analyse the enabling technology stack-comprising Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), the Internet of Things (IoT), Big Data Analytics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and Digital Twins-that collectively forms the backbone of intelligent urban ecosystems. AI application domains investigated include adaptive traffic signal control, demand-responsive waste collection, smart-grid energy optimisation, water-network anomaly detection, predictive public safety, AI-assisted healthcare dispatch, and environmental airquality forecasting. Drawing on documented case studies from Singapore, Barcelona, Dubai, and Indian cities under the Smart Cities Mission, we evaluate the real-world effectiveness and scalability of AI-driven urban solutions, synthesising quantitative performance benchmarks across deployments. A structured analysis of challenges-encompassing algorithmic bias, surveillance ethics, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, digital inequality, and fiscal barriers-is presented alongside mitigation frameworks. The paper concludes with a forward-looking perspective on emerging paradigms including autonomous vehicles, generative AI in urban design, AI-powered Digital Twin operating systems, 6Genabled ultra-dense sensing, Green AI, and quantum-accelerated optimisation. We argue that ethically responsible and inclusive AI implementation, grounded in transparent data governance, is essential for cities that are not only intelligent but also equitable, resilient, and sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地审视了人工智能（AI）对城市规划和智慧城市发展的多方面影响，涵盖了从机器学习、深度学习、物联网、大数据分析、GIS到数字孪生的使能技术栈，分析了AI在城市交通、废物管理、能源、水资源、公共安全、医疗调度和环境监测等领域的应用，并基于新加坡、巴塞罗那、迪拜及印度智慧城市任务的案例研究评估了实际效果，最后讨论了算法偏见、监控伦理、网络安全等挑战及未来新兴范式。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响城市规划与智慧城市发展？其使能技术栈、应用领域、实际效果、面临的挑战及未来发展方向分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球城市化加速给城市基础设施、治理和资源管理带来前所未有的压力，传统城市规划方法论已不足以应对交通拥堵、污染、能源低效和公共服务不公等复杂互联的城市挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以AI使能技术栈为理论基础，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、物联网、大数据分析、GIS和数字孪生，共同构成智能城市生态系统的技术基础。
AI.method: 系统文献分析与案例研究方法，基于新加坡、巴塞罗那、迪拜及印度智慧城市任务的实证案例，结合量化性能基准的综合评估。
AI.findings: AI驱动的城市解决方案在实际部署中展现出有效性，但仍面临算法偏见、监控伦理、网络安全漏洞、数字不平等和财政障碍等挑战；未来应关注自主车辆、生成式AI、AI驱动的数字孪生操作系统、6G传感、绿色AI和量子优化等新兴范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI应用于城市规划与智慧城市发展的系统性分析框架，整合了技术与治理层面的综合视角，并提出了面向伦理责任和包容性AI实施的概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市管理者提供了AI解决方案的实证绩效基准和现实可扩展性评估，提出了应对算法偏见、监控伦理、网络安全等挑战的缓解框架，以及确保公平、韧性、可持续城市发展的数据治理指导原则。

title: Rethinking The Work Product Doctrine For The AI Era: Why Matters More Than Who Or When
affiliations: University of Miami - School of Law

detail.title: Rethinking The Work Product Doctrine For The AI Era: Why Matters More Than Who Or When
detail.abstract:
Lawyers worldwide now routinely rely on generative and agentic AI tools—general-purpose tools like Claude and ChatGPT and legal platforms like Harvey, Legora, and CoCounsel—to analyze transactions, assess risk, draft documents, and shape legal advice. Drawing on 50 interviews with senior in-house lawyers, partners, legal-operations leaders, and corporate executives, this Article demonstrates that AI is already embedded in legal work. Yet whether the work product doctrine protects these materials remains unresolved. Five decisions from 2024-2026 frame the debate. United States v. Heppner, 820 F. Supp. 3d 292, 294 (S.D.N.Y. 2026) held that documents a criminal defendant generated using an open, consumer AI platform were not privileged or protected as work product. Warner v. Gilbarco, Inc., 820 F. Supp. 3d (E.D. Mich. Feb. 10, 2026) reached the opposite conclusion, holding that AI-assisted litigation materials constitute protected work product and that treating AI tools as third parties for waiver purposes would "nullify work-product protection in nearly every modern drafting environment." Morgan v. V2X, Inc. (D. Colo. Mar. 30, 2026) substantially extended Warner, analogizing AI to email, phones, and smart devices, and introduced AI-specific protective order language. Two earlier cases in the Northern District of California, Tremblay v. OpenAI, Inc. and Concord Music Group, Inc. v. Anthropic PBC, had already held that AI prompts crafted by counsel reflect mental impressions and litigation strategy i.e., opinion work product that is virtually undiscoverable.  However, the critical unresolved question is how courts will and should apply the work product doctrine going forward. 

In addition to recommending that parties and attorneys use closed, confidential AI systems whenever possible to ensure work product protection, this Article makes three main arguments. First, who prepared the work product shouldn't matter. Attorney involvement or direction should not be required. The focus should be on the “why” not the “who” especially since there will be AI-generated content that is not created by any person per se.

Second, the anticipation of litigation requirement is construed too narrowly and unequally as related when the duty of preservation begins. Ironically, when the courts are determining when the duty of preservation of documents begins it is based on a much broader interpretation of the anticipation of litigation. In work product, some courts demand a unilateral belief that is more than probable and also that the litigation is imminent or impending in time. Therefore, potential parties who use AI for legal research before the anticipation of litigation requirement is met, have no protection under the work product doctrine. As such, they are creating discoverable records that can establish corporate knowledge, willfulness, and scienter. Recent cybersecurity cases demonstrate how the "anticipation" requirement fails even when litigation is probable. Applied to AI, this gap is magnified because AI creates comprehensive, timestamped logs of every query. However, when applying the duty of preservation, courts only require that there be a reasonable good faith that litigation is credibly probable (regardless of when). Therefore, this Article recommends the courts use the same standard as in the preservation requirement along with a why analysis (whether because of or primary purpose) instead of the currently narrow when analysis applied.

Third, the ordinary course of business exception is too broad and, given the way AI is used today, should be eliminated. My prior article on the subject argued that the ordinary course of business exception enables courts to deny protection by infusing their narrow view of the corporate attorney's role into the analysis thereby making the distinction between "business" and "law" outcome-determinative.  For AI, this problem is existential: as AI becomes the ordinary course of business for law firms and legal departments (and it already is for many), the exception threatens to swallow the rule entirely. If every legal department and law firm uses AI daily for everything—contract review, regulatory research, risk assessment—then all AI-assisted work product could be characterized as "ordinary course of business." Therefore, this Article concludes that the recommendation of my prior article to eliminate the business/law distinction from the work product analysis applies with even greater force to AI, where the distinction has gone from "arbitrary and impossible" to unworkable because the same tool, in the same session, can perform both legal and business analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文基于50个资深律师、法务负责人及企业高管的访谈，论证AI已深度嵌入法律工作，但现行工作成果保护原则（work product doctrine）尚无法妥善应对。文章提出三大论点：应关注"为何"而非"由谁"准备、应采用与证据保全义务一致且更宽的"预见诉讼"标准、应废除"日常业务例外"规则，以保障AI辅助法律工作的保密性与可发现性边界。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI和智能体已深度嵌入法律工作的背景下，法院应如何适用工作成果保护原则（work product doctrine）以正确界定AI辅助法律材料的可发现性与特权保护范围？
AI.motivation: 法律实务中律师已普遍依赖AI工具（如ChatGPT、Harvey等）进行交易分析、风险评估和文件起草，但工作成果保护原则是否覆盖这些材料仍不确定。2024-2026年间的五个判例（Heppner、Warner、Morgan、Tremblay、Concord Music）给出了相互矛盾或存在缺陷的结论，亟需对该原则进行系统性反思和重构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作成果保护原则（work product doctrine）及其相关子规则，包括：1）"由谁准备"（attorney involvement）要求；2）"预见诉讼"（anticipation of litigation）标准；3）"日常业务例外"（ordinary course of business exception）；以及与证据保全义务（duty of preservation）标准的对比分析。
AI.method: 质性访谈法：对50位资深内部法务律师、合伙人、法务运营负责人和公司高管进行深度访谈；辅以判例分析法：对2024-2026年间五个关键判例（Heppner、Warner、Morgan、Tremblay、Concord Music）进行法律比较与评析。
AI.findings: 1）AI已深度嵌入法律工作，但法院对AI辅助材料的工作产品保护态度分裂：Heppner案否认保护，Warner案和Morgan案支持保护，Tremblay和Concord Music案承认AI提示词属于意见工作产品；2）"由谁准备"要求已不适用AI环境；3）"预见诉讼"标准过窄且与证据保全义务标准不一致；4）"日常业务例外"因AI的普遍使用将被过度扩张，威胁吞噬工作产品保护规则本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出应将工作产品保护的核心从"由谁"（who）转向"为何"（why），以适应AI生成内容无自然人创作者的现实；2）主张"预见诉讼"应采用与证据保全义务一致的标准（合理善意相信诉讼可信地可能发生），并辅以目的分析（whether because of or primary purpose）；3）强化先前研究的主张，认为应彻底废除"日常业务例外"和"业务/法律"区分，因AI工具的同一会话即可同时完成法律与业务分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）建议律师和当事人尽可能使用封闭、保密的AI系统以确保工作产品保护；2）建议在诉讼中引入AI特定的保护令用语（protective order language）；3）为法院、律师和公司法务提供处理AI辅助材料特权与可发现性争议的规范性指引。

title: Targeted Repression and Political Repertoire Compression: Evidence from the Ansei Purge in Japan
affiliations: Soka University

detail.title: Targeted Repression and Political Repertoire Compression: Evidence from the Ansei Purge in Japan
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether targeted repression changes not only the level but also the composition of recorded political activity. I examine the Ansei Purge of 1858-1860 in Japan, when coercive enforcement focused on politically salient networks during the treaty and succession crisis. Overt political activity exposed political ties to regime scrutiny, while learning and training activity could operate through less public capability networks. I assemble a monthly prefecture panel from the Historiographical Institute's Summary database of the Ishin Shiryō and separate visible movement-side mobilization from lower-visibility knowledge building. The design interacts the October 1858 enforcement onset with source-side Ii-family political visibility and a combined measure of pre-1858 Westernlearning and medical-learning capacity. Visible movement-side activity contracts where both exposures are high, while knowledge-building activity does not rise in parallel: the shift toward knowledge-side activity reflects fewer mobilization records, not more knowledge production. Placebo timing, negative-control outcomes, exposure-definition variants, permutation inference, and phase-based sensitivity checks confirm this timing and movement-side pattern. The evidence indicates that targeted coercion changed which forms of political activity remained visible, without eliminating the underlying capability networks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究定向镇压如何改变被记录的政治活动的构成而非仅改变其水平。利用日本1858-1860年安政大狱作为自然实验，发现镇压使显性政治动员活动减少，但知识建设活动并未相应增加——这种构成变化源于镇压减少了动员记录，而非增加了知识产出。
AI.research_question: 定向镇压是否不仅改变政治活动的水平，还改变其构成？
AI.motivation: 理解威权政权下镇压如何影响政治活动，特别是镇压是否会改变政治活动的形态（从显性动员转向低可见度的知识建设活动）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 镇压与政治活动构成的理论框架，区分显性政治动员网络与低可见度知识能力网络。
AI.method: 使用历史文献数据库构建月度府级面板数据，采用双重差分设计（安政大狱强制执行为处理变量），结合伊井家族政治可见度和1858年前西方学习与医学学习能力的综合测量，并进行安慰剂检验、负面控制结果、暴露定义变体、置换推断和分阶段敏感性检验。
AI.findings: 在政治可见度和知识能力均较高的地区，显性运动侧活动显著收缩，但知识建设活动并未同步上升；从显性活动向知识活动的转变反映的是动员记录减少，而非知识产出增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了定向镇压如何改变政治活动的可见构成，而非根本消除底层能力网络；为理解镇压对政治活动形态选择的影响提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究威权体制下的镇压策略、政治活动形态转移及历史计量方法提供了方法参考。

title: The Capital-Efficiency Trilemma in Consolidated Industries: A Practitioner-Scholar Framework for Market-Velocity Governance, Trust-Based Scale, and Operational Resilience
affiliations: Independent Practitioner

detail.title: The Capital-Efficiency Trilemma in Consolidated Industries: A Practitioner-Scholar Framework for Market-Velocity Governance, Trust-Based Scale, and Operational Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. No conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on practitioner case evidence from enterprise programs in which the author held direct executive responsibility. All organizational references have been anonymized where appropriate to protect confidentiality. No human subjects research, patient data, or formal experimental methodology was employed. Formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was self-funded by the author as an independent practitioner-scholar contribution.

detail.abstract: The dominant paradigm of corporate strategy in consolidated, regulated service industries has operated on a durable premise: scale wins. Larger organizations, with deeper balance sheets, broader referral networks, and superior purchasing power, were assumed to possess structural competitive advantages that smaller, more agile competitors could not overcome. This premise is failing. A structural shift — the convergence of hyper-localized geographic competition, assetlight operational models, and governed artificial intelligence deployment — is creating a new competitive dynamic in which velocity of market entry and depth of digital integration generate competitive advantages that raw corporate scale cannot replicate and frequently cannot respond to in time. This paper introduces the Capital-Efficiency Trilemma: a structural governance constraint in consolidated industry strategy that formalizes three simultaneously non-negotiable competitive dimensions — deployment velocity, capital efficiency, and trust-based governance — as structurally interdependent variables resistant to sequential optimization. Derived from the same macroeconomic structural logic that grounds the AIconomics Trilemma in organizational AI governance, the Capital-Efficiency Trilemma establishes that organizations in consolidated markets cannot simultaneously maximize speed-to-market, capital efficiency, and trustgovernance integrity under conventional capital-heavy expansion models, and that the failure to recognize this structural constraint produces characteristic, predictable competitive failure modes. The paper introduces the OTR Framework — Outpace, Trust, Resilience — as the operational model for navigating the Trilemma, the Market-Timing Paradox as the empirical mechanism through which legacy scale converts from competitive advantage to competitive liability, and the 5:1 Capital Investment Discipline as the bridge connecting the Capital-Efficiency Trilemma to the AIconomics organizational governance frameworks published in prior work. The paper is grounded in publicly available empirical data on industry consolidation dynamics and is positioned as a practitioner-scholar contribution at the intersection of competitive strategy, industrial organization economics, and enterprise AI governance. Six testable propositions establish an empirical research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"规模即优势"的传统公司战略范式，提出资本效率三难困境（Capital-Efficiency Trilemma）这一结构性治理约束，并引入OTR框架（Outpace, Trust, Resilience）作为应对方案，同时提出市场时机悖论与5:1资本投资纪律，并给出六个可测试的研究命题。
AI.research_question: 在整合性监管服务行业中，传统"规模致胜"的竞争范式为何失效？组织如何在部署速度、资本效率和信任治理三个维度之间实现结构性平衡？
AI.motivation: 传统上认为规模更大的企业拥有结构性竞争优势，但超本地化地理竞争、轻资产运营模式和治理AI部署的融合正在颠覆这一前提。规模优势正在转化为竞争劣势，而现有战略理论未能解释这一结构性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本效率三难困境（Capital-Efficiency Trilemma）：基于AIconomics三难困境的宏观经济学结构逻辑，提出在整合市场中组织无法在传统资本密集型扩张模式下同时最大化市场进入速度、资本效率和信任治理完整性。
AI.method: 基于公开可得的行业整合动态实证数据，采用实践者-学者视角，结合竞争战略、产业组织经济学与企业AI治理的跨学科分析框架，提出六个可测试的研究命题。
AI.findings: 提出四个核心概念：资本效率三难困境揭示结构性治理约束；OTR框架（Outpace超越、Trust信任、Resilience韧性）作为应对三难困境的运营模型；市场时机悖论解释传统规模如何从竞争优势转为竞争劣势；5:1资本投资纪律作为连接三难困境与AI治理框架的桥梁。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将AIconomics三难困境的逻辑框架推广至资本效率领域，正式提出资本效率三难困境概念，识别出传统规模优势向劣势转化的"市场时机悖论"机制，丰富了竞争战略理论中对结构性约束的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为整合行业中面临竞争压力的大型组织和寻求突围的小型竞争者提供了OTR框架作为可操作的竞争策略模型，并给出5:1资本投资纪律作为具体的资源配置指导原则。

title: Recognizing What's Around the Corner: Merger Control, Capabilities, and the New Nature of Potential Competition
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group and University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group

detail.title: Recognizing What's Around the Corner: Merger Control, Capabilities, and the New Nature of Potential Competition
detail.abstract: This paper argues for a capabilities-based, forward-looking approach to merger control that reflects the realities of dynamic competition. In fast-evolving sectors, the most significant competitive threats often come not from current rivals but from de novo firms or adjacent firms developing complementary technologies or capabilities. Conventional antitrust tools — rooted in static market shares and product overlaps — fail to detect these latent challengers or assess the innovation potential of mergers. We draw on economic theory, executive insight, and case studies (Meta–Giphy, Adobe–Figma, Amazon–iRobot) to show how competitive uncertainty disciplines incumbents and how mergers can either suppress or amplify that dynamic. We propose a framework that shifts the focus from products to capabilities: assessing technological assets, organizational routines, and innovation trajectories. This approach reduces enforcement errors — both false positives and false negatives — and enables regulators to protect long-term rivalry without undermining legitimate adaptation to new technology and market shifts By recognizing unseen competition as a structural feature of dynamic markets, and by evaluating mergers through the lens of capabilities, agencies can better align merger control with the goal of promoting sustained innovation and longer-term consumer welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能力（capabilities）且具有前瞻性的并购审查方法，以反映动态竞争的实际情况。在快速演变的行业中，最具威胁的竞争者往往不是现有对手，而是全新进入者或开发互补技术的邻近企业。传统反垄断工具基于静态市场份额和产品重叠，无法识别这些潜在挑战者或评估并购的创新潜力。作者结合经济理论、高管洞察和三个案例（Meta–Giphy、Adobe–Figma、Amazon–iRobot），提出将审查焦点从产品转向能力——评估技术资产、组织惯例和创新轨迹，以减少执法错误（假阳性与假阴性），使并购控制更好地促进持续创新和长期消费者福利。
AI.research_question: 在快速演变的动态竞争行业中，传统基于静态市场份额和产品重叠的并购审查工具为何失效？应如何设计一种基于能力的前瞻性并购审查框架，以准确识别潜在竞争威胁并减少执法错误？
AI.motivation: 传统反垄断工具建立在静态市场结构和产品重叠分析之上，但在技术快速迭代的行业中，最具威胁的竞争者往往来自新兴企业或开发互补技术的邻近企业，传统方法无法识别这些潜在挑战者，导致并购审查出现系统性误判（假阳性与假阴性），既可能错误阻止有益并购，也可能放任扼杀创新的并购。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态竞争理论（dynamic competition）、能力基础观（capabilities-based view）、竞争不确定性对在位者的纪律约束效应（competitive uncertainty disciplines incumbents）
AI.method: 理论分析结合案例研究：引用经济理论、高管洞察，并对三个代表性并购案例（Meta–Giphy、Adobe–Figma、Amazon–iRobot）进行深度分析，展示竞争不确定性如何约束在位者以及并购如何抑制或放大这种动态效应。
AI.findings: 传统并购审查工具无法捕捉快速演变行业中的潜在竞争威胁；竞争不确定性对在位企业具有重要的纪律约束作用；并购既可能压制这种动态竞争机制，也可能保持或放大它；将审查焦点从产品转向能力（技术资产、组织惯例、创新轨迹）可以更准确地评估并购的竞争影响，并减少执法错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力基础观引入并购控制理论，提出从"产品重叠"到"能力评估"的范式转换；将"看不见的竞争"（unseen competition）重新定义为动态市场的结构性特征而非边缘异常；构建了一个减少假阳性与假阴性执法错误的分析框架，丰富了动态竞争与反垄断理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了一套可操作的能力导向并购审查框架，帮助其识别潜在创新威胁、评估并购对创新轨迹的影响；在保护长期竞争与允许企业合法适应技术和市场变化之间取得平衡，最终服务于持续创新和长期消费者福利。

title: Exploring The Role of Digital Tools in Facilitating Business Development: A Case Study of Rigworld Group in the Oil And Gas Manpower Service Sector in Ghana

detail.title: Exploring The Role of Digital Tools in Facilitating Business Development: A Case Study of Rigworld Group in the Oil And Gas Manpower Service Sector in Ghana
detail.abstract: The digital transformation of business operations has become imperative for competitive advantage in the oil and gas industry, yet limited empirical evidence exists on how manpower service providers in emerging markets leverage digital tools for business development. This study explores the role of digital tools in facilitating business development within Ghana's oil and gas manpower services sector, focusing on Rigworld Group as a case study. Guided by the Technology-Organization-Environment framework, the study employed a qualitative research approach with twenty participants purposively selected from various departments including business development, human resources, operations, finance, and information technology. Data was collected through semi-structured interviews lasting 45 to 75 minutes and analyzed using thematic analysis to identify patterns related to digital tool adoption. The findings revealed that Customer Relationship Management systems maintained client relationship continuity but faced inconsistent departmental adoption and training gaps. Enterprise Resource Planning systems effectively integrated procurement, finance, and operations despite change resistance and system rigidity. Data analytics tools showed significant potential for strategic decision-making but remained underutilized due to restricted access and absence of a data-driven culture. E-recruitment platforms successfully expanded the talent pool and accelerated hiring processes but suffered from inefficient candidate filtering and poor integration with other HR systems. The study concludes that while Rigworld Group has progressed in digital adoption, a fragmented approach characterized by departmental silos, inadequate training, and poor system integration limits the full realization of digital transformation benefits. It is recommended that the company implement comprehensive training programs, establish clear usage protocols across departments, foster a data-first organizational culture, and form a dedicated cross-functional team to spearhead an integrated digital transformation strategy that aligns technology adoption with strategic business objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究以加纳油气行业人力服务企业Rigworld Group为案例，运用TOE框架和定性研究方法，探讨数字工具在业务发展中的作用。研究发现CRM、ERP、数据分析工具和电子招聘平台虽有应用成效，但存在部门孤岛、培训不足和系统集成度低等碎片化问题，制约了数字化转型效益的全面实现。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场中人力服务提供商如何利用数字工具促进油气行业的业务发展？Rigworld Group的数字工具采用现状、障碍与成效如何？
AI.motivation: 油气行业的数字化转型已成为竞争优势的必备条件，但关于新兴市场中人力服务提供商如何利用数字工具促进业务发展的实证证据十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境（Technology-Organization-Environment, TOE）框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法；从业务发展、人力资源、运营、财务和信息技术等不同部门有目的地选取20名参与者；采用45至75分钟的半结构化访谈收集数据；运用主题分析（thematic analysis）识别数字工具采用相关模式。
AI.findings: 1) CRM系统能维持客户关系连续性，但存在部门间采用不一致和培训缺口；2) ERP系统有效整合采购、财务和运营，但面临变革阻力和系统僵化问题；3) 数据分析工具在战略决策方面潜力显著，但因访问受限和缺乏数据驱动文化而利用不足；4) 电子招聘平台扩大了人才库并加速招聘流程，但候选人筛选效率低下且与其他人事系统集成不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TOE框架应用于油气行业人力服务领域，丰富了数字化转型理论在新兴市场情境下的适用性；揭示了组织内部碎片化采用对数字化转型成效的制约机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提出具体建议：实施全面培训计划、建立跨部门明确使用协议、培育数据优先的组织文化、组建专门的跨职能团队以推动整合式数字化转型战略，使技术采用与战略业务目标保持一致。

title: Combating Authorized Retailers' Gray Market Diversion: The Value of Blockchain Adoption for the Manufacturer
affiliations: Central South University, Central South University, Central South University and Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Combating Authorized Retailers' Gray Market Diversion: The Value of Blockchain Adoption for the Manufacturer
detail.abstract: In practice, low-end market retailers may divert products to high-end markets (hereafter referred to as gray market diversion), eroding manufacturers' profits and diluting brand value. To address this, manufacturers may adopt blockchain and impose penalties, but blockchain may reveal that true product quality is lower than consumers' perceived quality. AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含制造商、高端市场零售商和低端市场零售商的博弈模型，研究制造商如何通过区块链技术和惩罚机制应对低端零售商向高端市场转售产品（灰色市场转售）的问题。区块链虽然能遏制灰色市场转售，但也可能暴露产品真实质量低于消费者感知质量的风险。
AI.research_question: 制造商应如何选择区块链技术和惩罚机制来应对灰色市场转售行为？
AI.motivation: 实践中低端市场零售商可能将产品转售至高端市场，侵蚀制造商利润并稀释品牌价值。制造商需采取有效策略（区块链+惩罚）应对，但区块链的采用面临两面性：既能遏制转售，又可能暴露产品质量低于消费者感知的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（game-theoretic model）
AI.method: 构建包含制造商、高端零售商（H）和低端零售商（L）三方参与的博弈论模型
AI.findings: 论文探讨了制造商在区块链采用与惩罚机制之间的权衡决策，以及这些决策对灰色市场转售、各参与方利润和品牌价值的影响（具体结果需待原文详述）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为灰色市场转售管理提供了博弈论分析框架，揭示了区块链技术在分销渠道管理中的双刃剑效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商制定应对灰色市场转售的策略提供了决策参考，帮助其权衡区块链采用的成本与收益，以及惩罚力度的设置。

title: Why They Stay, Why They Leave: A Job Embeddedness Model of Turnover Intention in Student-Led Startups in Egypt

detail.title: Why They Stay, Why They Leave: A Job Embeddedness Model of Turnover Intention in Student-Led Startups in Egypt

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that this research was conducted independently of any commercial venture with which the author may be affiliated, and that no financial or personal relationships influenced the design, analysis, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves human participants through an anonymous, voluntary survey instrument. Participants provide informed consent prior to participation, are informed of their right to withdraw at any time without penalty, and are not asked to provide personally identifying information. The study poses no more than minimal risk to participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for the preparation of this paper.

detail.abstract: Purpose: Employee turnover is a persistent challenge for early-stage ventures, yet most research on this problem draws on samples from mature firms in developed economies. This paper addresses a narrower and largely unexamined context: student-led entrepreneurial teams operating within university-based startup ecosystems in Egypt. Drawing on job embeddedness theory, the paper develops a conceptual model explaining why members of such teams form the intention to stay or the intention to leave, and proposes founder-team relationship quality as a boundary condition on this relationship. Design/methodology/approach: The paper proposes a quantitative, cross-sectional survey design. A structured questionnaire adapting established scales for job embeddedness, turnover intention, and founder-team fit is designed for administration to members of student-led venture teams affiliated with Egyptian university entrepreneurship programmes and competitions. The paper specifies the sampling frame, measurement instruments, reliability procedures, and the planned analytical strategy (correlation and hierarchical regression analysis) in full, so that the design can be independently replicated and the resulting data subjected to peer scrutiny. Findings: This paper presents the conceptual model, hypotheses, and complete research design; empirical data collection is in progress at the time of submission. The results section is structured to report descriptive statistics, reliability coefficients, correlation matrices, and hierarchical regression output once fieldwork is complete, consistent with the reporting conventions of comparable published studies in this literature. Originality/value: Job embeddedness research has concentrated overwhelmingly on established organisations in North American, European, and East Asian settings. Very little work has examined how the theory applies to the informal, resource-constrained, and founder-centric environment of student entrepreneurship in the Middle East and North Africa. By extending job embeddedness theory to this context and introducing founder-team fit as a moderating mechanism specific to early-stage ventures, the paper offers a theoretical and practical contribution relevant to entrepreneurship educators, student venture founders, and policymakers supporting university-based entrepreneurship ecosystems in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于工作嵌入理论，构建了一个概念模型，解释埃及大学学生创业团队成员的去留意图，并提出创始人-团队关系质量作为边界条件。论文提出了完整的研究设计（横截面问卷调查、相关分析与层级回归），但数据收集尚在进行中。
AI.research_question: 在埃及大学创业生态系统中，学生领导创业团队成员形成留任意图或离职意图的机制是什么？创始人-团队关系质量如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 现有员工流失研究主要基于发达经济体的成熟企业样本，针对早期创业企业（尤其是中东和北非地区学生创业团队）的研究极为匮乏。工作嵌入理论此前几乎未应用于这一非正式、资源受限、创始人主导的情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作嵌入理论（Job Embeddedness Theory）
AI.method: 定量横截面调查设计；采用结构化问卷（改编工作嵌入、离职意向和创始人-团队匹配的成熟量表）；计划采用相关分析和层级回归分析；详细说明了抽样框架、测量工具、信度检验程序和统计分析策略以保证可复制性。
AI.findings: 本文在投稿时仅呈现概念模型、假设和完整研究设计；实证数据收集尚在进行中，结果部分仅为计划中的报告框架（描述性统计、信度系数、相关矩阵和层级回归输出）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工作嵌入理论扩展到中东和北非地区学生创业团队这一全新情境；引入创始人-团队匹配作为针对早期创业企业的调节机制，丰富了工作嵌入理论的边界条件研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业教育者、学生创业团队创始人和支持新兴市场大学创业生态系统的政策制定者提供理论与实践启示，帮助理解并改善学生创业团队的人才保留问题。

title: Spatial Spillover and Synergistic Effects of Leading Pedestrian Intervals: Empirical Evidence from New York City
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Spatial Spillover and Synergistic Effects of Leading Pedestrian Intervals: Empirical Evidence from New York City
detail.abstract: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI) is a signal-timing treatment designed to reduce pedestrian-vehicle conflicts at signalized intersections, yet conventional evaluations often assume intersection-level independence and overlook heterogeneity in traffic exposure. Using a panel of 36,018 intersection-year observations from New York City between 2013 and 2018, this study combines multidimensional coarsened exact matching with a high-dimensional fixed-effects Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood model and cluster-robust standard errors. The estimated effects vary with traffic state and spatial deployment pattern. Under low-to-moderate traffic volumes, LPI is associated with local safety gains and protective spillovers to adjacent intersections. Under high-volume conditions, isolated LPI is associated with risk transfer to adjacent intersections, consistent with compressed vehicular right-of-way. Clustered LPI deployments appear to attenuate this adverse spillover, suggesting a network-level traffic-calming effect. Model-based counterfactual topology reconstruction indicates that, under the same number of installed LPIs, reallocating treatments could increase avoided crashes by 52.97%, reduce the spatial standard deviation of residual risk by 4.70%, and lower maximum intersection risk by 8.71%. These model-based findings show that LPI programs should be evaluated and deployed as network-level interventions rather than as isolated intersection treatments.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用纽约市2013-2018年36,018个交叉口-年观测数据，结合多维精确匹配与高维固定效应泊松伪极大似然模型，发现行人先行间隔（LPI）的效果因交通流量和空间部署模式而异：低至中等流量下LPI带来局部安全收益和相邻交叉口的保护性溢出；高流量下孤立LPI将风险转移至相邻交叉口，而集群部署可缓解这种不利溢出。反事实拓扑重构表明，在相同安装数量下重新分配LPI可增加52.97%的避免事故数，降低风险空间标准差4.70%及最大交叉口风险8.71%，意味着LPI应作为网络级干预而非孤立交叉口措施进行部署。
AI.research_question: LPI（行人先行间隔）的信号配时措施在不同交通流量和空间部署模式下，其安全性效应如何变化？LPI应如何作为网络级干预而非孤立交叉口措施进行评估和部署？
AI.motivation: 传统评估LPI效果的方法通常假设交叉口层面相互独立，并忽略了交通暴露量的异质性，这可能导致对LPI实际效果的误判，无法揭示其空间溢出效应和风险转移机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交通暴露异质性理论、空间溢出效应理论、风险转移理论、网络级交通静化效应理论
AI.method: 多维粗化精确匹配（coarsened exact matching）结合高维固定效应泊松伪极大似然模型（PPML），并采用聚类稳健标准误；同时进行了基于模型的反事实拓扑重构分析。
AI.findings: 1) 低至中等交通流量下，LPI带来局部安全收益并对相邻交叉口产生保护性溢出；2) 高流量条件下，孤立LPI将风险转移至相邻交叉口，符合车辆通行权被压缩的机制；3) 集群部署LPI可缓解不利溢出，产生网络级交通静化效应；4) 在相同安装数量下重新分配LPI，可增加52.97%避免事故数、降低4.70%残余风险空间标准差及8.71%最大交叉口风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LPI评估从交叉口独立视角拓展至网络层面，揭示了LPI效果依赖于交通状态和空间部署模式的异质性，并提出风险转移与保护性溢出的双面溢出机制，以及集群部署的网络级交通静化效应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通管理部门提供了基于实证的LPI网络级部署优化策略，证明在相同资源投入下通过空间重新配置可显著提升安全效益并降低风险分布的不均衡性，指导LPI政策的科学规划。

title: Risk-Informed Heterogeneous Proxy Models Using Machine Learning to Predict Cool-Down Time for Hydrate Mitigation in Deepwater Petroleum Pipelines

detail.title: Risk-Informed Heterogeneous Proxy Models Using Machine Learning to Predict Cool-Down Time for Hydrate Mitigation in Deepwater Petroleum Pipelines
detail.abstract: After an unplanned shutdown in subsea oil and gas pipelines, hydrate-formation risk can increase rapidly, potentially leading to blockage, delayed restart, and escalation of process-safety and flowassurance consequences. Operators must estimate the Cool-Down Time (CDT) rapidly because this time window constrains the preservation actions that can be safely executed before hydrate-favourable pressure-temperature conditions are reached. As an alternative to computationally demanding multiphase-flow simulations, this paper develops a risk-informed Heterogeneous Composite Proxy (HCP) model for fast CDT prediction using operating conditions measured at the onset of shutdown. The proposed framework combines a cost-sensitive binary classifier, which identifies high-and low-risk operating regimes with respect to a CDT threshold, with two local regression models dedicated to the corresponding regimes. An Adaptive Hybrid Sampling (AHS) procedure is then used to enrich the training set both near the risk boundary and inside the high-risk region, where prediction errors have the most severe operational consequences. The framework is evaluated on an OLGA-based model of a real offshore pipeline and compared with global and composite proxy baselines trained with conventional and adaptive sampling. The results show that the proposed risk-informed HCP improves CDT prediction in the high-risk region while maintaining online prediction times compatible with operational decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文针对海底油气管道非计划停产后水合物形成的冷却时间（CDT）快速预测问题，提出了一种风险告知的异构复合代理（HCP）模型。该模型结合成本敏感的二分类器识别高低风险工况，并为不同风险区域分别建立局部回归模型，通过自适应混合采样（AHS）在风险边界和高风险区域内富集训练集。基于OLGA真实海底管道模型的评估表明，该方法在高风险区域的CDT预测精度得到提升，同时保持在线预测时间满足运营决策支持要求。
AI.research_question: 如何在非计划停产后快速准确地预测海底油气管道的水合物冷却时间（CDT），以支持高效的安全运营决策？
AI.motivation: 非计划停产后水合物形成风险迅速上升，可能导致管道堵塞、延迟重启及工艺安全和流动保障后果。运营商需要快速估算CDT以确定安全的保压操作时间窗口，但传统的多相流模拟计算量大、耗时长，无法满足快速决策需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险告知的异构复合代理模型框架，结合成本敏感二分类与局部回归模型，以及自适应混合采样策略。
AI.method: 1) 成本敏感二分类器区分CDT阈值对应的高/低风险运行工况；2) 为两个风险区域分别构建局部回归模型；3) 自适应混合采样（AHS）在风险边界和高风险区域内富集训练集；4) 基于OLGA真实海底管道模型进行验证，并与全局及复合代理基线进行对比。
AI.findings: 所提出的风险告知HCP模型在高风险区域的CDT预测精度优于全局和复合代理基线模型，同时在线预测时间保持在运营决策支持可接受的范围内。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种风险告知的异构复合代理建模框架，将成本敏感分类与局部回归相结合，并引入针对风险区域的自适应采样策略，为代理模型在安全关键工况下的应用提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海底油气管道运营商提供了一种快速、可靠的CDT预测工具，可在停产后迅速评估水合物形成风险，从而优化保压策略、降低堵塞和延迟重启风险，支持实时运营决策。

title: Warranted AI: Seven Conditions for Defensible Reliance on Consequential AI-Enabled Decisions and Actions in Regulated Industries

detail.title: Warranted AI: Seven Conditions for Defensible Reliance on Consequential AI-Enabled Decisions and Actions in Regulated Industries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.

detail.abstract:
Organisations already rely on AI-enabled decisions and actions in consequential settings. Yet accountability has not kept pace with technology. Warranted Reliance means reliance that can be justified, defended and stood behind with accountability. The key gap is that governance intent is not the same as Governance in Effect. Policies, approvals, inventories and assurance reports alone do not show that governance operated when a system shaped a decision, initiated an action or produced consequences.

Warranted AI addresses that gap by defining a Warranting Standard for organisational reliance on consequential AI-enabled decisions and actions. It is a threshold test for when reliance can be justified, defended and stood behind. This is not an AI ethics framework, a model explainability method or a compliance checklist. Warranted AI defines the conditions under which reliance can be warranted.

The standard takes the form of seven conditions that operate together. They test whether the organisation knew what it relied on, could trace what occurred, preserved accountability, enforced boundaries, sustained scrutiny, maintained independent oversight and protected the context and state required for reliance. The standard is sector-agnostic because institutional forms differ, but the reliance question does not.

Warranted AI is not proof of legality. It is the evidentiary condition for defensible organisational reliance.

AI tools were used for directed literature retrieval and drafting assistance in the preparation of this paper. All research evaluation, framework architecture, conditions, conceptual positions and authorial judgements are the author’s own. The author takes full responsibility for all claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有据信赖"（Warranted Reliance）概念，并构建了"Warranted AI"标准，旨在弥合组织治理意图与实际治理效果之间的差距，为组织在重大AI决策与行动中的信赖提供可辩护、可问责的证明条件。
AI.research_question: 组织在何种条件下才能对重大AI驱动的决策和行动进行有据（可正当化、可辩护、可问责）的信赖？
AI.motivation: 虽然组织已经在关键情境中依赖AI决策，但问责机制未能与技术同步发展。现有的政策、审批、清单和保证报告仅代表治理意图，无法证明治理在系统实际影响决策或行动时真正发挥了作用，即"治理在效果上"的缺失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"有据信赖"（Warranted Reliance）为核心概念框架，提出"Warranting Standard"作为组织依赖重大AI决策的门槛测试标准，该标准由七个相互关联的条件构成。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性研究：构建了包含七个条件的标准框架——是否知晓所依赖之物、能否追溯发生之事、是否保持问责、是否执行边界、是否维持持续审查、是否保持独立监督、是否保护信赖所需的上下文与状态。
AI.findings: Warranted AI标准以七个协同运作的条件作为组织信赖AI的门槛测试；该标准具有跨部门通用性，因为机构形式各异但信赖问题本质相同；该标准不是合法性证明，而是可辩护的组织信赖的证据性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"治理意图"与"治理实效"的区分，并通过"有据信赖"和"Warranting Standard"概念填补了这一理论缺口；明确将所提标准与AI伦理框架、模型可解释性方法及合规检查清单区分开来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了实践性门槛测试，帮助其判断在重大AI决策和行动中的信赖是否可正当化、可辩护和可问责；标准具有部门通用性，适用于不同机构类型。

title: Firms Relocation Saga: A Bibliometric and Econometric Analysis of Firm Relocation Research
affiliations: Central Bank of Armenia

detail.title: Firms Relocation Saga: A Bibliometric and Econometric Analysis of Firm Relocation Research
detail.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive examination of the scholarly literature concerning firm relocation. I assess a broad collection of studies in this domain, tracing their development from the earliest records to the current day. By classifying the research according to its medium of dissemination-distinguishing between PDFs, web-based content, and books-I detect a pronounced transition in citation practices over the decades. Whereas books once formed the primary vehicle for sharing insights, PDF-based formats have now become overwhelmingly dominant. The available evidence further indicates that PDF articles tend to garner a substantially higher number of citations than books, pointing to a tangible impact advantage for digital formats. The volume of publication has risen sharply in more recent years, with the greatest density of papers occurring in the modern period. A closer inspection of the subject matter reveals a significant evolution in scholarly focus. Earlier work concentrated chiefly on conventional location determinants, such as input costs and logistical considerations. More recently, however, the discourse has gravitated toward contemporary issues, including cross-border production shifts, industrial repatriation, technological digitization, and the influence of sudden regulatory interventions. Cumulatively, this review enables me to map the field's progression toward maturity, highlight the scholarly rewards of adopting current publication modes, and establish a foundational reference point for future bibliometric inquiries in economic geography.

AI.tldr: 本文对企业迁移相关学术文献进行了全面综述，按传播媒介（PDF、网页、书籍）分类研究，发现PDF格式已主导引用实践且引用量显著高于书籍，并追踪了研究主题从传统区位因素向跨境生产转移、产业回流、数字化及政策干预等当代议题的演变。
AI.research_question: 企业迁移领域学术文献的发展脉络与演变趋势是什么？不同传播媒介如何影响学术引用，以及研究主题在时间上发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏对企业迁移领域文献的系统性综述，尤其是缺少从传播媒介视角审视引用模式演变及其影响的研究，需要为该领域建立基础性的文献图谱参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学与引文分析理论，以及经济地理学中企业区位选择理论（涵盖传统区位因子与当代迁移驱动因素）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，对企业迁移相关研究按传播媒介（PDF、网络内容、书籍）进行分类，通过引文数量对比和出版密度的时序分析进行文献计量评估。
AI.findings: （1）出版媒介经历了从书籍主导到PDF格式压倒性主导的转变；（2）PDF文章比书籍获得显著更多的引用，具有明显的数字格式影响力优势；（3）近期论文出版量急剧上升，现代时期密度最高；（4）研究主题从早期注重投入成本、物流等传统区位因素，转向跨境生产转移、产业回流、技术数字化和监管干预等当代议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 描绘了企业迁移领域的演进路径与成熟度图谱，揭示了传播媒介变迁对学术影响力的作用机制，为经济地理学的文献计量研究奠定了理论参考基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了选择当代出版媒介以提升学术影响力的实务指引，并为未来经济地理学领域的文献计量分析建立了基础性参考框架。

title: Dharma Beyond Outcomes: Conscience as the Measure of an Impeccable Life
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Dharma Beyond Outcomes: Conscience as the Measure of an Impeccable Life
detail.abstract: This essay argues that righteous action consists in fidelity to conscience-disciplined by truthfulness and non-harm, values it derives as the minimal preconditions of discernment itself rather than assuming outright-regardless of outcome, following the Bhagavad Gita's teaching on action without attachment to its fruits. It defines adharma not as any particular ideology but as a recurring mechanism: the substitution of a pre-issued category for case-by-case discernment, visible alike in caste, in the strand of Enlightenment rationality that fused with commerce, in market logic, in certain forms of identity politics, and inside rule of law itself, whenever protection from harm is made conditional on prior classification rather than grounded in the harm itselfwhile distinguishing this from a case against rules as such, since fixed categories remain indispensable protections against power asymmetry and the cognitive limits of individual discretion, and become adharmic only when they stop answering to the case they were made to serve. Extending the discernment test from the individual to the organization, the essay develops an account of dharma as a continuously learnt protocol rather than a fixed virtue or rule-a discipline of reverence for the other that must be relearned at each encounter, illustrated through natural coexistence (the platypus and its ecology) and collective synergy (a football team in flow), and drawing a considered distinction from relativism, Kantian deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, stakeholder theory, value pluralism, agonistic pluralism, and Ubuntu ethics. It then confronts the vulnerability of any such process account-that a learnt protocol can drift into capture while still calling itself dharmic-and examines, without fully resolving, what kind of reference could correct such drift without repeating the very fault it corrects, drawing on the Samkhya distinction between Purusha and Prakriti and the Saiva Siddhanta relation of Siva and Sakti as models of a reference incapable of capture because it does not act, while being explicit that neither this reference nor the appeal to love that follows from it constitutes an operational solution to the drift problem-only an orientation the unresolved work of discernment must not lose sight of. The essay closes by applying this framework honestly to artificial intelligencearguing that an AI system is structurally all Sakti and no Siva, that human oversight cannot itself supply the uncapturable reference the argument requires, and that this limitation, honestly acknowledged, is itself the more useful contribution to AI ethics than a false resolution would be.

AI.tldr: 本文以《薄伽梵歌》"无执于果"的教导为基础，主张正义行动在于对良知的忠诚，并将其约束于真实性和非伤害性原则。文章将adharma定义为一种反复出现的机制——用预先给定的类别替代逐案辨别，并以此考察种姓制度、启蒙理性与商业的结合、市场逻辑、身份政治以及法治本身中的非正义现象。文章进一步将辨别测试从个体扩展到组织，将dharma阐述为一种持续学习的协议而非固定德性或规则，并通过对人工智能的分析收尾，指出AI系统在结构上"全为Sakti而无Siva"，人类监督无法提供不可捕捉的参照，这一诚实的局限本身即是对AI伦理更有用的贡献。
AI.research_question: 正义行动的本质是什么？如何理解adharma（非正义）作为一种反复出现的机制，以及dharma作为一种持续学习的协议如何在个体、组织及人工智能层面得以实践？
AI.motivation: 作者试图超越将adharma等同于特定意识形态的简化理解，揭示其作为"以预先分类替代逐案辨别"的结构性机制；同时回应过程性伦理叙事——学习型协议可能漂移为被捕获（capture）状态的脆弱性，并诚实地面对包括AI伦理在内的当代应用困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以《薄伽梵歌》的行动哲学（无执于果）为根基，结合数论派（Samkhya）的Purusha与Prakriti区分、湿婆悉檀多（Saiva Siddhanta）的Siva与Sakti关系，并在与相对主义、康德义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、利益相关者理论、价值多元主义、对抗性多元主义及Ubuntu伦理等进行比较中确立自身立场。
AI.method: 哲学论证/概念分析：通过定义关键概念（良知、adharma机制、dharma作为学习协议），运用案例说明（鸭嘴兽及其生态、足球队的集体协同），并进行系统性的伦理理论比较，最后将框架应用于人工智能伦理分析。
AI.findings: (1) adharma不是特定意识形态，而是"预先分类替代逐案辨别"的机制，在种姓、商业启蒙理性、市场逻辑、身份政治和法治中均可识别；(2) 固定类别并非天然有害——它们是防止权力不对称和个人认知局限的必要保护，仅在不再回应其服务对象时才成为非正义；(3) dharma是持续学习的协议，需在每次相遇中重新学习对他者的敬畏；(4) 学习协议可能漂移为"捕获"状态，而Samkhya和Saiva Siddhanta提供的不可捕捉参照（不作为的参照）仅是导向，不是操作性解决方案；(5) AI系统结构上全为Sakti而无Siva，人类监督无法弥补这一结构性缺陷，诚实的承认比虚假的解决更有价值。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将adharma重新概念化为结构与机制而非意识形态，提供了超越左右之争的非正义分析框架；(2) 提出dharma作为"持续学习的协议"的过程性伦理学路径，并明确了其与主流伦理理论的区分；(3) 引入印度哲学（Samkhya、Saiva Siddhanta）资源回应过程伦理学的"漂移/捕获"难题；(4) 为AI伦理提供了结构性批判——指出AI的"全Sakti无Siva"本质及人类监督的局限，拒绝虚假的解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为识别各种制度性非正义提供了诊断工具——权责以预先分类为条件而非以伤害本身为基础；(2) 为组织伦理提供了"dharma作为学习协议"的实践模型；(3) 为政策制定者提供了区分"正当固定类别"与"adharmic类别"的辨别标准（是否持续回应其服务对象）；(4) 对AI伦理领域提出审慎性警告：不提供虚假解决方案，而是通过诚实承认结构性局限来指导AI治理的预期管理。

title: Introductory Analysis of the 2025 Annual Homelessness Assessment Report
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - School of Social Policy & Practice and

detail.title: Introductory Analysis of the 2025 Annual Homelessness Assessment Report

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article. The authors report that there are not competing interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article. The authors report that there are not competing interests to declare.

detail.abstract: This analysis examines the sharp surge and modest reversal of overall homelessness between 2022 and 2025 according to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's (HUD) 2025 Annual Homelessness Assessment Report (AHAR). After rising by 32% (189,018 people) between 2022 and 2024, literal homelessness on any given night fell by 3% (25,828) between 2024 and 2025. Underneath this slight decline are two divergent trends: an 11% drop in family homelessness paired with continued increases in individual and chronic homelessness, which both reached record highs. The reversal was also concentrated in the same geographies that accounted for the majority of the previous increases. States like New York and Illinois attribute this reversal to a declining inflow of migrants and the closing of emergency shelters temporarily constructed to serve new arrivals (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development [HUD], 2026b). We demonstrate that the surge and partial reversal were both driven by local dynamics rather than a broader national trend.

AI.tldr: 本文根据HUD 2025年年度无家可归评估报告，分析了2022至2025年间美国无家可归问题的急剧上升与小幅回落，指出33%的上升和3%的下降均由地方动态驱动而非全国性趋势，且回落集中在此前增长最显著的地理区域。
AI.research_question: 2022至2025年间美国无家可归人数急剧上升后小幅回落，这一变化是否反映了全国性趋势，还是由地方动态所驱动？
AI.motivation: 无家可归问题在2022至2024年间急剧上升32%，2024至2025年间出现3%的小幅回落，但其背后的驱动因素尚不明确，需要区分全国性趋势与地方性因素的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该分析基于无家可归人口统计与区域差异分析框架，关注家庭、个人及长期无家可归人口的结构性分化。
AI.method: 基于HUD 2025年年度无家可归评估报告数据的描述性统计与趋势对比分析，比较2022-2024与2024-2025两个时段的总量及分类变化，并分析地理分布特征。
AI.findings: （1）无家可归总人数在2022至2024年上升32%（增加189,018人），2024至2025年下降3%（减少25,828人）；（2）家庭无家可归下降11%，但个人和长期无家可归持续上升并创历史新高；（3）回落集中在此前增长最集中的地区；（4）纽约和伊利诺伊等州将回落归因于移民流入减少及临时紧急庇护所的关闭；（5）激增与回落均由地方动态驱动，而非全国性趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究挑战了将无家可归变化视为全国性统一趋势的传统认知，揭示了地方政策、移民流动和庇护所供给等地方因素在无家可归人口动态中的决定性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府制定针对性的无家可归干预政策提供了实证依据，表明应对移民流入驱动的无家可归激增需要地方层面的应急与长期规划，同时提示需关注个人和长期无家可归问题的持续恶化。

title:
Digital Asset Governance and Settlement Infrastructure:  Institutional OTC Liquidity Architecture and Sequential Compliance
Frameworks

detail.title:
Digital Asset Governance and Settlement Infrastructure:  Institutional OTC Liquidity Architecture and Sequential Compliance
Frameworks
detail.abstract:
The institutionalization of digital assets demands a
paradigm shift from speculative execution velocity to deterministic
settlement finality. This paper examines the systemic architecture
governing large-scale, cross-border over-the-counter (OTC) digital
asset liquidity networks. Specifically, we evaluate the implementation
of the NEXARION CETL Controlled Execution Architecture as a
non-cryptographic, multi-gate sequential compliance layer designed to
manage multi-party tokenized value transfers. By analyzing the
structural mechanics of data observability and programmatic risk
isolation, this study provides an operational blueprint for financial
institutions to execute large-scale digital asset operations without
exposing core capital to settlement volatility or counterparty
execution failure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字资产机构化进程中，从投机性执行速度向确定性结算最终性转变的范式需求。研究聚焦于NEXARION CETL受控执行架构——一种非加密、多网关的顺序合规层，用于管理大规模跨境OTC数字资产流动性网络中的多方代币化价值转移。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统性架构实现大规模跨境OTC数字资产流动性网络的确定性结算，同时规避结算波动和对手方执行失败风险？
AI.motivation: 数字资产机构化要求从投机性执行速度向确定性结算最终性进行范式转变，现有架构缺乏针对大规模多方代币化价值转移的非加密合规执行层。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字资产机构化理论、结算最终性理论、系统性架构治理框架、数据可观测性与程序化风险隔离理论
AI.method: 对NEXARION CETL受控执行架构进行系统性评估，分析其作为非加密、多网关顺序合规层的实施效果，包括数据可观测性和程序化风险隔离的结构性机制分析。
AI.findings: NEXARION CETL架构为金融机构提供了执行大规模数字资产操作的运营蓝图，能够在无需将核心资本暴露于结算波动或对手方执行失败的前提下实现确定性结算。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字资产领域从投机性执行速度向确定性结算最终性转变的理论框架，引入了非加密合规架构作为传统加密安全之外的替代性治理方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可操作的架构蓝图，支持在不暴露核心资本风险的情况下执行大规模跨境OTC数字资产操作，填补了机构级数字资产结算基础设施的实践空白。

title: Explicating Disability Narratives in the Media to Shape Public Attitudes, Reinforce or Dismantle Stereotypes
affiliations: , University of Oklahoma, University of Oklahoma, University of Oklahoma and University of Oklahoma

detail.title: Explicating Disability Narratives in the Media to Shape Public Attitudes, Reinforce or Dismantle Stereotypes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors reports that there are no competing financial, professional, or personal interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subject was involved in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for the conducting of this research or the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Disability narratives are inspired by the lived experiences and first-person accounts of people with disabilities. Disability narratives are essential for understanding and promoting inclusion within society, as they allow disabled and nondisabled individuals to understand the many components that play into the disabled experience. Despite this importance, disability narratives suffer from a lack of conceptual clarity and inconsistencies with intersectionality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility. Additionally, representation is inconsistent, highlighting those with visible disabilities, white experiences and nondisabled perspectives. This showcases a challenge within disability narratives that contributes to a limited view of identities. This explication follows Miller's (2023) seven-step explication process to narrow down a concise conceptual definition of disability narratives, allowing for better understanding of academic research and proper media representation. This explication uses quantitative analysis to establish the core ideas and frameworks of disability narratives. Key findings of this explication include an emphasis on identity, representation and accessibility. This explication displays conceptual precision and supports future research and analysis of disability representation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过Miller（2023）七步概念阐释法，对"残疾叙事"（disability narratives）进行了系统的概念界定与阐释。研究发现残疾叙事在概念清晰度、交叉性、多样性、包容性和可及性方面存在不足，且代表性不一致（偏重可见残疾、白人经验和非残疾视角）。研究通过定量分析确立了残疾叙事核心概念框架，强调身份认同、代表性和可及性三个核心维度。
AI.research_question: 残疾叙事（disability narratives）这一概念应如何被精确界定？其核心要素和框架是什么？
AI.motivation: 残疾叙事对于理解和促进社会包容至关重要，但当前该概念缺乏概念清晰度，且在交叉性、多样性、包容性和可及性方面存在不一致性。同时，代表性不均（偏重可见残疾、白人经验和非残疾视角）导致了身份认知的局限，因此亟需对残疾叙事进行概念厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: Miller（2023）的七步概念阐释法（explication process）
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，依据Miller（2023）七步概念阐释流程，对残疾叙事的概念进行系统化界定与框架构建。
AI.findings: 残疾叙事的核心概念要素包括：身份认同（identity）、代表性（representation）和可及性（accessibility）。研究表明残疾叙事在概念上存在模糊性，代表性偏重可见残疾、白人经验和非残疾视角，限制了身份的多元理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了更为精准和简明的残疾叙事概念定义，填补了该领域概念清晰度的空白，为学术界关于残疾叙事的研究提供了统一的概念框架基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体中残疾叙事的正确呈现提供了概念指导，有助于推动残疾群体的代表性改善，支持未来关于残疾表征的研究和分析，促进社会包容实践。

title: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth
affiliations: INSEAD - Finance, Imperial College Business School,  and Imperial College Business School

detail.title: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth
detail.abstract: Using the universe of incorporated firms in the United Kingdom, we document that long term debt that is not secured by specific corporate assets (commonly referred to as cash-flow-based debt) is ubiquitous, even among very young firms. Consistent with cash-flow-based lending depending on firms' continuation value, both the timing and the amount of cash-flow-based debt at first financing are strongly related to future performance. In fact, the age at which firms first access cash-flow-based long-term debt is a strong predictor of firm outcomes up to twenty years later. In contrast, the age at which firms access asset-based lending does not predict future performance. To understand how lending based on continuation value impacts firm dynamics, we develop a tractable theory of firm life cycle dynamics with permanent heterogeneity and financing frictions-where access to finance can be based on signals of both current and future performance. The model highlights the importance of financing based on future value in matching the predictability of cash-flow-based financing observed in the data. It also highlights how frictions to financing based on available collateral vs. future value lead to differential selection and hence very different distributions of firms that survive and grow. The degree to which firms can access financing based on future value is therefore fundamentally intertwined with aggregate firm dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文利用英国全部注册公司的数据，记录了基于现金流（而非特定资产抵押）的长期债务在各类企业（包括非常年轻的企业）中普遍存在。首次获得现金流债务融资的年龄能强有力地预测企业未来长达20年的表现，而资产抵押融资的年龄则无此预测力。作者构建了一个包含永久异质性和融资摩擦的企业生命周期理论模型，强调基于未来价值的融资对匹配数据中现金流融资的可预测性至关重要，并揭示了基于抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦如何导致差异化的企业选择和成长分布。
AI.research_question: 基于现金流（非抵押）的长期债务如何影响企业生命周期动态？首次获得此类融资的时点为何能预测企业长期表现？
AI.motivation: 传统企业融资理论侧重于资产抵押借贷，但现实中基于现金流（企业持续经营价值）的借贷非常普遍，尤其是在年轻企业中。作者希望通过数据和理论模型理解这种基于持续经营价值的融资如何影响企业动态和总体经济的企业分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业生命周期动态理论，包含永久异质性（permanent heterogeneity）和融资摩擦（financing frictions）的理论模型，区分基于当前表现（现金流/抵押品）与基于未来表现（持续经营价值）的信号获取融资。
AI.method: 实证分析：利用英国全部注册公司的数据，追踪企业首次获得现金流债务融资和资产抵押融资的年龄，并检验其对企业长期结果的预测力。理论建模：构建可处理的企业生命周期动态模型，包含永久异质性和融资摩擦，校准后与数据匹配。
AI.findings: （1）现金流债务在英国企业中普遍存在，包括非常年轻的企业；（2）首次获得现金流债务融资的时点和金额与企业未来表现强相关；（3）首次获得现金流债务融资的年龄可预测企业长达20年的结果，而资产抵押融资的年龄无此预测力；（4）模型显示基于未来价值的融资对匹配数据中现金流融资的可预测性至关重要；（5）基于抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦会导致差异化的企业选择和成长分布，融资可及性程度与总体企业动态根本交织。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统地将"基于持续经营价值的融资"纳入企业生命周期动态模型；（2）揭示了基于未来价值融资与基于抵押品融资对异质企业选择的不同影响机制；（3）建立了融资可及性程度与企业总体动态（存活和成长分布）之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业融资渠道的选择提供实证依据，表明现金流借款能力是企业未来表现的早期信号；（2）对信贷政策制定者具有启示意义：影响基于未来价值融资可得性的政策将深刻影响企业总体动态和经济结构。

title: Harnessing Intellectual Capital to Drive Competitive Advantage: Implications for SME's Performance in Nigeria
affiliations: University of Ilorin, Ilorin, Nigeria and University of South Africa, University of South Africa

detail.title: Harnessing Intellectual Capital to Drive Competitive Advantage: Implications for SME's Performance in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: The ethical approval was approved by the University

detail.abstract: Studies and reports show that over half of SMEs fail within the first five years of inception, and over one-third fail within the first two years of operation. As a result, the study aims to harness the potential of intellectual capital, formal education, hard/soft skills, and e-commerce to drive competitive advantage and enhance SME's performance in Kwara State. The study was grounded in Resource-Based Theory and Dynamic Capabilities Theory because of their effectiveness in explaining the subject. This study employed a descriptive survey research design for a population of 3,124 SMEs registered with the Kwara State Board of Internal Revenue. The sample size was determined using Raosoft online, resulting in 354. The study was analyzed using descriptive statistics, measures of central tendency and inferential statistics. It was found that formal education has a weak but statistically significant positive influence on SMEs' performance (R=0.305; p<0.001). Also, hard/soft skills have a positive (moderately significant) influence on SMEs' performance (R = 0.428; p<0.001). Finally, e-commerce platforms have a weak but statistically significant positive effect on SMEs' performance (R=0.322, p<0.001). The study found that e-commerce adoption appears more prevalent among experienced SME operators. Similarly, using both hard and soft skills is necessary to integrate e-commerce into corporate processes. SME vendors are advised to use social media and e-commerce platforms to boost their online presence.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨智力资本、正规教育、硬/软技能及电子商务如何驱动尼日利亚夸拉州中小企业（SMEs）的竞争优势与绩效。研究发现正规教育、硬/软技能和电子商务平台均对SME绩效有统计上显著的正向影响，其中硬/软技能的影响为中等强度，正规教育和电子商务的影响较弱。
AI.research_question: 智力资本、正规教育、硬/软技能和电子商务如何影响夸拉州中小企业的竞争优势和绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 超过一半的中小企业在成立五年内倒闭，超过三分之一在两年内倒闭，亟需探明提升中小企业绩效的关键驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础理论（Resource-Based Theory）和动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）
AI.method: 采用描述性调查研究设计，研究对象为夸拉州税务局注册的3,124家中小企业，通过Raosoft在线工具确定354个样本量。运用描述性统计、集中趋势测量和推断性统计进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 正规教育对SME绩效有弱但统计显著的正向影响（R=0.305, p<0.001）；2. 硬/软技能对SME绩效有中等程度的正向显著影响（R=0.428, p<0.001）；3. 电子商务平台对SME绩效有弱但统计显著的正向影响（R=0.322, p<0.001）；4. 电子商务采用在经验丰富的经营者中更普遍；5. 硬技能和软技能需结合使用以将电子商务整合到企业流程中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资源基础理论与动态能力理论相结合，实证验证了智力资本各维度（教育、技能）和电子商务能力作为企业资源/动态能力对中小企业绩效的差异化贡献，为两个理论在发展中国家中小企业情境下提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议中小企业经营者使用社交媒体和电子商务平台提升在线曝光度；强调硬技能与软技能并重以有效整合电子商务；提示经验丰富的经营者更宜采用电子商务，为中小企业管理者提供可操作的实践指导。

title: Judicial Governance Capacity: A Diagnostic Application of the Governance Accountability Architecture Framework to Federal Professional Accountability
affiliations: Liberty University and

detail.title: Judicial Governance Capacity: A Diagnostic Application of the Governance Accountability Architecture Framework to Federal Professional Accountability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could have inappropriately influenced the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is a conceptual and diagnostic study. It did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, animals, or biological materials. Institutional Review Board approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external grant funding. The study was independently conducted by the authors as part of the Governance Accountability Architecture Research Program at the IAM of America Policy Center.

detail.abstract: The federal professional accountability system—the institutional framework through which attorneys admitted to practice before federal courts are investigated, adjudicated, and sanctioned for professional misconduct—operates through a complex governance architecture of distributed authority spanning state licensing authorities, federal district courts, courts of appeals, agency professional-responsibility offices, and the Supreme Court. Although this distribution preserves constitutional checks and balances, professional independence, and federalism values, it also creates conditions under which accountability processes may fail when authority, information, or coordination become insufficiently integrated across organizational boundaries. This paper applies the Governance Accountability Architecture (GAA) framework to the federal professional accountability system as a diagnostic test case. Building directly upon the general theory developed in Paper A of the GAA Research Series (Whiteside & Whitesides, 2026a), the paper examines how governance architecture may influence accountability-process performance, procedural legitimacy, trust production, and institutional trust within the federal judiciary. The paper introduces Judicial Governance Capacity (JGC) as a domain-specific application of the broader Institutional Governance Capacity construct and proposes five Provisional Judicial Trust Dimensions as domain-specific applications of the Institutional Trust Framework. The paper develops a provisional map of the Governance Authority Configuration, specifies how Governance Authority Integration could be evaluated across five dimensions, identifies conditions under which Distributed Accountability Failure may emerge, and proposes four comparative institutional counterfactuals—information integration only, coordination integration only, hybrid federal credential, and consolidated federal accountability system—to isolate the distinct mechanisms through which governance architecture may influence accountability outcomes. The federal professional-accountability domain serves as the first theory-elaborating application of the framework. By assessing the framework's conceptual fit and identifying domain-specific mechanisms, boundary conditions, and testable propositions, the paper establishes a structured basis for evaluating whether the framework can be adapted to additional domains. Cross-domain portability remains a proposition to be assessed through cumulative comparison rather than a conclusion established by this paper. The paper concludes with a measurement-development agenda and comparative research design for future empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文运用治理问责架构（GAA）框架，对联邦专业问责系统（即管理联邦法院执业律师不当行为的制度体系）进行诊断性测试。论文将一般性GAA理论应用于这一具体领域，引入"司法治理能力"（JGC）和"五项临时司法信任维度"作为领域特定概念，绘制了治理权力配置图，并提出四种比较性制度反事实以隔离治理架构影响问责结果的机制。该研究是GAA框架的首次理论阐释性应用，旨在为跨领域可迁移性评估建立结构化基础。
AI.research_question: 治理架构如何影响联邦专业问责系统的问责流程绩效、程序合法性、信任生产与制度信任？GAA框架能否适用于联邦专业问责这一特定领域？
AI.motivation: 联邦专业问责系统通过分布式治理架构运作，涵盖州许可机构、联邦地区法院、上诉法院、机构专业责任办公室及最高法院。虽然这种分布维护了宪法制衡、专业独立性和联邦主义价值，但也可能导致权力、信息与协调在组织边界间整合不足时问责流程失效。因此需要引入系统性的治理架构理论框架来诊断和分析这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理问责架构（GAA）框架（源自GAA研究系列论文A）、制度治理能力（Institutional Governance Capacity）构念、制度信任框架（Institutional Trust Framework）
AI.method: 理论阐释性应用与诊断性测试：将GAA框架应用于联邦专业问责系统，绘制治理权力配置图，提出五项治理权力整合评估维度，识别分布式问责失败的触发条件，并提出四种比较性制度反事实（仅信息整合、仅协调整合、混合联邦资格、整合联邦问责系统）以隔离不同架构机制的影响。
AI.findings: 论文提出了联邦专业问责系统中分布式问责失败的潜在条件，明确了五项治理权力整合评估维度，构建了四种比较性制度反事实以区分信息整合、协调整合、混合资格及完全整合问责系统各自的影响机制。同时指出跨领域可迁移性仍是有待通过累积比较评估的命题，而非本文已确立的结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文是GAA框架的首次理论阐释性应用，通过领域特定测试评估框架的概念契合度，识别领域特定机制、边界条件与可检验命题，为框架的跨领域可迁移性评估建立了结构化基础。引入"司法治理能力"（JGC）作为制度治理能力构念的领域特定应用，并提出五项临时司法信任维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文为评估和改革联邦专业问责系统提供了系统的诊断工具和分析框架，提出了测量开发议程和比较性研究设计，为未来实证检验以及政策制定者优化问责架构提供了可操作的评估维度与制度替代方案。

title:
AI, Fiscal Space, and Social Protection in Four Latin American Economies: 
;A Scenario-based Threshold Framework

detail.title:
AI, Fiscal Space, and Social Protection in Four Latin American Economies: 
;A Scenario-based Threshold Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no intervention or direct interaction with human participants and uses aggregate sources and secondary, de-identified survey data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Can fiscal space from artificial intelligence finance recurrent social protection in Latin America? This paper develops a prespecified, scenario-based feasibility test that translates an AI dividend into income and fiscal capture, compares it with policy costs, and applies debt-consistency and persistence screens. For Peru, Chile, Colombia, and Mexico, no deterministic crossing occurs under non-stress scenarios because translation and capture jointly fall short. Crossings arise only under diagnostic disruption: Chilean guaranteed minimum income is conditionally feasible and debt-consistent; Peru's social pension crosses accounting but fails the debt guardrail; Colombia and Mexico do not cross. Crossing frequencies are model-implied, not predictive probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文针对拉丁美洲四国（秘鲁、智利、哥伦比亚、墨西哥），开发了一种预设的、基于情景的可行性检验框架，评估人工智能带来的"财政空间"能否为经常性社会保护提供资金。研究发现，在非压力情景下，没有任何国家出现确定性跨越（即AI红利无法同时满足收入转化和财政征收需求）；只有在诊断性扰动情景下才出现跨越情形：智利的保障最低收入条件可行且符合债务约束，秘鲁的社会养老金通过会计检验但未通过债务约束，哥伦比亚和墨西哥则未跨越。
AI.research_question: 人工智能带来的财政空间能否为拉丁美洲的经常性社会保护提供可持续融资？具体检验秘鲁、智利、哥伦比亚和墨西哥四国的可行性。
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲面临着持续的经常性社会保护融资缺口问题，而人工智能被视为潜在的经济增长和财政收入的来源。然而，现有研究缺乏系统性的可行性评估，无法判断AI红利能否确实转化为可持续的社会保护资金来源，因此需要建立严格的检验框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可行性检验框架，包含四个关键环节：（1）将AI红利转化为收入和财政征收；（2）与政策成本进行比较；（3）债务一致性检验；（4）持续性筛查。采用预设的、基于情景的分析方法。
AI.method: 开发一种预设的（prespecified）、基于情景的（scenario-based）可行性检验工具。具体包括：将AI红利转化为收入和财政征收的翻译模型，与政策成本进行对比，并应用债务一致性和持续性筛选标准。区分非压力情景与诊断性扰动（diagnostic disruption）情景。
AI.findings: （1）在非压力情景下，四国均无确定性跨越，原因是翻译和征收环节共同不足；（2）在诊断性扰动下才出现跨越：智利的保障最低收入条件可行且债务一致；秘鲁社会养老金会计上通过但未通过债务约束；哥伦比亚和墨西哥均未跨越；（3）跨越频率是模型内在推导的结果，而非预测性概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并应用了一个综合性的、多步骤的可行性检验框架，将AI红利、财政转化、政策成本、债务约束整合进统一的分析框架，为评估新兴技术驱动的财政空间提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉丁美洲各国政府提供了基于实证情境的社会保护融资可行性评估工具，明确指出了各国在AI红利利用上的短板（转化和征收环节），并为政策制定者提供了区分"会计可行"与"债务可持续"的诊断性参考。

title: How Can Digitization and Artificial Intelligence Enhance Service Delivery in Kenya's Marginalized Units to Combat Corruption and Foster Development?

detail.title: How Can Digitization and Artificial Intelligence Enhance Service Delivery in Kenya's Marginalized Units to Combat Corruption and Foster Development?
detail.abstract: Kenya's arid and semi-arid marginalized counties, including Turkana, Mandera, Wajir, Garissa, Samburu, Marsabit, and Tana River, continue to experience the compounded effects of historical neglect, weak public infrastructure, and endemic corruption that together undermine equitable service delivery. This paper examines how digitization and artificial intelligence (AI) can strengthen service delivery, curb corruption, and foster inclusive development in these historically underserved regions. Drawing on peer-reviewed literature, government policy documents, and recent empirical studies, the paper situates Kenya's digitization agendaanchored in the Kenya National Digital Master Plan 2022-2032, the Huduma Kenya and e-Citizen platforms, the Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS), and the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030-within the country's broader governance and anti-corruption reform trajectory. It argues that while digitization has demonstrated measurable gains in reducing opportunities for petty corruption and improving administrative efficiency, its benefits remain unevenly distributed, with marginalized counties experiencing persistent digital exclusion, weak connectivity, and elevated risk of exclusion from digital identity and welfare systems. The paper further considers the dual-use character of AI as both a tool for detecting and deterring corruption and a potential source of new governance risks, including opacity, centralization of administrative discretion, and data protection harms. It concludes with policy recommendations emphasizing infrastructure equity, rights-based digital identity reform, human-centred and explainable AI design, and strengthened institutional capacity as prerequisites for digitization and AI to meaningfully advance transparency and development in Kenya's margins.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字化和人工智能如何在肯尼亚干旱与半干旱的边缘化县（如Turkana、Mandera等）加强服务交付、遏制腐败并促进包容性发展，指出数字化虽有成效但利益分配不均，并提出以基础设施公平和以人为本的AI设计为核心的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 数字化和人工智能如何能够加强肯尼亚边缘化县的服务交付、遏制腐败并促进包容性发展？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚边缘化县长期遭受历史忽视、公共基础设施薄弱和系统性腐败，导致服务交付不公平，亟需探索数字技术能否作为变革工具改善现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理与反腐败改革理论、数字包容性发展框架、AI双重用途（dual-use）理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合同行评审文献、政府政策文件和近期实证研究
AI.findings: 数字化在减少小额腐败机会和提升行政效率方面有可衡量成效，但利益分配不均；边缘化县面临持续的数字排斥、连接薄弱及被排除在数字身份和福利系统之外的风险；AI具有检测腐败与产生新治理风险（不透明、权力集中、数据保护危害）的双重属性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了数字治理在边缘化区域的应用理论，补充了AI双重用途属性在发展中国家治理情境下的理论分析，丰富了数字排斥与包容性发展的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及其他发展中国家提出具体政策建议：基础设施公平、基于权利的数字身份改革、以人为本和可解释的AI设计、加强机构能力建设。

title: Governance Deficits in a Marginalized Devolved Unit: Corruption, Capacity, and Accountability Challenges in Turkana County, Kenya

detail.title: Governance Deficits in a Marginalized Devolved Unit: Corruption, Capacity, and Accountability Challenges in Turkana County, Kenya
detail.abstract: Since the promulgation of the Constitution of Kenya in 2010, devolution has been presented as the principal mechanism for redressing the historical marginalization of Kenya's arid and semi-arid regions. More than a decade into the devolved dispensation, Turkana County, the country's second-largest county by land area and among its poorest, illustrates both the promise and the limits of this reform. Drawing on Auditor-General reports, parliamentary records, national statistical data, peer-reviewed studies, and contemporaneous news reporting, this paper examines eight interlocking governance deficits in Turkana County: (1) corruption and misappropriation of public funds; (2) limited innovation and weak digital infrastructure constraining e-government; (3) high adult illiteracy and constrained human capital; (4) structural dependency on donor and humanitarian aid; (5) weak monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems undermining project sustainability; (6) the absence of structured, competitive human-resource frameworks in the county public service; (7) patronage-oriented cash disbursements at the expense of infrastructure investment; and (8) a persistent gap between projects reported as "complete" in audit records and their actual, often non-functional, state on the ground. The paper situates these findings within good-governance and principal-agent theoretical frameworks and within the broader literature on devolution and corruption in Kenya. It concludes with a set of policy recommendations, including the adoption of performance-linked contractual employment in the county public service, strengthened County Integrated Monitoring and Evaluation Systems (CIMES), and greater public disclosure of project status and expenditure.

AI.tldr: 本文以肯尼亚图尔卡纳县为案例，基于审计长报告、议会记录、统计数据和新闻报道，系统考察了权力下放十年后该县面临的八项治理赤字（腐败、电子政务落后、人力资本不足、援助依赖、监测评估薄弱、人力资源框架缺失、现金分配导向、项目实际未完成），并以善治和委托-代理理论为框架提出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 权力下放改革在肯尼亚干旱及半干旱地区（以图尔卡纳县为例）实施十多年后，是否有效解决了历史边缘化问题？哪些治理赤字仍在制约该地区的可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 2010年肯尼亚宪法将权力下放作为纠正干旱及半干旱地区历史边缘化的主要机制，但十余年后成效有限。图尔卡纳县作为第二大县且是最贫困县之一，集中体现了权力下放改革的承诺与局限，需要系统识别其治理缺陷以为政策改进提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 善治理论（good-governance）与委托-代理理论（principal-agent），并结合肯尼亚权力下放与腐败的相关文献。
AI.method: 定性案例研究，综合运用审计长报告、议会记录、国家统计数据、同行评审研究及同期新闻报道等多源数据进行三角验证。
AI.findings: 识别出图尔卡纳县八项相互关联的治理赤字：腐败与公款挪用、数字基础设施薄弱与电子政务创新不足、成人文盲率高且人力资本受限、对捐赠者和人道主义援助的结构性依赖、监测评估体系薄弱导致项目不可持续、县级公共服务缺乏结构化竞争性人力资源框架、以恩庇为导向的现金发放挤占基础设施投资、审计记录中"已完成"项目与实际无法运行状态之间存在持续差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将善治理论与委托-代理理论应用于肯尼亚特定干旱地区权力下放的实证研究中，揭示了权力下放改革中委托-代理链条断裂的具体机制，丰富了发展中国家中权力下放与治理腐败的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体政策建议，包括在县级公共服务中推行绩效关联合同制就业、强化县级综合监测评估系统（CIMES）、以及加强项目状态与支出的公众信息披露，为肯尼亚及其他面临类似挑战的发展中国家提供改革参考。

title: Machine Learning for Financial Statement Manipulation Risk Prediction in a Frontier Market: Evidence from Nepal
affiliations: University of Delhi - Ramjas College

detail.title: Machine Learning for Financial Statement Manipulation Risk Prediction in a Frontier Market: Evidence from Nepal
detail.abstract:
Fraud detection models have been trained and validated on data from developed markets, where disclosures follow standard formats and enforcement runs deep (Beneish, 1999; Dechow, Ge, Larson, & Sloan, 2011; Gepp, Kumar, & Bhattacharya, 2021; Perols, 2011). Nobody has tested whether these models retain their predictive power in frontier markets, where filings are incomplete and regulators lack capacity. Models trained on NYSE- or ASX-listed firms have never been tested against incomplete filings, weak oversight, and a financial system that bears little resemblance to the markets where the models were built.

Nepal provides a useful test case. NEPSE lists approximately 300 companies. The Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON) has pursued firms for late filings but has not, during our sample period, brought enforcement actions related to accounting manipulation. The listed universe is dominated by banks, microfinance companies, and hydropower developers. That sector mix does not exist in the US panels that trained Beneish or Dechow models. Annual reports present additional challenges: many are published in Nepali, typeset in Preeti font (a non-Unicode encoding that prevents standard text extraction), and they omit receivables or fixed asset data that the Modified Jones Model requires.

Gepp, Kumar, and Bhattacharya (2021, 2024) built the GEPP framework for fraud detection using financial ratios, market signals, and governance variables. Their approach normalizes ratios by industry median and predicts manipulation one year forward. The framework has performed well on US and Australian data. No study has tested whether it retains that performance when variable coverage drops below 50% and the panel spans only a decade.

We started with a simple assumption: if the same economic incentives that drive manipulation in the US (debt covenants, profitability pressure, size-related scrutiny) also drive it in Nepal, then the same machine learning methods should work in both settings. We expected the models to work, but we expected lower accuracy than what US studies report, and we expected macroeconomic variables to matter more in Nepal given the country's greater economic volatility.
